AI.tldr: 该论文研究SDD（规范驱动开发）中好的规范应包含什么内容，基于ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148对114个开源SDD仓库评分，提炼出EPIC框架（10个质量维度、40条实践），帮助开发者在编码智能体之前发现并填补规范空白。
AI.motivation: 开发者措辞（如"must"vs"should"）会被编码智能体不同解读，因智能体常用自身假设填补指令空白。SDD要求先写规范、计划和任务，但现有框架模板无法帮助开发者判断写得是否足够充分、清晰。
AI.method: （1）访谈从业者，发现措辞重要性；（2）依据ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148对114个开源SDD仓库的产出物打分；（3）从最高分仓库中提炼实践，形成EPIC框架，含10个质量维度、40条实践。
AI.result: 多数SDD实践者（N=15）认可每条实践；规范质量前1/3的仓库bug修复提交占11.8%，后1/3为20.4%；前1/3仓库贡献者中位数为后者的4倍。
AI.conclusion: 开发者可用EPIC在智能体之前发现并填补规范中的空白，提升规范质量，进而关联更低的bug修复比例与更多贡献者。

title: DBRAG: Multi-Table Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Complex Database Queries
summary: Recent advancements in large language models have introduced new capabilities for reasoning over structured data, particularly through program-aided tools that can analyze tables. However, many existing methods address single-table scenarios or assume that the relevant tables are already provided. In practice, users often issue complex data exploration queries over entire databases, where relevant information may be distributed across multiple relations. In this work, we introduce DBRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework tailored for multi-table question answering. DBRAG first retrieves candidate tables using an offline table index, enriches their summaries with query-relevant rows, and uses an LLM to rerank the candidates. A program-aided reasoner then selects the required tables and executes operations over their full contents, keeping the initial prompt context compact. Experiments on the Spider, GeoQuery, and ATIS datasets used in this study demonstrate improvements in table retrieval and multi-table question answering.

AI.tldr: DBRAG：面向多表问答的检索增强生成框架。
AI.motivation: 现有表格推理方法多针对单表场景或假设相关表已提供，而实际用户常需在整个数据库上做复杂查询，相关信息分散在多个关系中。
AI.method: DBRAG先通过离线表索引检索候选表，用查询相关行丰富其摘要，再用LLM重排候选；随后程序辅助推理器选择所需表并对其完整内容执行操作，保持初始提示上下文紧凑。
AI.result: 在Spider、GeoQuery和ATIS数据集上，表检索与多表问答性能均有提升。
AI.conclusion: DBRAG有效支持跨多关系数据库的复杂数据探索查询。

title: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
summary: We present DistScene, a framework for single-image compositional 3D scene generation by jointly modeling the environment and individual objects. Unlike existing methods that represent scenes primarily as collections of objects, we model the environment as an explicit scene component to provide geometric context for object placement. Specifically, we introduce Scene-Frame Generation, which jointly generates separate environment and object components in a shared coordinate frame, allowing their geometry and relative placement to be learned together. Then we introduce Object-Centric Refinement to refine each object in a local frame with scene context. Finally, we develop Object-to-Scene Distillation to transfer pretrained object-generation priors to scene generation through automatically composed and rendered synthetic scenes. Evaluations on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate improved scene-level spatial coherence over the evaluated baselines. Project page: https://coolbeam.github.io/DistScene/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DistScene，一个通过联合建模环境与单个对象来实现单图像组合式 3D 场景生成的框架。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要将场景表示为对象的集合，缺乏对环境的显式建模，从而难以提供对象放置所需的几何上下文。作者希望将环境作为显式场景组件建模，以提升场景级空间一致性。
AI.method: 包含三个核心组件：1) Scene-Frame Generation，在共享坐标帧中联合生成独立的环境与对象组件，使几何与相对布局可一起学习；2) Object-Centric Refinement，在局部坐标系中结合场景上下文细化每个对象；3) Object-to-Scene Distillation，通过自动合成并渲染的合成场景，将预训练的对象生成先验迁移到场景生成中。
AI.result: 在室内和室外基准上评估，结果显示相较所比较的基线方法，场景级空间一致性有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 将环境作为显式场景组件并与对象联合建模，能有效提升单图像 3D 场景生成的空间一致性。项目页面：https://coolbeam.github.io/DistScene/

title: Stabilizing language models under continual learning via condition-anchored distillation
summary: Continual adaptation of language models can change their output distribution on prompts learned earlier, while retaining every old prompt-answer pair may be undesirable or impossible. We study condition-anchored generative distillation (CAGD): retain a small set of old prompts, use a frozen previous model to reconstruct completions and generation states, and match its predictive distributions while learning the next task. The formulation separates three roles that ordinary replay conflates: conditions select the behavior to protect, teacher generations locate relevant states, and soft targets specify how predictions may change. For autoregressive language generation, teacher-rollout distillation admits an exact chain-rule decomposition of sequence divergence. For masked-diffusion language modeling, our implementation directly controls local denoising drift on teacher-generated completions. In continual adaptation of a 219M masked diffusion language model, CAGD reduces four-task final held-out loss from 2.927 to 1.114 in one task order and from 2.168 to 0.891 in exact reverse. The same soft targets lower final average loss by 0.055 over hard replay when teacher-generated support is held identical. The direction persists on fresh facts and natural instructions across SMDM and Qwen3. On GSM8K, Qwen adaptation preserves answer-format compliance, but exact-match retention is seed-mixed at 0.6B and worsens at 1.7B. These results support condition-anchored functional preservation as a common design principle across the tested language-generation objectives.

AI.tldr: 提出条件锚定生成蒸馏(CAGD)方法，通过保留少量旧提示、冻结旧模型重建补全与生成状态，并匹配预测分布，实现语言模型持续适应中的功能保持。
AI.motivation: 语言模型持续适应会改变早期任务的输出分布，而保留所有旧提示-答案对既不可取也不现实，需要一种高效的旧行为保持机制。
AI.method: CAGD分离三种角色：条件选择待保护行为、教师生成定位相关状态、软目标规定预测变化方式。对自回归生成用教师rollout实现序列散度的精确链式分解；对掩码扩散模型直接控制教师生成补全上的局部去噪漂移。
AI.result: 219M掩码扩散模型四任务最终held-out损失从2.927降至1.114（一种顺序），反向顺序从2.168降至0.891；相同教师支持下软目标比硬回放平均损失低0.055。结论在SMDM与Qwen3上对新鲜事实和自然指令持续成立。GSM8K上Qwen保持答案格式合规，但精确匹配在0.6B种子混合、1.7B变差。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将条件锚定功能保持作为所测语言生成目标中的通用设计原则。

title: RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway
summary: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation. These findings establish the technical feasibility of an LLM-orchestrated architecture for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy capabilities and information across longitudinal workflows; they do not establish clinical correctness, clinical utility or prospective benefit.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RadOnc-Agent，一个由大语言模型编排的智能体框架，将放疗流程形式化为四个临床阶段、提供26个可调用函数，通过对话界面统一调度异构放疗能力，验证了跨阶段纵向工作流协调的技术可行性。
AI.motivation: 放疗领域的人工智能虽已在单项任务上取得进展，但这些能力分散在不同临床阶段、软件环境和数据模态中，与放疗从治疗决策到随访的纵向连续流程相割裂。需要一种能够跨阶段、跨环境协调异构能力的架构。
AI.method: 构建 RadOnc-Agent：将放疗形式化为四个临床阶段，提供26个可调用函数与对话式接口；由 LLM 控制器将临床意图映射为受模式（schema）约束的调用，保留患者与工作流上下文，并将请求路由至专家服务。通过2600条单函数请求（7800次重复执行）、200个预设跨阶段合成场景（600次执行）及60份去标识患者记录的120个流程实例（360次干净执行）进行评估，并做消融实验。
AI.result: 单函数执行中选中预期函数比例98.79%；脚本化跨阶段工作流完成率96.50%；真实患者工作流执行完成率96.67%。消融显示：移除纵向状态使跨阶段完成率从96.50%降至84.00%；禁用模式与身份校验使后端调度错配率从0%升至95.28%。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了 LLM 编排架构协调异构放疗能力与跨纵向流程信息的技术可行性，但未证明临床正确性、临床实用性或前瞻性获益。

title: Learning When to Refine: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Budgeted Neural-Operator PDE Solvers
summary: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for time-dependent PDEs, but autoregressive deployment creates a refinement-allocation problem: prediction errors vary over space and time, while only a finite number of local corrections can be committed along a trajectory. We formulate this as budgeted adaptive neural-operator solving. A global Fourier neural operator advances the full field, a local operator proposes patch-wise residual corrections, and a set-aware selector chooses where to refine. A macro policy decides when and how much of the remaining refinement budget to spend. We introduce rollout-verified policy improvement (RV-PI), which evaluates feasible refinement counts through actual continuation rollouts of the learned PDE solver, converts long-horizon advantages into conservative policy targets, and accepts an update only when held-out trajectory error improves. On the shallow-water benchmark with a 32-intervention budget, RV-PI achieves a three-seed mean trajectory relative L2 error of 0.6910, improving over immediate-only policy improvement by 5.37% and RandomMacro by 2.41%. On the forcing-driven Brusselator benchmark with a 76-intervention budget, RV-PI attains 0.09954, improving over immediate-only policy improvement by 2.31% and RandomMacro by 5.32%. These results show that, under a fixed refinement budget, the value of a local correction depends on its downstream effect on the autoregressive trajectory, not only on its immediate error reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文将自回归神经算子求解PDE中的局部修正分配问题形式化为预算约束下的自适应求解，提出RV-PI策略改进方法，在两个基准上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 神经算子虽能快速代理时变PDE，但自回归部署时预测误差在时空上不均，而轨迹上可用的局部修正次数有限，因此需要合理分配有限的细化预算。
AI.method: 全局Fourier神经算子推进全场；局部算子提出分块残差修正；集合感知选择器决定细化位置；宏策略决定何时及花费多少剩余预算；提出rollout-verified policy improvement (RV-PI)，通过实际连续rollout评估可行细化数，将长时域优势转为保守策略目标，仅在留出轨迹误差改善时接受更新。
AI.result: 浅水基准（32次干预预算）：RV-PI三种子平均轨迹相对L2误差0.6910，比immediate-only策略改进提升5.37%，比RandomMacro提升2.41%。Brusselator基准（76次干预预算）：RV-PI为0.09954，比immediate-only提升2.31%，比RandomMacro提升5.32%。
AI.conclusion: 在固定细化预算下，局部修正的价值取决于其对自回归轨迹的下游影响，而不仅是即时误差降低。

title: Metric-Based Equilibrium Selection in Noncooperative Differentiable Games
summary: Metric conditioning can change which equilibrium attracts learning dynamics without moving the equilibria of a differentiable game. We study how to use state-dependent symmetric positive-definite (SPD) metrics to select among known equilibria by keeping a designated equilibrium attracting while making a rival unstable. Building on classical results on matrix stability under positive-definite multiplication, we characterize when such destabilization is possible and show how restricting the metric to act independently on each player limits the stability changes that can be achieved at differential Nash equilibria. We then combine a stabilizing metric at the selected equilibrium with a destabilizing metric at the rival through smooth interpolation, yielding a single metric field that preserves every equilibrium of the game while assigning the desired local stability types. We also derive a step-size condition for implementing the method in discrete time. The approach is validated on a continuous-commitment stag hunt and an entropy-regularized iterated prisoner's dilemma, where it selects the desired equilibrium in both settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用状态依赖的SPD度量在不改变博弈均衡的前提下，选择性地使目标均衡吸引、竞争均衡不稳定，并通过平滑插值构造单一度量场，附离散时间步长条件并在两个案例中验证。
AI.motivation: 可微博弈中度量（metric）会影响学习动态收敛到哪个均衡，但不改变均衡本身。作者希望利用这一性质，主动选择已知均衡中的目标均衡。
AI.method: 基于正定乘法下矩阵稳定性的经典结果，刻画何时可对竞争均衡实现去稳定；分析逐玩家独立度量对微分Nash均衡稳定性改变的限制；将目标均衡的稳定度量与竞争均衡的去稳定度量平滑插值为单一度量场，保持所有均衡不变并赋予所需局部稳定性；推导离散时间实现的步长条件。
AI.result: 在连续承诺的stag hunt和熵正则化迭代囚徒困境上验证，两场景均成功选择出期望均衡。
AI.conclusion: 状态依赖SPD度量可作为均衡选择的工具，在不移动均衡的情况下重塑学习动态的局部稳定性，且可离散实现。

title: CheckerBench: Can Long-Horizon Agents Synthesize Static-Analysis Checkers?
summary: Static-analysis checker synthesis requires agents to interpret a defect specification, inspect a repository, implement analyzer-specific logic, and refine the checker through repeated compilation and analysis feedback. Existing coding-agent benchmarks focus on tasks such as patch generation or vulnerability detection and rarely assess whether an agent can develop a working checker in a repository from start to finish. We introduce CheckerBench, an executable benchmark of 300 tasks derived from 297 CVEs across 167 repositories, 85 CWEs, and five language ecosystems. Each task includes vulnerable and fixed revisions, a pinned analysis environment, and a checker scaffold. We further introduce CheckerLab, a common evaluation framework that independently rebuilds submitted checkers and measures vulnerable-fixed diagnostic contrast, patch localization, false positives, and tool use. Across 21 model-harness configurations and three independent repeats per configuration, mean Pass@1 is 32.30%, while the best reaches 45.33%. These results show that reliable, reusable checker development remains challenging for current coding agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 CheckerBench 基准与 CheckerLab 评估框架，用 300 个基于真实 CVE 的任务考察编码智能体能否从头开发可用的静态分析 checker，结果显示当前智能体性能有限（平均 Pass@1 32.30%）。
AI.motivation: 静态分析检查器合成需要智能体解读缺陷规范、审查仓库、实现分析器逻辑并迭代优化，但现有编码智能体基准多聚焦补丁生成或漏洞检测，很少评估能否端到端开发出可工作的检查器。
AI.method: 构建 CheckerBench：300 个任务源自 297 个 CVE，覆盖 167 个仓库、85 个 CWE 和五类语言生态，每个任务含漏洞/修复版本、固定分析环境与检查器脚手架；并推出 CheckerLab 评估框架，独立重建提交的检查器，衡量漏洞与修复版本的诊断对比、补丁定位、误报及工具使用情况。
AI.result: 在 21 种模型-框架配置、每种配置三次独立重复下，平均 Pass@1 为 32.30%，最佳达 45.33%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可靠的、可复用的检查器开发对当前编码智能体仍具挑战性。

title: Learning to Retrieve via Reinforcement Learning in Embedding Space
summary: Dense retrieval models are typically trained with contrastive objectives that learn effective representations but do not directly optimize retrieval metrics or downstream task performance. To address this problem, we introduce RELER (REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval), a reinforcement learning framework that enables existing embedding models to learn to retrieve directly in embedding space and align to task-specific rewards. We train RELER by sampling unit-length query and document embedding actions from von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distributions centered on normalized encoder outputs, scoring the resulting retrieval or downstream outcomes as rewards, and updating the encoder with REINFORCE using a leave-one-out baseline (RLOO). As exploration in the high-dimensional embedding space is prone to sampling noise, we further propose conditional-mean projection (CMP), which projects each sampled embedding onto the low-dimensional subspace spanned by its encoder output and the candidate embeddings it is compared against, reducing noise in the policy gradient while preserving its expectation. We evaluate RELER on BRIGHT, a benchmark with reasoning-intensive queries that remain challenging for existing embedding models. RELER consistently outperforms InfoNCE and LambdaLoss in average nDCG@10 when post-training BGE-M3 and Qwen3-Embedding backbones. We further evaluate downstream utility through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where we adapt only the query encoder while keeping the document index and generator fixed. Across seven QA datasets, jointly optimizing retrieval and answer rewards improves both average retrieval performance and answer quality in RAG.

AI.tldr: 提出RELER，一个用强化学习让嵌入模型直接在嵌入空间学习检索并对齐任务奖励的框架，配合条件均值投影(CMP)降低采样噪声，在BRIGHT和RAG任务上优于InfoNCE与LambdaLoss。
AI.motivation: 传统密集检索模型用对比目标(如InfoNCE)训练，能学到有效表示，但不直接优化检索指标或下游任务性能，存在训练目标与评测目标不一致的问题。
AI.method: 将归一化编码器输出作为中心，从von Mises-Fisher(vMF)分布采样单位长度的查询/文档嵌入动作，以检索或下游结果为奖励，用REINFORCE配leave-one-out基线(RLOO)更新编码器；并提出条件均值投影(CMP)，将采样嵌入投影到由编码器输出与候选嵌入张成的低维子空间，降低高维采样的策略梯度噪声同时保持期望不变。
AI.result: 在BRIGHT(推理密集型查询)上，post-training BGE-M3和Qwen3-Embedding时，平均nDCG@10持续优于InfoNCE和LambdaLoss。在RAG评估中(仅适配查询编码器，固定文档索引和生成器)，跨7个QA数据集，联合优化检索与答案奖励同时提升平均检索性能和答案质量。
AI.conclusion: 用强化学习直接优化检索指标与任务奖励是可行且有效的，CMP能有效缓解高维嵌入空间探索的噪声问题，且该方法可扩展到RAG等下游任务。

title: BoT-Feedback: Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Biomechanical Evidence for Explainable Human Action Feedback
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in visual understanding and multimodal reasoning, yet they remain fundamentally limited in Human Action Feedback Generation. Existing methods infer coaching feedback directly from visual observations, producing generic advice, limited interpretability, and physically implausible hallucinations. In contrast, expert human coaches diagnose performance through explicit biomechanical reasoning over joint kinematics, posture, and body dynamics. We introduce BoT-Feedback, a framework that grounds MLLM reasoning in structured biomechanical evidence. Our key contribution is Biomechanics of Thought (BoT), a four-stage reasoning framework that progressively identifies the action, localises the critical body regions, analyses quantitative biomechanical differences between expert and student performances, and synthesises interpretable coaching feedback. To support this reasoning process, we develop a plug-and-play Biomechanical Data Parser (BDP) that converts videos into structured biomechanical descriptors and an alignment strategy that temporally matches expert and student motions. We further introduce BiomAF, a benchmark containing paired teacher-student videos, 3D skeletons, biomechanical attributes, and expert-coaching annotations. Experiments across twelve open- and closed-source MLLMs demonstrate that grounding reasoning in biomechanical evidence consistently improves feedback quality, interpretability, and robustness while substantially reducing biomechanical hallucinations. BoT-Feedback improves the average expert evaluation score from 2.07 to 2.95 (+40%), enabling compact open-source MLLMs to approach the performance of substantially larger proprietary systems for explainable action feedback generation.

AI.tldr: 提出BoT-Feedback框架，将MLLM推理建立在结构化生物力学证据上（BoT四阶段推理+BDP解析器），把专家评分从2.07提升到2.95（+40%），减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM直接由视觉观测推断教练反馈，导致建议笼统、可解释性差、出现物理上不合理的幻觉。而专家教练依赖对关节运动学、姿态和身体动力学的显式生物力学推理来诊断表现。
AI.method: 核心为Biomechanics of Thought（BoT）四阶段推理：识别动作→定位关键身体区域→分析专家与学生的定量生物力学差异→合成可解释反馈。配套可插拔的Biomechanical Data Parser（BDP）将视频转为结构化生物力学描述符，并提出对齐策略实现专家与学生动作的时间匹配。同时构建BiomAF基准，含成对师生视频、3D骨架、生物力学属性与专家标注。
AI.result: 在12个开源与闭源MLLM上实验表明，基于生物力学证据的推理持续提升反馈质量、可解释性与鲁棒性，并显著减少生物力学幻觉。平均专家评分从2.07升至2.95（+40%），使小型开源MLLM接近大型专有系统水平。
AI.conclusion: 将MLLM推理锚定于结构化生物力学证据，可有效改善可解释动作反馈生成，缩小开源与闭源模型差距，为人类动作反馈生成提供新路径。

title: Metonymic Circuits for Abstract Concept Grounding in Vision Transformers
summary: We study how Vision Transformers ground abstract concepts (e.g., angry) when training data provide limited direct referential evidence. We hypothesize a metonymic grounding mechanism in which abstract predictions are driven by concrete, interpretable anchor concepts (e.g., fire) that bridge visual signals to abstract semantics. By applying Transcoders on CLIP and DINO vision encoders, we recover intermediate features that can be associated with semantic labels for more concrete concepts, and trace their contributions in circuits underlying abstract concept recognition. Experiments on a carefully curated icon dataset reveal structured metonymic circuits, in which perceptual primitives dominate early layers and object-like anchors precede abstract targets. Images containing rendered text instead recruit a distinct perceptual-to-textual route. Causal interventions further validate that metonymic intermediates are functionally involved in grounding abstract concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证Vision Transformers通过"转喻式接地机制"（metonymic grounding）来理解抽象概念，即用可解释的具体锚点概念（如fire）桥接视觉信号与抽象语义（如angry）。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究当训练数据缺乏直接指称证据时，Vision Transformers如何将抽象概念与视觉信号建立联系。
AI.method: 在CLIP与DINO视觉编码器上应用Transcoders，恢复可关联到具体概念语义标签的中间特征，并追踪其在抽象概念识别电路中的贡献；在精心构建的图标数据集上进行实验，并通过因果干预验证。
AI.result: 实验揭示了结构化的转喻电路：感知基元主导早期层，类物体锚点出现在抽象目标之前；含渲染文字的图像则招募独特的"感知到文本"路径。因果干预证实转喻中间量在功能上参与了抽象概念的接地。
AI.conclusion: Vision Transformers通过具体锚点概念实现抽象概念的转喻式接地，该机制得到因果验证。

title: Event-Driven ML Pipeline Orchestration for Manufacturing: An AWS Industry Experience
comment: Accepted in the 14th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Engineering (IC2E 2026). It will be hosted on October 13th-15th, 2026 at Santa Clara, California, USA
summary: We present an industry experience report on three years of operating an event-driven cloud infrastructure for continuous machine learning training in automotive manufacturing. Our system orchestrates GPU-accelerated training of product-specialized model pairs, a physics prediction model and a reinforcement-learning control policy, across multiple plants, coordinating long-running GPU workloads triggered by manufacturing events. The architecture combines Amazon ECS with EC2 GPU capacity providers, SQS-based messaging with dead-letter queues, and an admission-controlled Lambda dispatcher that enforces cluster concurrency limits. A Conductor orchestrator on ECS Fargate initiates dependency-aware retraining chains on a weekly schedule. The entire infrastructure is codified in modular Terraform with multi-account separation. From 40000+ production training jobs we report a 72-78% cost reduction versus always-on GPU infrastructure. A discrete-event simulation confirms that admission control is necessary (naive dispatch loses 65% of jobs) and that queue-draining matches AWS Step Functions latency while eliminating per-job startup overhead. We provide lessons learned and release the simulator and Terraform module skeletons as open-source artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文是汽车制造业中事件驱动云基础设施的工业经验报告，用于持续机器学习训练，通过调度多工厂的GPU训练任务实现显著成本节约。
AI.motivation: 在汽车制造场景下，需要跨多个工厂持续训练产品专用模型对（物理预测模型与强化学习控制策略），而常开GPU基础设施成本高昂，缺乏对长期运行GPU工作负载与制造事件协调的实践经验。
AI.method: 架构结合Amazon ECS与EC2 GPU容量提供者、基于SQS的消息传递与死信队列、以及执行集群并发限制的准入控制Lambda调度器；ECS Fargate上的Conductor编排器按周计划启动依赖感知的重训练链；基础设施以模块化Terraform实现多账户隔离。同时采用离散事件仿真进行评估。
AI.result: 基于40000+生产训练作业，相比常开GPU基础设施实现72-78%成本降低；仿真证实准入控制必不可少（朴素调度丢失65%作业），且队列排空在延迟上与AWS Step Functions相当，同时消除了每作业启动开销。
AI.conclusion: 该事件驱动云基础设施在多年生产实践中验证了成本与效率优势，并提供经验教训，开源发布仿真器与Terraform模块骨架。

title: On the Complexity of Mixed Equilibria in First-Price Auctions with Correlated Priors
summary: We show that computing an approximate mixed Bayes-Nash equilibrium in a discrete first-price auction with correlated priors is PPAD-complete. The key intermediate step in our reduction is the PPAD-completeness of computing an approximate Nash equilibrium in a new normal-form game, the hypergraph discrete first-price auction, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 计算相关先验下离散一价拍卖的近似混合贝叶斯-纳什均衡是 PPAD-完全的。
AI.motivation: 研究离散一价拍卖在相关先验条件下，求解近似混合贝叶斯-纳什均衡的计算复杂度。
AI.method: 通过归约证明，关键中间步骤是证明一类新的标准型博弈——超图离散一价拍卖——的近似纳什均衡计算是 PPAD-完全的。
AI.result: 证明相关先验下离散一价拍卖的近似混合贝叶斯-纳什均衡计算是 PPAD-完全的。
AI.conclusion: 该问题的均衡计算具有 PPAD-完全复杂度，所引入的超图离散一价拍卖博弈可能具有独立研究价值。

title: When Old Facts Return: Re-Reads, Reverts, and the Limits of Temporal Memory
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Ancillary files contain retained aggregate evidence, derived scenario and annotation exports, reference code, and an offline verifier
summary: A memory system can retire an obsolete value and later restore it merely because the same old statement appears again. A re-read of an old source and a genuine revert can produce the same observed sequence of values while requiring opposite current answers. We study this ambiguity on 130 extractor-selected atomic transitions derived from software fixes. In the ordinary transition condition, identity-based temporal memory reaches 98.5% model-judged accuracy with zero observed errors under a literal stale-value proxy. Appending a verbatim re-read of the old statement reduces accuracy to 10.8% and raises the stale-value rate to 88.5%. A guard that refuses to reactivate a previously retired value restores accuracy to 97.7% and reduces that rate to 0.8% in this constructed re-read condition. The guard cannot also recognize a legitimate revert without additional change provenance. Two supporting studies examine exposing retired history to the answer model and supplying current source for changed behavior. An exploratory extraction study over 707 software fixes provides scope context, not a universal coverage estimate. The design implication is to distinguish an observation of a value from evidence that the value changed. Selected inputs, aggregate-only answer records, related-family judges and a post-failure guard evaluation limit the conclusions to the retained experiments.

AI.tldr: 研究记忆系统中"旧值再现"的歧义：观测到旧值与真正回退无法区分。基于130个原子转换实验，普通条件下准确率98.5%，加入逐字重读后降至10.8%；防止"复活旧值"的守卫恢复至97.7%，但无法识别合法回退。结论：需区分"观测到某值"与"该值发生变化的证据"。
AI.motivation: 记忆系统可退休旧值并在同一旧语句再现时重新启用，但"重读旧源"与"真正回退"会产生相同的观测值序列，却需要相反的当前答案，导致时序记忆的歧义。
AI.method: 从软件修复中提取130个原子转换，采用基于身份的时间记忆，比较普通转换条件与"逐字重读旧语句"条件；引入拒绝复活已退休值的守卫；并做两项支持性研究（向答案模型暴露退休历史、提供当前源码）及707个修复的探索性提取研究。
AI.result: 普通条件准确率98.5%、陈旧值率0%；加入重读后准确率10.8%、陈旧值率88.5%；守卫将重读条件恢复至97.7%准确率、0.8%陈旧值率，但无法识别合法回退。探索性提取仅提供范围背景，非普适覆盖估计。
AI.conclusion: 关键在于区分"对某值的观测"与"该值已改变的证据"。缺少变更来源信息时，守卫可抑制误复活却无法识别合法回退。受限于选定输入、聚合答案记录、相关族判定器及事后守卫评估，结论仅适用于所保留实验。

title: Token-Budgeted Escalation for Financial Document QA: Cost Is Predictable, Benefit Is the Bottleneck
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and aggregate artifacts: https://github.com/junru-zhu/token-budgeted-escalation-financial-qa
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems can route difficult queries to deeper context, but batch deployments must allocate a shared token budget across calls whose costs vary by query. We formulate selective escalation as finite-batch allocation for financial document question answering. Each of 150 FinanceBench questions first receives a top-1 retrieval answer. Predictors estimate the adjudication-quality gain and token cost of an optional top-5 call, and the allocator prioritizes calls by predicted gain per token. At the nominal 10% budget, gain-per-token allocation improves adjudication quality over gain-only ranking by 0.034 (95% document-bootstrap CI [0.001, 0.072]) while using 46.6% fewer total tokens than one-pass top-5 retrieval. Additional-call cost is accurately predictable (R-squared 0.93), whereas beneficial escalation remains difficult to rank (AUROC 0.60). These results show that heterogeneous cost is actionable under tight constraints, while progress across the full budget frontier depends on stronger query-specific benefit estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文将"选择性升级"建模为有限批量token分配问题，在FinanceBench上按预测增益/单位token分配top-5调用，10%预算下优于仅按增益排序并显著节省token。
AI.motivation: 批量RAG部署需在成本随查询变化的多次调用间共享token预算，如何高效分配有限预算尚不清楚。
AI.method: 150个FinanceBench问题先做top-1检索回答；用预测器估计可选top-5调用的裁决质量增益与token成本，分配器按预测增益/单位token排序优先调用。
AI.result: 10%预算下，增益/单位token分配比仅按增益排序提升裁决质量0.034（95%文档自助CI [0.001, 0.072]），总token比一次性top-5减少46.6%；额外调用成本可准确预测（R²=0.93），但有益升级难排序（AUROC 0.60）。
AI.conclusion: 紧约束下异质成本可被有效利用；要推进整个预算前沿，需更强的查询级收益估计。

title: Event Cameras for Melt-Pool Monitoring in Additive Manufacturing: A Benchmark and a Cross-Machine Transfer Analysis
summary: Melt-pool monitoring is central to qualifying metal additive manufacturing (AM), yet no public event-camera benchmark exists for this domain. Event cameras report per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond timing instead of reading full frames, giving the temporal resolution AM transients demand at a fraction of the data rate. We present SynAM-E (Synthetic AM Events), the first public multi-source simulated event-camera benchmark for metal-AM melt-pool monitoring: 85 physics-calibrated event shards from 15 sources across 8 institutions, with public baselines and fixed cross-machine evaluation splits. On a single-machine case study, event-spatial monitoring matches dense-frame accuracy (0.874 versus 0.863 macro-F1), and the absolute intensity that events discard adds only +0.006 under fusion. On the NIST Additive Manufacturing Metrology Testbed (AMMT) build, a near-sensor event-rate counter recovers a raw-frame-confirmed 528.7 Hz intensity oscillation at ~380 times less sensor readout than the frame stream requires. A compact 93 k-parameter spiking model runs at 15 times lower modeled inference energy for a 0.073 macro-F1 cost. Every cross-source task includes a built-in trust test against camera identity shortcuts: process-type classification passes while material classification remains confounded by camera band, a corpus-structural limitation the release documents and the trust test exposes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SynAM-E，首个公开的金属增材制造熔池监测事件相机仿真基准，包含15个来源、85个事件分片及基线，并展示事件相机在精度、数据率与能耗上的优势。
AI.motivation: 金属增材制造熔池监测缺乏公开的事件相机基准，而事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率且数据率低，适合捕捉AM瞬态过程。
AI.method: 构建SynAM-E基准：85个物理校准事件分片，来自8家机构15个来源，提供公开基线与固定跨机器评估划分；并进行单机案例、NIST AMMT实验及脉冲模型评估，加入针对相机身份捷径的信任测试。
AI.result: 事件空间监测与密集帧精度相当（macro-F1 0.874 vs 0.863）；融合绝对强度仅提升+0.006；近传感器事件率计数器以约380倍更低读出恢复528.7 Hz强度振荡；93k参数脉冲模型推断能耗低15倍，macro-F1仅降0.073；过程类型分类通过信任测试，材料分类受相机波段混淆。
AI.conclusion: SynAM-E为金属AM熔池事件相机监测提供首个公开基准，验证了事件方法在精度、数据率和能耗上的潜力，同时揭示了相机波段导致材料分类混淆的结构性局限。

title: Verdicts Without Annotated Evidence: Rejection Sampling or Label-Only Post-Training for Evidence Recovery?
summary: In many review workflows the verdict is the only thing retained. The passages behind it are not marked, because that annotation costs far more than recording the decision. We measure how much of that evidence a small language model can recover when it is post-trained on the verdicts alone, with no human evidence labels at any stage. On ContractNLI the human evidence spans are held out until evaluation. Matching the recorded verdict and agreeing with those spans are not the same thing: across six systems the two scores are only weakly related and rank the systems differently, so accuracy is a poor guide when the citations have to be reviewable. Label-only training on the bare verdict reaches accuracy 0.896 and span F1 0.564. Rejection sampling, which keeps a generated trace only when its verdict matches the record and then picks one by an automatic source-grounding score, reaches 0.797 and 0.556, against 0.747 and 0.493 before training. Verbatim citation rises from 0.597 to 0.729 under label-only training and to 0.701 under rejection sampling. One seed on one corpus cannot say which method is better, but both improve the evidence without anyone annotating it.

AI.tldr: 研究在仅有判决（verdict）标签、无人工证据标注的情况下，小模型能否从判决中恢复证据跨度（evidence spans），并比较纯标签训练与拒绝采样两种方法。
AI.motivation: 许多审查流程只保留判决，背后的证据段落未被标注，因为标注成本远高于记录决策。作者希望衡量：仅用判决进行后训练，小模型能恢复多少证据。
AI.method: 在ContractNLI上将人工证据跨度留作评测。比较两种方法：(1) 纯标签训练（label-only，直接用裸判决训练）；(2) 拒绝采样（保留判决与记录一致的生成轨迹，再用自动来源定位分数挑选）。全程无人工证据标签。
AI.result: 纯标签训练达到准确率0.896、跨度F1 0.564；拒绝采样达0.797与0.556（训练前为0.747与0.493）。逐字引用率在纯标签训练下从0.597升至0.729，拒绝采样下升至0.701。六个系统中判决匹配与跨度一致仅弱相关且排序不同。
AI.conclusion: 单独一个语料、一个种子无法断定哪种方法更优，但两种方法都能在无人标注证据的情况下改善证据质量；准确率在需要可审查引用时是糟糕的指引。

title: Principles that Guide, Actions that Inform: Agent Evolution via Knowledge Abstraction
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interactive environments, yet their ability to continually evolve from experience remains limited. Although fine-tuning enables adaptation, its dependence on parameter access and high computational costs restrict its flexibility, especially for large-scale and closed-source LLMs. External memory offers an alternative by allowing agents to accumulate experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing methods mainly focus on experience representation and organization, while the acquired knowledge remains tightly coupled with specific tasks and contexts, limiting generalization. A key challenge is how to transform concrete interactions into abstract and reusable knowledge that guides future decisions beyond individual experiences.
  To address this challenge, we propose SAGA (\underline{\textbf{S}}elf-evolving \underline{\textbf{A}}gents through Experience-\underline{\textbf{G}}rounded \underline{\textbf{A}}bstraction), a framework for experience-grounded knowledge abstraction and utilization in LLM agents. SAGA progressively transforms interaction trajectories into episodic descriptions, reusable procedures, and principles with explicit applicability conditions, while maintaining links to execution evidence. Retrieved principles are instantiated into task-specific guidance and used to refine candidate actions through corrective feedback and resampling. This creates an execution--abstraction feedback loop, where accumulated knowledge guides future interactions and new experiences continuously update hierarchical memory. Experiments on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld demonstrate improved task performance, with ablation studies highlighting the importance of contextual instantiation and action regulation for leveraging principle-level knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGA框架，将LLM智能体的交互经验逐步抽象为情景描述、可复用流程和带适用条件的原则，通过执行-抽象反馈循环提升泛化能力，在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld上验证有效。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体难以从经验中持续进化：微调依赖参数访问且计算成本高，尤其不适合大规模和闭源模型；外部记忆虽可避免改参数，但现有方法侧重经验表示与组织，学到的知识与特定任务和情境紧耦合，难以泛化。核心挑战是如何将具体交互转化为抽象、可复用的知识以指导未来决策。
AI.method: SAGA框架渐进地将交互轨迹转化为（1）情景描述、（2）可复用流程、（3）带明确适用条件的原则，并保留与执行证据的链接。检索到的原则被实例化为任务特定指导，并通过纠正性反馈与重采样来精炼候选动作。由此形成执行-抽象反馈循环：积累的知识指导未来交互，新经验持续更新分层记忆。
AI.result: 在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld上的实验表明任务性能得到提升；消融研究凸显了上下文实例化和动作调控对利用原则级知识的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 通过经验落地的分层抽象与执行反馈循环，智能体可在不修改模型参数的情况下积累可复用知识并提升泛化与任务表现。

title: Learning from Unreliable Trajectories: Adversarially-Robust Federated Q-Learning
summary: We study federated reinforcement learning in which multiple agents interact with a common Markov decision process and communicate through a central server to collaboratively learn the optimal state-action value function. Our goal is to understand whether the sample-efficiency benefits of collaboration can be retained when a fraction of the agents behave adversarially and transmit arbitrarily corrupted information. To address this problem, we introduce Robust Async-Fed-Q, an epoch-based federated learning algorithm that combines variance-reduced estimation of the Bellman optimality operator at the agents with robust aggregation at the server. We establish high-probability finite-time guarantees showing that the proposed method preserves the statistical gains of collaboration among the honest agents while tolerating adversarial corruption. In particular, the effect of the adversarial agents decreases as the amount of data collected by each honest agent grows and eventually vanishes in the infinite-sample limit. We complement these guarantees with information-theoretic lower bounds that characterize the unavoidable statistical cost of adversarial corruption, leading to the first nearly matching upper and lower bounds for adversarially robust federated reinforcement learning. We further extend our framework to accommodate single-trajectory Markovian sampling and heterogeneous partial coverage, where different agents may explore different regions of the state-action space and learning relies on their collective coverage. Finally, our epoch-based design substantially improves the best known communication complexity for federated Q-learning under asynchronous sampling.

AI.tldr: 研究对抗性代理下的联邦强化学习，提出 Robust Async-Fed-Q 算法，兼具高效样本利用与鲁棒性，并给出近乎匹配的上界与下界。
AI.motivation: 在联邦强化学习中，部分代理可能发送被任意污染的信息，需要理解协作的样本效率收益能否在对抗环境下保持。
AI.method: 提出基于 epoch 的 Robust Async-Fed-Q：代理端使用方差缩减的 Bellman 最优算子估计，服务器端进行鲁棒聚合；并扩展至单轨迹马尔可夫采样与异构部分覆盖。
AI.result: 给出高概率有限时间保证，证明保留诚实代理的统计增益且对抗影响随每代理数据增加而消失；提供信息论下界，首次获得近乎匹配的上界与下界；显著改进了异步采样下联邦 Q-learning 的通信复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为对抗鲁棒联邦强化学习建立了首个近乎最优的统计与通信复杂度理论框架。

title: Rewarding Informed Voting in PoS Governance
summary: We study reward design for delegated representatives who acquire costly information and vote on a binary governance proposal. Effort improves both private information and delegated voting weight. We show that no payment rule can make sincere voting strictly optimal at every positive effort profile under a non-neutral prior, while fixed budgets limit accuracy in large symmetric committees. We then compare proportional sharing with a conditional rule that rewards only members of a sufficiently large winning coalition. Unlike proportional sharing, which supports sincere voting only through indifference, the conditional rule makes sincere voting strictly optimal at symmetric positive effort profiles. It supports sincere equilibria with the same effort as proportional sharing and, under suitable reward-cost conditions, with strictly higher effort and decision accuracy. Insincere equilibria may nevertheless coexist.

AI.tldr: 研究委托代表在二元治理中获取信息并投票的奖励设计，比较比例分享与条件奖励规则的激励效果。
AI.motivation: 代表需付出成本获取信息并投票，努力既提高私人信息也提高委托投票权重，如何设计奖励以激励真实投票和更高努力尚不清晰。
AI.method: 理论建模委托代表的信息获取与投票，分析无支付规则可行性，并比较比例分享与仅奖励足够大获胜联盟成员的条件规则。
AI.result: 非中性先验下，任何支付规则都无法在每个正努力水平使真诚投票严格最优；固定预算限制大对称委员会准确性。条件规则在对称正努力下使真诚投票严格最优，可与比例分享同等努力，且在合适条件下努力和决策准确性更高，但可能共存不真诚均衡。
AI.conclusion: 条件奖励规则在激励真诚投票和提升努力、准确性方面优于比例分享，但需注意不真诚均衡共存的可能性。

title: Acquiring and Verifying Repository Norms for Coding Agents
summary: Changes produced by coding agents can pass functional tests while leaving repository contribution requirements unmet. Following repository-specific norms requires identifying guidance dispersed across repository sources and interpreting its conditions and exceptions. Retrieval and documentation approaches supply general context, but agents must still determine which norms apply. We introduce RepoNorm to acquire explicit and implicit repository norms independently of coding tasks. It checks norm content and applicability using repository evidence, consults Git history when needed, and delivers norm packages to existing coding agents. Our evaluation uses three coding models and 121 tasks from RepoNormBench. Against the baseline with no additional generated guidance (Raw), relative improvements are 7.42-10.77% for Overall Norm Compliance Rate (NCR), 31.64-45.44% for Contribution NCR, and 11.34-17.69% for Prompt-omitted NCR. All three coding models also obtain higher values on these NCR measures with RepoNorm than with CodeWiki documentation. Functional success rates show observed gains of 5.79-9.09 percentage points over Raw; the paired comparisons do not reach the significance threshold. Sampled precision is 86% with RepoNorm's default configuration.

AI.tldr: 提出RepoNorm，独立于编码任务获取仓库显式与隐式规范，通过仓库证据校验规范内容与适用性，并接入现有编码智能体。在RepoNormBench上评测。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体生成的改动可通过功能测试，却未满足仓库贡献要求。遵循仓库特定规范需识别分散于仓库各处的指导并理解其条件与例外，现有检索与文档方法只提供通用背景，无法判断哪些规范适用。
AI.method: RepoNorm独立于编码任务获取显式与隐式仓库规范；用仓库证据检查规范内容与适用性，必要时查询Git历史，并向现有编码智能体交付规范包。
AI.result: 三种编码模型、121个任务上评测：相较无额外生成指导的Raw基线，总体NCR提升7.42-10.77%，贡献NCR提升31.64-45.44%，Prompt省略NCR提升11.34-17.69%；三项NCR均优于CodeWiki文档。功能成功率较Raw提升5.79-9.09个百分点，但配对比较未达显著水平。默认配置采样精度86%。
AI.conclusion: RepoNorm能有效提升仓库规范遵循度，且优于文档方法，但功能成功率提升尚不显著。

title: Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation
comment: 8 pages. Published in WI-IAT 2025. Best Student Paper Award
summary: In this work, we propose a novel recommendation model, CLARER (Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation) that integrates aspect features learned from textual reviews with rating information to improve the accuracy and explainability of recommendations. Our proposed framework learns user and item representations by combining rating-based features and aspect-based features from reviews. Specifically, rating-based features are learned through a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) model, while aspect-specific review representations are learned using a transformer encoder to capture the semantic information and contrastive learning to better distinguish user preferences. To provide explanations, we train a transformer decoder, using the final representations of users and items from both rating and aspect-based features as context. Experimental results in three benchmark data sets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance compared to baseline methods in both recommendation (accuracy) and explanation generation.

AI.tldr: 提出CLARER模型，融合评分与评论方面特征，结合对比学习提升推荐准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐模型需同时提升准确性与可解释性，需有效整合评分信息与评论中的方面特征。
AI.method: 用MLP学习评分特征，用Transformer编码器结合对比学习学习方面级评论表示，并训练Transformer解码器以用户与物品的最终表示为上下文生成解释。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，推荐准确率与解释生成均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CLARER通过融合评分与方面特征及对比学习，实现了推荐准确性与可解释性的共同提升。

title: Visual-Invariance-Augmented Feature Optimal Alignment for Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Closed-Source MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain vulnerable to transferable adversarial examples, especially in black-box settings where only open-source surrogate models are accessible. Existing targeted transfer attacks mainly align adversarial and target samples using global image-level features, such as encoder [CLS] embeddings. However, such coarse alignment insufficiently exploits patch-level visual structures, limiting transferability across heterogeneous closed-source MLLMs. We propose IAU-FOA, a visual-invariance-augmented feature optimal alignment attack with adaptive unbalanced transport, to improve targeted transferability against closed-source MLLMs. IAU-FOA aligns adversarial and target samples at both global and local levels: a cosine-based objective narrows their global semantic gap, while patch tokens are clustered into compact local patterns and matched through optimal transport for fine-grained feature alignment. Balanced optimal transport enforces fixed marginal masses even for local clusters without reliable counterparts, potentially introducing misleading alignment gradients. We therefore introduce confidence-adaptive unbalanced transport to relax these constraints for weakly matched clusters, aiming to reduce unreliable local alignment and improve adversarial transferability. We further study the effect of input transformations and propose visual-invariance augmentation, which applies bidirectional pixel-intensity rescaling and per-channel white-balance adjustment to simulate exposure, contrast, illumination, and color-temperature variations. This strategy encourages adversarial perturbations to generalize across different visual encoders. Extensive experiments on open-source and closed-source MLLMs show that IAU-FOA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transferable attack methods. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaxiaojunQAQ/IAU-FOA.

AI.tldr: 提出 IAU-FOA，通过全局-局部特征最优对齐与自适应非平衡传输，提升对闭源 MLLM 的定向迁移攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有定向迁移攻击仅用全局图像级特征（如 CLS 嵌入）对齐对抗样本与目标样本，忽略 patch 级视觉结构，泛化到异构闭源 MLLM 的能力不足。
AI.method: IAU-FOA 在全局与局部两个层面进行对齐：用余弦目标缩小全局语义差距；将 patch token 聚成紧凑局部模式，通过最优传输做细粒度匹配。引入置信度自适应非平衡传输，对弱匹配簇放松固定边缘约束以减少不可靠梯度。并提出视觉不变性增强，采用双向像素强度缩放与逐通道白平衡调整模拟曝光、对比度、光照和色温变化。
AI.result: 在开源与闭源 MLLM 上的大量实验表明，IAU-FOA 持续优于当前最先进的迁移攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: 全局-局部联合对齐结合自适应非平衡传输与视觉不变性增强，能有效提升对抗样本跨异构闭源 MLLM 的定向迁移性。

title: WavePrune: One period is often enough for RoPE
summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) encodes token positions by rotating each two-dimensional channel of the query and key vectors at a channel-specific frequency, making the attention logits invariant to a common shift of positions. However, this rotation is periodic, and it leads to position aliasing where relative positions separated by a full rotation period become hard to tell apart. To address this, we propose WavePrune, which restricts each channel to its first rotation period. We show that it removes the distractions in attention maps created by position aliasing and improves overall long-context performance. Specifically, WavePrune raises the HELMET score on four of five models we test without any extra tuning (e.g., 35.7 -> 40.0 on Qwen3-8B). When pretraining models from scratch, WavePrune also achieves lower validation loss at extrapolated lengths than pretraining without it. Because WavePrune restricts each channel to a sliding window, it induces a fine-grained sparsity that our hardware-aligned CUDA kernels exploit for 1.15x prefill and 1.24x decoding speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 32K context. Together, these results show that RoPE's periodic structure, widely regarded as essential, is largely redundant beyond the first rotation period.

AI.tldr: RoPE的周期性导致位置混叠，WavePrune通过限制每个通道到第一个旋转周期来消除混叠，提升长上下文性能并加速推理。
AI.motivation: RoPE通过旋转位置编码实现位置表示，但其旋转具有周期性，导致相对位置相隔一个完整旋转周期后难以区分（位置混叠），从而在注意力图中产生干扰。
AI.method: 提出WavePrune，将每个通道限制在其第一个旋转周期内，形成滑动窗口，由此产生细粒度稀疏性，并设计硬件对齐的CUDA内核加以利用。
AI.result: 在5个模型中的4个上无需额外调优即提升HELMET分数（Qwen3-8B：35.7→40.0）；从头预训练时外推长度上验证损失更低；32K上下文下比FlashAttention-2实现1.15倍prefill和1.24倍解码加速。
AI.conclusion: RoPE的周期性结构（通常被认为至关重要）在第一个旋转周期之后在很大程度上是冗余的。

title: AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems
summary: Traditional data pipelines are notoriously brittle, often failing due to upstream schema drift, API contract changes, or website DOM modifications. Present observability tools only raise alerts but for human engineers, resulting in a high Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and operational fatigue. In this paper we propose AegisFlow (Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation), a novel agentic framework that closes the loop between detection and resolution. AegisFlow uses a Watchdog agent to collect runtime telemetry and has a Repair agent to automatically create, test and deploy code patches based on Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework presents the non-intrusive execution model called Parallel Shadow Patching, a non-intrusive execution model based on the Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, Knowledge (MAPE-K) loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments. Through experimental testing, we have evaluated AegisFlow across five common failure scenarios, and see 98.1 percent improvement in MTTR (from an average of 170 minutes per patch to 3.2 minutes) and a patch success rate of 92 percent . In particular, the system is successful in dealing with changes in the JSON schema (96 percent ) and punctuation drift (98 percent ), and is least successful in Shadow DOM cases (85 percent ). AegisFlow frees up about 98 percent of data engineering on-call time from firefighting and reallocates it towards innovation. The framework is deployment agnostic consisting of a system that can be deployed in a plugin fashion into an existing pipeline orchestration system with minimal uplift to the existing system.

AI.tldr: AegisFlow 是一个基于 LLM 的智能体框架，通过 Watchdog 与 Repair 智能体及并行影子补丁（PSP）实现自愈数据管道，将 MTTR 从 170 分钟降至 3.2 分钟，补丁成功率 92%。
AI.motivation: 传统数据管道脆弱，易因上游 schema 漂移、API 契约变化或网页 DOM 修改而失败；现有可观测性工具仅能告警交由人工处理，导致 MTTR 高、运维疲劳。
AI.method: AegisFlow 采用 Watchdog 智能体收集运行时遥测，Repair 智能体基于 LLM 自动生成、测试并部署代码补丁；核心为“并行影子补丁”（Parallel Shadow Patching），一种基于 MAPE-K 循环的非侵入式执行模型，在数字孪生环境中生成并验证补丁。
AI.result: 在五类常见故障场景中，MTTR 改善 98.1%（从平均 170 分钟/补丁降至 3.2 分钟），补丁成功率 92%；JSON schema 变化 96%、标点漂移 98% 表现最佳，Shadow DOM 最低为 85%。
AI.conclusion: AegisFlow 释放约 98% 数据工程 on-call 时间用于创新，且部署无关，可作为插件式组件集成到现有管道编排系统，改动成本低。

title: AttSVD:Prompt-Adaptive Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Attention-Guided SVD
summary: The key-value (KV) cache of autoregressive transformers grows linearly with context length and dominates memory at long context. Most training-free remedies evict low-importance tokens, an irreversible choice along the sequence axis. We instead keep every token and store it more cheaply along the "feature" axis. We therefore propose AttSVD, a new "interpretable" low-rank compression whose basis is derived from each prompt's own attention geometry: an online, per-prompt truncated SVD that keeps only the directions attention actually reads, cutting persistent per-head KV memory in proportion to the retained rank. We propose two decode-time caching strategies, accumulating and streaming, for short and long generation regimes. Furthermore, we propose two refinements that make compression adaptive. A per-matrix energy rule sizes the logit space and the attention mass independently. An attention-aware basis truncates only in the spaces attention actually reads, preserving both the attention logits and the attention output. The same factors also provide free, per-head interpretability insights into the effective rank and the geometry attention consumes. Across multiple models, on both an agentic benchmark and the full LongBench suite AttSVD stays on par with the dense cache while using up to 50% of the KV-cache memory.

AI.tldr: AttSVD提出一种沿特征轴的低秩KV缓存压缩方法，基于每个prompt自身的注意力几何进行在线截断SVD，保留注意力真正读取的方向，实现记忆减半且性能不降。
AI.motivation: 自回归Transformer的KV缓存随上下文线性增长并主导长上下文内存。现有免训练方案多沿序列轴不可逆地逐出低重要度token。
AI.method: 不丢弃token，而是沿特征轴廉价存储。AttSVD将每个head的KV基从该prompt的注意力几何导出，做在线逐prompt截断SVD，仅保留注意力读取的方向。提出accumulating与streaming两种解码时缓存策略。并引入两项自适应改进：per-matrix能量规则分别设定logit空间与注意力质量，注意力感知基截断仅作用于注意力读取空间以保留logits与输出。
AI.result: 在多个模型、agentic基准与完整LongBench上，AttSVD在仅用最多50% KV缓存内存时与dense cache性能持平，并附带每head有效秩与注意力几何的可解释性洞察。
AI.conclusion: 沿特征轴的低秩压缩为长上下文KV缓存提供免训练、可解释且内存高效的替代方案。

title: Online Fair Division under Eligibility Constraints
summary:
We study fair division of indivisible items under eligibility constraints: each item may be assigned only to a subset of eligible agents. This model coincides with restricted assignment in scheduling, with agents as machines and items as jobs, and captures settings where work or resources must be split among parties with different capabilities. Eligibility makes the usual fairness benchmarks inadequate, as agents should not be measured against items they could never receive. We therefore use eligibility-aware versions of proportionality and envy-freeness, where an agent's proportional share splits each item equally among its eligible agents, and envy comparisons discount items the agents are not eligible for.
  Our main finding is a sharp chore--goods separation for proportionality. We focus on identical valuations: under arbitrary valuations, no online algorithm can guarantee even an $o(m)$-approximation for chores. For chores, Prop1 is achievable offline, whereas exact proportionality and proportionality up to any item are not. For online chores, the optimal approximation factor for Prop1 for deterministic algorithms is $Θ(\sqrt m)$, with the lower bound holding even for unit-size jobs. For goods, Prop1 is again achievable offline, but the tight online bound drops to $Θ(\log m)$.
  For envy-based fairness, the picture is different. Goods and chores are equivalent under eligibility-aware envy notions, while the choice of notion is decisive. Strong EF1 may fail to exist even offline and cannot be approximated online. In contrast, weak EF1 can be maintained online, while weak EFX separates offline from online. Together, these results give a systematic study of online proportional and envy-based fairness in restricted assignment and show which fairness guarantees remain achievable under eligibility constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究资格约束下不可分物品的公平分配，系统刻画了在线/离线比例公平与嫉妒公平的可达性，并揭示了chore与goods之间的显著分离。
AI.motivation: 每个物品只能分给部分有资格的agent，类似调度中的受限分配；传统公平基准不适用，因为agent不应与永远无法获得的物品比较，因此需采用资格感知的公平概念。
AI.method: 采用资格感知的比例份额（物品在合格agent间平分）与嫉妒比较（忽略不合格物品）；聚焦相同估值，分析Prop1、精确比例、比例至任意物品及多种EF/EFX（强/弱EF1、弱EFX）在在线与离线下的近似界。
AI.result: 比例公平呈现chore-goods分离：chore离线可实现Prop1，精确比例与比例至任意物品不可行；在线确定性Prop1最优界为Θ(√m)，goods为Θ(log m)。嫉妒公平中goods与chore等价，但概念选择关键：强EF1可能离线不存在且在线不可近似；弱EF1可在线维持，弱EFX则离线与在线分离。
AI.conclusion: 论文对受限分配中的在线比例公平与嫉妒公平给出系统研究，明确了资格约束下哪些公平保证仍可实现。

title: ES-Trace: Auditing Ethical-Sourcing Disclosure of Code Generation Models Beyond Model Cards
summary: Code generation models have been increasingly used in software development, but their development raises ethical-sourcing concerns involving intellectual property, privacy, fairness, labour practices, and environmental impact. Although prior work has defined ethical-sourcing criteria for code generation, it remains unclear how much evidence existing models disclose and where that evidence can be found. We introduce ES-Trace, a framework for ethical-sourcing disclosure audits that traces disclosed evidence beyond model cards using the Model Documentation Traceability Graph (MDTG), which represents relationships among models, versions, and documentation artifacts. We apply ES-Trace to 26 models from 10 publishers across 77 documents and 20 ES-CodeGen aspects. Model-card-only auditing yields a mean score of 1.77/5, while resolving the declared references increases it to 2.82/5, with most of the increase arising from documents that the publisher declares in structured metadata. The key findings of our study include: (1) social and labour-related aspects remain poorly documented, even when expanding the audit to the full documentation scope, (2) resolving documentation references substantially increases observed disclosure, raising the mean score from 1.77/5 to 2.82/5, (3) model-card-only audits can mischaracterize release-level disclosure changes, and (4) documentation mismatches can associate evidence with the wrong model or version, highlighting the need for explicit model--version binding and consistency across documentation artifacts. Our study calls for reference-aware ethical-sourcing disclosure audits, explicit model--version binding and consistency across documentation artifacts, and stronger documentation of currently underreported social and labour-related aspects.

AI.tldr: 提出ES-Trace框架，通过文档溯源图审计代码生成模型的伦理披露，发现仅看模型卡会严重低估披露程度。
AI.motivation: 代码生成模型的伦理来源问题（知识产权、隐私、公平、劳工、环境）日益重要，但现有模型披露的证据量和位置不明。
AI.method: ES-Trace框架，基于模型文档溯源图（MDTG）追踪模型卡之外的披露证据，覆盖模型、版本与文档间关系；应用于10家发布者的26个模型、77份文档、20个伦理方面。
AI.result: 仅模型卡审计均分1.77/5；解析声明引用后升至2.82/5，主要来自结构化元数据声明文档；社会与劳工方面仍记录不足；模型卡审计会误判发布级披露变化；文档错配导致证据关联错误模型或版本。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁采用引用感知的伦理披露审计、显式模型-版本绑定与文档一致性，并加强社会及劳工方面的记录。

title: From Delivery to Stateful Exploration: Rethinking the Index for Agentic Search
summary: Recent advances in agentic search have given large language model (LLM) agents finer control over corpus exploration. However, search interfaces often return matching passages even when feedback about the candidate set would suffice for the next decision, coupling candidate refinement with source-text exposure. We propose IndexAct, an interface for Index-Native Corpus Interaction that separates candidate-set refinement from text inspection. Agents construct and manipulate persistent candidate sets through lexical conditions and set operations over an inverted index, receiving reusable state references and statistics such as candidate counts rather than matching passages. This feedback guides further refinement, while separately requested passages provide new clues or evidence that can inform subsequent operations on retained candidate sets. Experiments on five benchmarks spanning agentic search and multi-hop question answering show that IndexAct outperforms the evaluated baselines on each benchmark. On BrowseComp-Plus, it also achieves higher evidence coverage with a smaller average live context than terminal-based corpus interfaces, and maintains answer accuracy as the corpus expands. Further analyses suggest that informative refinement feedback and state reuse support continued evidence discovery, while shorter contexts or fewer search steps alone do not ensure better performance.

AI.tldr: IndexAct提出一种索引原生语料交互接口，将候选集精炼与文本检查解耦，通过倒排索引上的词法条件与集合操作管理持久候选集，仅返回状态引用与统计信息指导精炼，按需再请求文本。在五个基准上均优于基线，并在BrowseComp-Plus上以更小上下文获得更高证据覆盖，随语料扩展保持稳定准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体搜索接口在候选集精炼阶段就返回匹配段落，将候选集筛选与源文本暴露耦合，导致信息冗余或过早暴露文本，不利于高效探索。
AI.method: 提出IndexAct接口，将候选集精炼与文本检查分离。智能体在倒排索引上通过词法条件和集合操作构建、操作持久化候选集，获得可复用状态引用和候选数量等统计反馈；文本仅在单独请求时提供，用于获取新线索或证据。
AI.result: 在涵盖智能体搜索与多跳问答的五个基准上均优于所评估基线；在BrowseComp-Plus上以更小平均活跃上下文实现更高证据覆盖率，并随语料扩大保持答案准确率。分析表明，有效的精炼反馈与状态复用支持持续证据发现，而单纯缩短上下文或减少搜索步数未必提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 将候选集精炼反馈与文本检查分离、并支持状态复用，是提升智能体搜索效率与扩展性的关键；简洁上下文本身并非性能提升的充分条件。

title: Hierarchy-GBP: Accelerating Factor Graph Inference via Abstraction and Recovery
summary: Gaussian Belief Propagation (GBP) is a distributed inference algorithm that passes messages in graphical models, making it attractive for scalable spatial intelligence. However, we find GBP most effective locally: it rapidly smooths message errors that vary sharply between neighbor variables, but corrects global errors across distant graph regions incrementally through long-range message propagations. We propose Hierarchy-GBP (H-GBP), an iterative, two-stage framework that accelerates GBP by first solving these global errors with a coarse graph approximation (abstraction) and projecting the results back to the original graph (recovery), then refining the remaining local errors with GBP. We prove H-GBP convergence to the optimum by deriving the combined matrix operator of our abstraction and recovery steps and analyzing its spectral radius. Experiments on linear sparse graphs show that H-GBP converges fundamentally faster than standard GBP. Moreover, we validate H-GBP on two important spatial problems: Pose Graph Optimization (PGO) and Bundle Adjustment (BA). H-GBP markedly accelerates large-scale PGO and achieves state-of-the-art runtime across all tested BA scales.

AI.tldr: 论文提出H-GBP，通过粗图抽象与投影（recovery）先解决全局误差，再用GBP细化局部误差，从而加速Gaussian Belief Propagation收敛。
AI.motivation: GBP虽是分布式推理算法、适合可扩展空间智能，但仅局部高效：能快速平滑相邻变量间的尖锐消息误差，却需通过长程传播逐步修正远距离区域间的全局误差。
AI.method: 提出H-GBP，一种迭代两阶段框架：先用粗图近似（abstraction）求解全局误差并投影回原图（recovery），再用GBP精修剩余局部误差；通过推导抽象与恢复步骤的组合矩阵算子并分析其谱半径来证明收敛性。
AI.result: 在线性稀疏图上，H-GBP收敛速度从根本上快于标准GBP；在PGO上显著加速大规模问题，在所有测试BA尺度上达到SOTA运行时间。
AI.conclusion: H-GBP通过层次化处理全局与局部误差，理论证明收敛到最优，并在PGO和BA等空间问题上验证了显著加速效果。

title: Calibrated Answers About Randomized Trials From a 4-Billion-Parameter Open Model: A Registered Test and a License-Clean Release
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Code, results files and the paper's sources: https://github.com/johann-e-li/fiorillo. Model: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10722. Registration: https://osf.io/kaxmn/
summary: Fiorillo v0.5 is an open model that answers typed questions with a probability for each answer. Its main specialist reads a randomized trial's article, cut to 6,144 tokens, and answers whether an intervention significantly increased, significantly decreased or did not significantly change an outcome against a comparator (Evidence Inference 2.0, EI). It is Qwen3-4B-Base with low-rank adapters and a decision head, fine-tuned for EI only on the 1,431 of 2,657 training articles whose own license allows reuse. Four criteria registered on the Open Science Framework before this version's test predictions decided its release, the second bar judged on EI's test split, whose labels are public. On that split (1,218 prompts in 333 articles), the expected calibration error was 0.0168 against a limit of 0.05; log loss was below the prior's by 0.8603 (95 percent interval 0.8104 to 0.9078) and below that of Gemma 4 31B-it, reading the same input, by 0.1829 (0.1164 to 0.2598); and macro-F1 was 0.9248 against 0.8668, so all four criteria passed. Training the same recipe on clean articles alone cost 0.0123 in accuracy (0.0034 to 0.0207; descriptive). With no article, macro-F1 fell to 0.4384; the title alone raised it by 0.0939 (0.0655 to 0.1234), which a title stating the result or recall of the trial could explain; exchanging intervention and comparator reversed 0.6652 of its direction answers. Run as released, the files matched the evaluated predictions within limits set in advance. The release is under the Apache License 2.0 (digital object identifier 10.57967/hf/10722).

AI.tldr: Fiorillo v0.5 是一个开源模型，针对随机对照试验文章的结局方向判断任务，在预设四项标准上全部达标后按 Apache 2.0 发布。
AI.motivation: 为临床试验证据推断提供校准良好、可复用且合规的自动化工具，同时以预先注册标准约束发布决策。
AI.method: 基于 Qwen3-4B-Base 加低秩适配器与决策头，仅用 1,431 篇授权可复用文章微调；输入截断至 6,144 token，输出显著增加/减少/无显著变化三类答案及概率。四项标准在 OSF 预先注册。
AI.result: 测试集 1,218 prompts/333 篇：ECE 0.0168（限 0.05）；log loss 优于先验 0.8603、优于 Gemma 4 31B-it 0.1829；macro-F1 0.9248 对比 0.8668，四项全部通过。无文章时 macro-F1 降至 0.4384，仅标题提升 0.0939，交换干预与对照使 0.6652 方向答案反转。
AI.conclusion: 模型达到全部预设标准并可靠复现评测结果，已以 Apache 2.0 许可发布（DOI 10.57967/hf/10722）。

title: EPOCH: Reliable Discovery through Evidence-Governed Search
summary: AI research agents are increasingly used to search over programs, mathematical constructions, and proofs. However, existing systems typically optimize evaluator feedback without adequately governing how that feedback is interpreted, challenged, and reused. As a result, promising but fragile candidates can be promoted as discoveries, while benchmark improvements, finite certificates, and theorem-level claims are too easily conflated. We introduce EPOCH, an evidence-governed architecture designed to close this gap. EPOCH implements an evidence-governed discovery loop by combining explicit task contracts, typed memory, active falsification, admission checks, and independent replay, so that each candidate is evaluated against the strength and scope of the claim it supports. EPOCH achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance on AlgoTune, substantially exceeding the strongest baseline in mean normalized score (0.65 vs. 0.53), and attains the highest mean score on the internal Math14 suite (0.57). It further shows favorable held-out behavior under official-test replay and leads the descriptive aggregate on AgentHPO. Across ten discovery problems, EPOCH delivers substantial task-specific advances, including improved executable constructions, optimized algorithms, counterexamples, and proof-supported results. These advances demonstrate its ability to convert search into concrete progress across mathematical and computational domains. Together, the results suggest that evidence governance is a necessary step toward AI research agents that produce not only stronger solutions, but also more trustworthy scientific discoveries.

AI.tldr: EPOCH 提出一种"证据治理"式 AI 研究智能体架构，通过任务契约、类型化记忆、主动证伪、准入检查与独立回放，确保每个候选解按其支持的 claim 强度与范围被评估，从而提升发现的可靠性与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 研究智能体仅优化 evaluator 反馈，缺乏对反馈如何被解释、质疑与复用的治理，导致脆弱候选被误判为发现，benchmark 提升、有限证书与定理级结论被混为一谈。
AI.method: EPOCH 构建证据治理的发现循环，结合显式任务契约（task contracts）、类型化记忆（typed memory）、主动证伪（active falsification）、准入检查（admission checks）与独立回放（independent replay），针对候选所支持 claim 的强度与范围进行分层评估。
AI.result: 在 AlgoTune 上取得 SOTA 聚合表现，平均归一化得分 0.65 vs. 最强基线 0.53；内部 Math14 套件最高均分 0.57；在官方测试回放中表现出良好的 held-out 行为，并在 AgentHPO 上领先描述性聚合指标。十个发现问题上均取得实质性任务级进展，包括可执行构造、优化算法、反例与有证明支撑的结果。
AI.conclusion: 证据治理是迈向"既产出更强解、又产出更可信科学发现"的 AI 研究智能体的必要步骤。

title: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity for Recursive Entropic Risk Reinforcement Learning with a Generative Model
summary: In this paper, we study the sample complexities of value and policy learning in finite discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs) under recursive entropic risk preferences with risk parameter \(β\neq 0\), assuming access to a generative model of the MDP. We provide a refined analysis of model-based risk-sensitive Q-value iteration (MB-RS-QVI), a plug-in model-based method introduced in prior work, and derive \((\varepsilon,δ)\)-PAC guarantees for both learning the optimal \(Q\)-value function and an \(\varepsilon\)-optimal policy. Our bounds improve the exponential dependence on the effective horizon \(1/(1-γ)\) compared with the best existing guarantees for this setting. In particular, they match the existing lower bounds in their exponential dependence on \(|β|/(1-γ)\), as well as in \(S\), \(A\), \(\varepsilon\), and \(|β|\), up to logarithmic factors. Consequently, our analysis removes the exponential gap between the previously known upper and lower bounds, leaving only a polynomial gap in the effective horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究递归熵风险偏好下有限折扣MDP中值学习与策略学习的样本复杂度，改进了基于模型的Q值迭代（MB-RS-QVI）分析，在有效视界依赖上取得更紧的PAC界。
AI.motivation: 现有风险敏感MDP学习方法的样本复杂度上界对有效视界1/(1-γ)呈指数依赖，且与下界存在指数级差距，亟需更精细的分析来缩小这一差距。
AI.method: 在生成模型假设下，对已有的plug-in模型基风险敏感Q值迭代（MB-RS-QVI）进行精细分析，推导学习最优Q值函数与ε-最优策略的(ε,δ)-PAC保证。
AI.result: 所得界改进了对有效视界的指数依赖；在|β|/(1-γ)的指数依赖以及S、A、ε、|β|上匹配已有下界（至多对数因子），消除了上界与下界之间的指数差距，仅剩有效视界上的多项式差距。
AI.conclusion: 该分析显著缩小了风险敏感MDP学习的样本复杂度上下界差距，为解决有效视界上的剩余多项式差距提供了基础。

title: Network Intervention by Polling Strategic Agents
comment: Published as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
summary: A planner in a network of strategic agents faces three entangled challenges: the optimum depends on agents' private information, queried agents may misreport to steer the outcome, and exact computation does not scale. We study these challenges in multi-activity network games with heterogeneous private technologies, in which the planner sets non-discriminatory prices. We show that the optimal prices admit a centrality-based decomposition of the welfare kernel: each agent's contribution scales with its squared centrality in a network reweighted by agents' preferences across activities. This decomposition motivates Poll, a polling algorithm in which the planner samples one agent per round, walks briefly through the agent's neighborhood, and updates the price from a local report. From the same decomposition flow three forms of efficiency: computationally, Poll uses significantly fewer operations than exact computation and other distributed methods, requiring up to three orders of magnitude less communication on a real-world network with over 300,000 agents; statistically, its query complexity scales with topology and preference heterogeneity rather than explicitly with population size; and economically, it converges to welfare-maximizing prices while admitting behavior-specific implementations that induce truthful reports and detect adversarial deviations.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多活动网络博弈中的最优定价问题，提出基于中心性分解的Poll轮询算法，兼顾计算、统计和经济效率。
AI.motivation: 规划者在策略性代理网络中面临三重纠缠挑战：最优解依赖代理私有信息、被查询代理可能谎报以操纵结果、精确计算难以扩展。本文研究异构私有技术下的多活动网络博弈，规划者设定非歧视性价格。
AI.method: 证明最优价格允许福利核的中心性分解：每个代理的贡献随其在按偏好重加权网络中的平方中心性缩放。基于该分解提出Poll轮询算法：每轮采样一个代理，短暂游走其邻域，并根据局部报告更新价格。
AI.result: 计算上，Poll操作数显著少于精确计算和其他分布式方法，在30多万代理的真实网络上通信量减少最多三个数量级；统计上，查询复杂度取决于拓扑和偏好异质性而非人口规模；经济上，收敛到福利最大化价格，且支持诚实报告和检测对抗偏差的行为特定实现。
AI.conclusion: 中心性分解统一带来计算、统计、经济三重效率，为大规模策略性网络博弈的定价提供了可扩展且抗操纵的算法框架。

title: Harness Engineering for Software Engineering via Modular Executable Dev-Primitives
summary: Large language models (LLMs) equipped with terminal access have demonstrated strong capabilities in automating software engineering tasks. However, existing agents remain brittle on long-horizon workflows, where they must repeatedly reconstruct program state scattered across source files, configurations, tests, dependencies, and runtime behavior, leading to increasingly long interaction histories, context explosion, and semantic drift. Large repositories further complicate the identification of task-relevant components. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{Dev-Primitives} (\emph{Development Primitives}), a modular and executable abstraction that transforms repository components from passive software artifacts into active participants in software engineering. Each Dev-Primitive pairs a repository artifact with a resident LLM, which gives the artifact an agent-native interface grounded in its own implementation and dependencies, enabling natural-language reasoning, inter-component communication, and localized self-modification. Building on Dev-Primitives, we propose \textbf{HERMES}, a Harness Engineering framework for software engineeRing via Modular Executable Dev-PrimitiveS, which instantiates these primitives at repository scale through a dependency-aware dynamic activation mechanism and a bug diagnosis mechanism that maps execution evidence back to the components that must be revised. Extensive experiments on four software engineering benchmarks demonstrate that HERMES outperforms matched baseline harnesses by 12.4\% on average. Moreover, when paired with strong activation and diagnosis models, HERMES, even with Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives, remains within 4.5\% of the homogeneous GPT-5.6 Sol configuration across all four benchmarks, while reducing inference cost by 26.2\% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, highlighting the importance of harness design in software engineering agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Dev-Primitives抽象，将仓库构件与常驻LLM配对，构建HERMES框架，在软件工程任务上平均超过基线12.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有具备终端访问能力的LLM智能体在长周期工作流中表现脆弱，需反复重建分散于源码、配置、测试、依赖和运行时中的程序状态，导致交互历史过长、上下文爆炸与语义漂移；大型仓库进一步加剧任务相关组件的识别难度。
AI.method: 提出Dev-Primitives（开发原语），将每个仓库构件与常驻LLM配对，使其具备基于自身实现与依赖的智能体原生接口，支持自然语言推理、组件间通信与局部自修改；在其上构建HERMES框架，通过依赖感知的动态激活机制和将执行证据映射回待修改组件的缺陷诊断机制，在仓库规模上实例化这些原语。
AI.result: 在四个软件工程基准上，HERMES平均比匹配基线框架高出12.4%；搭配强激活与诊断模型时，即使使用Qwen3-8B原语，也在四个基准上与同构GPT-5.6 Sol配置差距在4.5%以内，同时在Terminal-Bench 4.0上降低推理成本26.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将仓库构件转变为主动参与者并配合良好的框架设计，可显著提升软件工程智能体的长周期能力，凸显harness设计在软件工程智能体中的重要性。

title: Adapting Generative Recommenders for Multi-Turn Interaction
summary: Generative recommenders decode items from a user's interaction history, but offer no way for users to correct a recommendation that misses their current intent. Adding conversation is natural since items and words share same output space, yet training the model to converse may overwrite the history-to-item mapping it relies on. We introduce INTEGER (**INTE**ractive **GE**nerative **R**ecommendation), which extends generative recommendation to multi-turn interaction with a learned routing token that lets the model decide when to recommend, history re-anchoring that conditions each item on both past behavior and the dialogue, and behavioral replay with instruction-data rehearsal that prevents forgetting during adaptation. Users can thus give feedback on recommendations within the dialogue, while recommendations stay grounded in behavioral history and accuracy is not traded for fluency. On Amazon Beauty and Toys, INTEGER matches or exceeds the strongest baselines in accuracy with competitive conversation quality, improving Hit@10 by 13.3% on Amazon Beauty, and significantly outperforms the generative recommender it starts from. Our analyses show that INTEGER learns behaviors that naive adaptation fails to acquire, recommending once the user's intent is clear and staying attentive to behavioral history at the moment of recommendation. INTEGER also learns an intent-agnostic replacement over the item space, which suppresses rejected items but points to attribute-aware feedback as the next step.

AI.tldr: INTEGER将生成式推荐扩展为多轮对话交互，通过路由token、历史重锚定和行为回放，在保持推荐精度的同时支持用户在对话中纠正推荐。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐从用户交互历史中解码物品，但用户无法纠正不符合当前意图的推荐。加入对话很自然（物品和词共享输出空间），但训练模型对话可能覆盖其依赖的历史到物品映射。
AI.method: 提出INTEGER，包含三部分：(1)学习型路由token，让模型决定何时推荐；(2)历史重锚定，使每个物品同时以历史行为和对话为条件；(3)行为回放结合指令数据演练，防止适应过程中遗忘。
AI.result: 在Amazon Beauty和Toys上，INTEGER在准确率上匹配或超越最强基线且对话质量有竞争力，Amazon Beauty上Hit@10提升13.3%，显著优于其基础的生成式推荐器。分析显示INTEGER学会了朴素适应无法获得的行为：意图明确时推荐、推荐时关注行为历史；同时也学到意图无关的物品替换，可抑制被拒物品。
AI.conclusion: INTEGER实现了推荐与对话的兼顾，用户可在对话中反馈，推荐仍扎根于行为历史，准确率不为流畅性让步。未来方向是属性感知反馈。

title: State-Aware Interaction MIL for Rare Joint Molecular Phenotype Prediction in Colorectal Cancer and Lung Adenocarcinoma
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Joint molecular phenotype prediction is complicated by small joint-positive populations and overlapping histological features across alternative molecular states. Existing computational pathology approaches typically predict biomarkers independently or formulate the joint-positive phenotype as a binary endpoint. Independent prediction does not model interactions between biomarker-specific histological representations, whereas binary joint prediction collapses the double-negative and two single-positive configurations into a single negative class. We propose State-Aware Interaction MIL, a weakly supervised method that preserves biomarker-specific histological representations, models their interaction, and supervises the complete four-state molecular configuration. We evaluate the proposed approach for joint BRAF+/MSI+ prediction in colorectal cancer and EGFR+/TP53+ prediction in lung adenocarcinoma using frozen UNI2-h and CONCH pathology foundation-model representations. With UNI2-h, State-Aware Interaction MIL achieved an average precision of 0.5566 in colorectal cancer (joint-positive prevalence 6.8%) compared with 0.5161 for NaiveMTL, and 0.2784 in lung adenocarcinoma (joint-positive prevalence 8.6%) compared with 0.2525 for IndependentPair. With CONCH, State-Aware achieved an average precision of 0.4410 compared with 0.3932 for DirectJoint in colorectal cancer and 0.1659 compared with 0.1226 for DirectJoint in lung adenocarcinoma. These results indicate that pathology foundation-model representations contain predictive information for rare joint molecular phenotypes and that preserving biomarker-specific representations within a structured molecular-state formulation can improve prediction of these phenotypes from histopathology.

AI.tldr: 提出State-Aware Interaction MIL方法，保留生物标志物特异性表征并建模其交互，监督完整四态分子构型，用于联合分子表型预测。
AI.motivation: 联合分子表型预测受限于联合阳性样本少及不同分子状态间组织学特征重叠；现有方法或独立预测生物标志物（忽略交互），或将联合阳性作为二分类端点（丢失双阴与两个单阳构型信息）。
AI.method: 弱监督方法State-Aware Interaction MIL：保留生物标志物特异性组织学表征、建模标志物间交互，并对完整四态分子构型进行监督。在结直肠癌BRAF+/MSI+和肺腺癌EGFR+/TP53+上评估，使用UNI2-h和CONCH病理基础模型表征。
AI.result: UNI2-h下结直肠癌AP达0.5566（vs NaiveMTL 0.5161，联合阳性率6.8%），肺腺癌AP 0.2784（vs IndependentPair 0.2525，联合阳性率8.6%）；CONCH下结直肠癌AP 0.4410（vs DirectJoint 0.3932），肺腺癌0.1659（vs 0.1226）。
AI.conclusion: 病理基础模型表征包含罕见联合分子表型的预测信息，在结构化分子状态框架内保留生物标志物特异性表征可提升组织病理学预测性能。

title: Investigating Model Compression for Neural Machine Translation in the Biomedical Domain
summary: Large-scale pretrained transformer models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse machine translation tasks, including multilingual settings. Knowledge distillation has emerged as a sustainable approach for model compression, transferring knowledge from large teacher models to smaller, more efficient student models. Similarly, quantization, which reduces the numerical precision of model weights and activations (e.g., from 32-bit to 8-bit representations) is widely used to accelerate inference, enabling models to run several times faster during deployment. However, both techniques face limitations when applied to specialized domain data, particularly under low-resource conditions. In knowledge distillation, the effectiveness of transfer is often constrained by the scarcity of domain-specific parallel data, while quantization can lead to performance degradation as bit precision decreases. In this work, we investigate the combined application of knowledge distillation and quantization for French-to-English biomedical translation, a domain characterized by specialized terminology and limited parallel resources. We develop and compare multiple fine-tuning strategies to adapt compressed student models to this challenging setting. Our experiments demonstrate that a collaboratively distilled and quantized student model achieves a 69% reduction in size, a 98.21% increase in inference speed, and a 98.46% reduction in CO2 emissions compared to the original baseline all without sacrificing translation quality. These results indicate that jointly optimized compression techniques can yield efficient, high-performance models suitable for translation service providers operating under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究知识蒸馏与量化联合应用于法英生物医学翻译，压缩学生模型实现69%体积缩减、98.21%推理加速、98.46%碳排放减少且不损失翻译质量。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练Transformer在多语言翻译上表现优异，但部署成本高。知识蒸馏与量化是常见压缩手段，然而在低资源专用领域（如生物医学）中，蒸馏受限于领域平行数据稀缺，量化随比特降低导致性能退化。因此需探究二者联合应用的效果。
AI.method: 以法英生物医学翻译为任务，结合知识蒸馏与量化，开发并比较多种微调策略，将压缩后的学生模型适配到该挑战性场景，并采用协同蒸馏与量化的方式优化模型。
AI.result: 协同蒸馏并量化的学生模型相比原基线：体积减少69%，推理速度提升98.21%，CO2排放减少98.46%，且翻译质量无损。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化的压缩技术可产出高效、高性能的翻译模型，适合资源受限的翻译服务提供商使用。

title: When better traffic forecasts fail to improve signal control: a layered diagnostic study of forecast-to-decision value
summary: Improved traffic forecasts do not necessarily yield better signal-control decisions. We investigate this gap through a layered diagnostic study using 29 days of reconstructed demand from Xuancheng, China, with seven dates reserved for testing. The framework evaluates point forecasts, conformal intervals, dependence-aware scenarios, and matched closed-loop controllers. Entry-level and movement-level forecasts reduce mean absolute error by 4.03% and 3.92%, respectively, relative to historical means. A nominal 90% conformal interval achieves 90.72% marginal coverage but only 75.66% on an ex-post high-demand subset. Interface audits identify decision-time leakage and reveal that only two of nine controlled intersections offer multiple effective actions. We correct the temporal interface and compare causal forecasts with a five-second event oracle using exhaustive joint-action search. A synthetic positive control demonstrates that future information can reduce the internal rollout cost by 61.5%. On the frozen test dates, however, causal forecasts and the event oracle increase queue vehicle?seconds by 6.09% and 3.39% relative to the matched no-future rollout, while the oracle reduces spillback exposure by 3.78%; paired-day bootstrap intervals cross zero. These findings indicate that forecast value depends on temporal observability, action identifiability, dynamics consistency, and objective alignment. The proposed protocol provides a practical way to diagnose where predictive improvements fail to translate into operational benefits.

AI.tldr: 交通预测精度的提升不必然带来更好的信号控制决策；本文提出分层诊断框架，揭示预测价值受时间可观测性、动作可识别性、动态一致性与目标对齐四项条件制约。
AI.motivation: 交通预测研究与信号控制应用之间长期存在"预测变好但决策未变好"的落差，但缺乏系统性的诊断方法来定位落差来源，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于宣城29天重建需求（7天留作测试）的分层诊断框架：评估点预测、共形区间、依赖感知场景与匹配的闭环控制器；通过接口审计检查决策时泄漏与动作可识别性（仅9个受控路口中的2个有多个有效动作）；修正时间接口后，用穷举联合动作搜索比较因果预测与5秒事件oracle。
AI.result: 入口级与流向级预测相对历史均值分别降低MAE 4.03%与3.92%；名义90%共形区间边际覆盖90.72%，但高需求子集仅75.66%。合成正对照显示未来信息可将内部rollout成本降低61.5%。冻结测试日上，因果预测与oracle反而使排队车·秒分别增加6.09%与3.39%，oracle使溢出暴露降低3.78%，配对日bootstrap区间跨越零。
AI.conclusion: 预测价值取决于时间可观测性、动作可识别性、动态一致性与目标对齐；所提协议为诊断"预测改进为何无法转化为运营收益"提供了实用方法。

title: QiYao-I: A Manifold Based Foundation Model for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting is a challenging yet important problem in real-world applications, where observations are often irregularly sampled and asynchronously recorded across variables. Existing time series foundation models are mostly built on regularly sampled sequences, making them difficult to generalize to irregular time intervals and asynchronous cross-variable dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose QiYao-I, a manifold based foundation model for irregular multivariate time series forecasting. Specifically, we introduce a novel sampling-conditioned temporal manifold attention mechanism that maps real timestamps into a learnable temporal manifold feature space and injects temporal manifold biases into attention layers, enabling the model to capture both irregular time intervals and local sampling structures. Further, we propose a dynamic variable interaction mechanism with frequency awareness. It selectively performs cross-variable message passing under asynchronous observations. Extensive experiments on real-world irregular multivariate forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that QiYao-I achieves superior performance compared with both time series foundation models and end-to-end irregular forecasting models, showing strong generalization ability in zero-shot and few-shot settings.

AI.tldr: QiYao-I：面向不规则多元时间序列预测的流形基础模型，通过采样条件时序流形注意力与频率感知动态变量交互机制，在不规则采样与异步跨变量场景下取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现实应用中观测常被不规则采样且各变量异步记录，而现有时间序列基础模型多基于规则采样序列，难以泛化到不规则时间间隔和异步跨变量依赖。
AI.method: 提出采样条件时序流形注意力机制，将真实时间戳映射到可学习时序流形特征空间并向注意力层注入时序流形偏置，以捕捉不规则时间间隔与局部采样结构；并提出频率感知的动态变量交互机制，在异步观测下选择性进行跨变量消息传递。
AI.result: 在真实不规则多元预测基准上，QiYao-I 优于时间序列基础模型与端到端不规则预测模型，并在零样本与少样本设置下展现强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: QiYao-I 作为基于流形的不规则多元时间序列预测基础模型，有效应对不规则采样与异步依赖挑战，具备良好泛化性。

title: Support-Dependent Regret Rates for Profit Maximization in Multilateral Trade
summary: We study online profit maximization in multilateral trade, a setting that generalizes both dynamic pricing and bilateral trade. At each round, an intermediary posts prices to buyers and offers payments to sellers; trade occurs only if every agent accepts.
