summary: Long-history recommenders often compress each user's history into a compact, candidate-independent memory that is cached and reused to score large candidate pools. We show that real user histories exhibit multi-scale semantic structure, with short-lived intent, medium-term interests, and long-term preferences coexisting in one sequence, and that monolithic cached memories preserve these scales unevenly: linear probes recover recent and mid-range content far worse than long-range content. We call this failure mode \textit{temporal aliasing}. We propose \textbf{MARS}, a multi-resolution user memory that writes the full history into recurrent state tracks anchored to different half-lives, and a sparse routing reader that materializes compact seed memories by selecting the relevant temporal resolutions for each seed, preserving fixed-size candidate scoring. MARS outperforms strong baselines on three public datasets, with gains that grow with history length. Component-matched ablations with paired tests show that temporal diversity and selective routing each contribute beyond what hard-window memories or added capacity provide. The advantage of MARS over its interface-matched baseline also widens after within-user behavioral shifts, at about $1.02\times$ that baseline's warm-cache serving latency for $1{,}000$ candidates per user.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MARS，一种多分辨率用户记忆机制，解决长历史推荐中缓存记忆的时序混叠问题，在多个数据集上超过强基线且延迟开销小。
AI.motivation: 真实用户历史存在多尺度语义结构（短期意图、中期兴趣、长期偏好共存），而单一缓存的紧凑记忆对这些尺度保留不均，线性探针显示近期和中程内容恢复效果远差于长期内容，作者称此时序混叠问题。
AI.method: MARS将完整历史写入锚定不同半衰期的循环状态轨道，并用稀疏路由读取器为每个种子选择相关时间分辨率，生成紧凑种子记忆，同时保持固定规模候选打分。
AI.result: MARS在三个公开数据集上优于强基线，增益随历史长度增长；组件匹配消融与配对检验表明时间多样性和选择性路由各有贡献；在用户行为漂移后优势扩大，1000候选/用户的warm-cache服务延迟约为基线的1.02倍。
AI.conclusion: 多分辨率记忆与选择性路由能更均衡地保留用户历史的多尺度结构，提升长历史推荐效果且服务延迟代价很小。

title: Learning What to Distill: Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models have shown strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference costs make knowledge distillation an important approach for transferring such capabilities to compact models in resource-constrained scenarios. On-policy self-distillation further reduces the reliance on external large teacher models while improving the reasoning ability of compact language models. However, existing methods typically either distill all token positions uniformly or select tokens using fixed heuristic criteria, assigning the same distillation strength to the selected positions rather than adaptively learning which tokens are most beneficial for distillation. To address these limitations, we propose BiToK-SD (Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation), a bilevel-optimization-based token selection method that learns where distillation should be applied during on-policy self-distillation. Specifically, BiToK-SD is formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, where the lower-level problem models Top-K token selection as a differentiable threshold-based relaxation, allowing the selected positions to adapt as the student policy evolves, while the upper-level problem performs knowledge distillation on the selected positions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that BiToK-SD achieves the best average performance among all compared methods while requiring only lightweight additional computation.

AI.tldr: 提出BiToK-SD，一种基于双层优化的Token选择方法，用于on-policy自蒸馏，自适应学习哪些位置进行蒸馏，在数学推理基准上取得最佳平均性能且额外计算开销轻量。
AI.motivation: 大模型推理能力强但推理成本高，知识蒸馏可将能力迁移到紧凑模型。On-policy自蒸馏减少对外部大教师模型的依赖，但现有方法要么对所有token位置均匀蒸馏，要么用固定启发式准则选择token并赋予相同蒸馏强度，无法自适应学习哪些token最有益。
AI.method: 将BiToK-SD建模为双层优化问题：下层问题把Top-K token选择建模为可微的基于阈值的松弛，使被选位置随学生策略演化而自适应；上层问题在选定位置上执行知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上，BiToK-SD在所有对比方法中取得最佳平均性能，且仅需轻量的额外计算。
AI.conclusion: 通过双层优化实现自适应的token选择，能有效提升on-policy自蒸馏的推理能力，兼顾性能与计算效率。

title: Foveated Compression: Selective High-Resolution Preservation for Token-Efficient VLMs
summary: Visual tokens are a major source of inference cost in vision-language models, yet simple image downsampling remains a surprisingly strong compression baseline. This raises a complementary question: under a fixed token budget, where should visual fidelity be preserved? We introduce Foveated Compression, which encodes a full-resolution image once and represents it with a mixture of native- and compressed-resolution visual tokens. A behaviorally self-distilled Foveated Merger compresses local visual tokens while preserving compatibility with their native counterparts, and a lightweight Foveated Selector chooses one of nine spatial cells to retain at native resolution using exhaustive budget-matched intervention supervision. At 11.11% visual tokens, uniform Foveated Compression shows no significant paired difference from iso-token downsampling. At 20.99%, the learned selector significantly outperforms random and fixed allocation, but remains below strong whole-image resizing, showing that localized fidelity is not universally preferable. A budget-matched region-choice oracle reaches 82.73 macro accuracy versus 69.61 for the learned selector, revealing substantial headroom within the same spatial action space. Matched probing further shows that signals predicting when compression breaks the answer are substantially more accessible after language-model computation than to the lightweight prefill-free selector. These results expose complementary bottlenecks in region selection and compressed-region fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Foveated Compression方法，在固定视觉token预算下，通过混合原生与压缩分辨率的token来编码图像，并探究视觉保真度应在何处保留。
AI.motivation: 视觉token是视觉语言模型推理成本的主要来源，而简单图像下采样已是强压缩基线。作者想探究在固定token预算下，视觉保真度应保留在何处。
AI.method: 将全分辨率图像编码一次，用原生与压缩分辨率的混合token表示。行为自蒸馏的Foveated Merger压缩局部token并保持与原生token兼容；轻量Foveated Selector在九个空间单元中选择一个以原生分辨率保留，使用预算匹配的干预监督。
AI.result: 11.11% token时，均匀Foveated Compression与等token下采样无显著配对差异。20.99%时，学习选择器显著优于随机与固定分配，但仍低于强全图缩放。预算匹配的区域选择oracle达82.73宏准确率，学习选择器仅69.61，头部空间大。匹配探测显示，预测压缩何时破坏答案的信号在语言模型计算后更易获得。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了区域选择与压缩区域保真度两方面的互补瓶颈。

title: Penalty-Framed No-Valid-Option MCQA: Analyzing LLM Abstention under Invalid Choices
comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference (Short Paper)
summary: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) is commonly used to evaluate large language models under the assumption that one of the provided options is correct, typically using answer-selection accuracy. However, in real deployments, users or retrieval systems may provide invalid option sets in which none of the listed choices is correct, and selecting one of them may incur downstream cost. We study this setting as penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA. Using the mathematics subset of MMLU-Pro, we remove the labeled correct option, allow models to either choose a remaining option or output ABSTAIN, and penalize invalid forced-choice responses. We further introduce correct-conditioned analysis, evaluating abstention only on instances that the model originally answered correctly. Experiments show that high MCQA accuracy does not fully guarantee abstention reliability: even under explicit no-valid-option-aware instructions and penalty-based scoring, models still produce invalid forced-choice responses for a subset of originally correct instances. These results show that penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA reveals an aspect of model reliability not captured by standard answer-selection accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"无有效选项"的多选题设定：去掉正确选项后，模型应选择放弃作答(ABSTAIN)，但实验发现高选择题准确率并不代表模型能可靠弃答。
AI.motivation: 现有多选题评测默认选项中必有正确答案，只看选择准确率；但现实中选项集可能无效（无正确答案），此时强行选择会带来下游代价，这种可靠性未被现有指标捕捉。
AI.method: 提出 penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA 设定：使用 MMLU-Pro 数学子集，移除正确选项，允许模型选择剩余选项或输出 ABSTAIN，并惩罚无效的强行选择；同时引入 correct-conditioned analysis，仅在模型原本答对的实例上评估弃答表现。
AI.result: 即使给出明确的无有效选项感知指令并采用惩罚式评分，模型在部分原本答对的实例上仍产生无效的强行选择，说明高 MCQA 准确率无法充分保证弃答可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 惩罚式无有效选项多选题揭示了标准选择准确率未能捕捉的模型可靠性维度，弃答可靠性应作为独立评测目标。

title: On Open-Ended Information Seeking for Information Elicitation Agents
summary: Information elicitation is an open-ended information-seeking problem in which an interaction can unfold in many potentially valuable directions, requiring an elicitor to continually determine which information to pursue as new information emerges. In agentic elicitation, these decisions may be delegated to a foundation model, yet how model choice shapes the resulting information-seeking behavior remains understudied. We study how judgments about information value vary across LLMs and how these differences shape sequential information seeking. We first examine these judgments across 11 LLMs spanning multiple model families and parameter scales, using a shared set of information and elicitation objectives. We then develop a controlled elicitation simulation in which different models encounter the same information space and use the same selection rule, isolating these judgments from question generation and respondent behavior. Using this setting, we characterize the breadth-depth behavior that emerges from model-specific information-seeking preferences over the course of elicitation. We further examine how interaction history changes the evaluation and subsequent selection of prospective information. We test the robustness and boundaries of these findings through sensitivity analyses and ablations over the opportunities available to the elicitor, the response labels used to operationalize information-seeking preferences, the presence of interaction history, and whether redundancy is explicitly relevant to the assessment. The project code, data, and trajectory files are available at https://github.com/infosenselab/open-elicitation.

AI.tldr: 研究不同LLM对信息价值的判断差异如何影响智能体式信息获取的广度-深度行为，并通过受控模拟隔离模型偏好。
AI.motivation: 信息elicitation是开放式信息搜寻问题，互动可能朝多个有价值方向发展，需要elicitor在新信息出现时持续判断该追求哪些信息。智能体式elicitation中这些决策可委托给基础模型，但模型选择如何塑造信息搜寻行为仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 1）用共享信息集与elicitation目标，考察11个跨模型家族与参数规模的LLM的信息价值判断；2）构建受控elicitation模拟，让不同模型面对相同信息空间并使用相同选择规则，隔离判断与提问生成、回答者行为；3）刻画模型特定信息搜寻偏好产生的广度-深度行为，考察交互历史对信息评估与选择的影响；4）通过敏感性分析与消融，检验elicitor可用机会、用于操作化偏好的响应标签、交互历史存在与否、冗余是否显式相关等边界。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果；主要发现方向是LLM间信息价值判断存在差异，且这些差异在受控模拟中产生可区分的广度-深度搜寻行为，并受交互历史等因素影响。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择会系统性地影响智能体式信息elicitation行为；需在隔离判断、生成与回答者行为的受控设置下研究其广度-深度权衡与边界条件。代码、数据与轨迹已开源。

title: Neural Fields Encode Adaptation Geometry
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures. Extended version of work accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
summary: Neural fields are usually evaluated by how well they reconstruct an observation. We show that this misses two useful properties of a fitted network: how easily it can adapt to new observations, and what its weights retain from earlier ones. We study these properties as adaptation geometry. For images, we meta-learn class-specific initializations, adapt each one to a new image, and measure how much the network must change to fit it. A simple local linear model closely predicts this adaptation cost, while replacing one network's tangent kernel with another's substantially worsens the prediction. Adaptation thus depends on the local geometry of the fitted network, not only on its current reconstruction. For physical fields, we repeatedly fit the same network to observations from a sequence. Its weights then retain information about that history. When two wave histories end at exactly the same observation, the final weights recover the sign of the wave velocity with 68.6% accuracy, whereas the current observation alone contains no such information and gives 50%. These two phenomena are quantitatively linked: tangent-kernel eigenvalues predict both which changes are easy to learn and how quickly they are overwritten by later fitting. Together, these results show that neural fields contain useful information beyond what they currently reconstruct: in how they can change and in how they got there.

AI.tldr: 神经场评估不应只看重建质量，其"适应几何"（易变性）和权重历史信息同样重要且相互关联。
AI.motivation: 传统神经场评估仅衡量重建观测的好坏，忽略了两个有用属性：网络适应新观测的难易程度，以及权重从早期观测中保留的信息。
AI.method: 将上述属性作为"适应几何"研究：图像上用元学习类特定初始化并适配新图，测量网络变化量；物理场上将同一网络反复拟合序列观测，考察权重保留的历史信息；并用切线核特征值进行定量联系分析。
AI.result: 局部线性模型能很好预测适配成本，替换切线核则显著恶化预测；两条波形历史终点相同时，最终权重以68.6%准确率恢复波速符号（仅看当前观测为50%）；切线核特征值同时预测哪些变化易学及被后续拟合覆盖的速度。
AI.conclusion: 神经场包含超出当前重建内容的有用信息：既体现在"如何变化"上，也体现在"如何到达"上。

title: Later Is Better: Token Reduction for ViTs Under Distribution Shift
summary: Training-free token reduction accelerates vision transformers by removing redundant tokens across layers, recovering most of the original accuracy at a fraction of the compute. These methods, however, are designed and evaluated primarily on clean data, and under real-world distribution shift their accuracy gap to the uncompressed model widens with the removal rate. We show that this gap is governed by the reduction schedule, the depth profile of removal, usually left fixed as an implementation detail. Concretely, we introduce a one-parameter late-concentrated power-law schedule that consistently improves out-of-distribution accuracy over flat at no extra inference cost. On ImageNet-C with DeiT-S, the late schedule closes 83% of that gap at a 26% compute reduction (+1.17pp), and 99% of it at a lighter 7% reduction (+0.26pp). The gain cannot be attributed to retaining more tokens or using extra compute: held to flat's compute, the late schedule removes more tokens in total and leaves fewer tokens at the end, yet still wins. Single-layer probes point to a mechanism: earlier reductions perturb features that pass through more remaining layers, front-loading reduction error in depth. The effect is broad, holding across five token-reduction methods (ToMe, EViT, ATS, ATC, PiToMe), nine backbones, all ImageNet-C corruption types, eight further shift suites, and two further modalities, video and vision-language QA. It is also specific to shift, still positive on clean and rising monotonically to ~4x that at the highest severity 5. The schedule keeps its gain under six test-time adaptation methods, and needs no per-input or per-domain tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文发现无需训练的token缩减方法的精度损失主要由"缩减日程"(缩减深度分布)决定，提出单参数晚集中power-law日程，在零额外推理成本下持续提升分布外(shift)精度，跨5种方法、9个骨干、多种模态验证。
AI.motivation: 现有无需训练token缩减方法主要在干净数据上设计与评估，在真实分布偏移下与未压缩模型的精度差距随移除率增大而扩大。作者认为这一差距由通常被视为实现细节而固定的"缩减日程"(移除的深度分布)所支配。
AI.method: 提出单参数"晚集中power-law日程"：将token缩减集中在深层，而非均匀(flat)分布。通过单层探针分析机制——早期缩减扰动会经过更多剩余层的特征，把缩减误差前置到深度中。无需逐输入或逐域调参，也无额外推理成本。
AI.result: ImageNet-C+DeiT-S上：晚日程在26%计算缩减下弥合83%差距(+1.17pp)，7%缩减下弥合99%(+0.26pp)。在同等计算量下，晚日程总移除更多token、末端token更少却仍胜出。效果跨ToMe、EViT、ATS、ATC、PiToMe五种方法、九个骨干、全部ImageNet-C腐蚀类型、八个额外偏移套件及视频与视觉语言QA两种模态；干净数据上仍为正，并随严重度单调上升至severity 5时约4倍；在六种测试时自适应方法下仍保持增益。
AI.conclusion: 缩减日程是影响shift鲁棒性的关键但被忽视的设计维度，晚集中power-law日程是简单、通用、即插即用的改进，在多种方法、骨干、模态与偏移场景下均有效且无额外成本。

title: Making COMET Comparable Across Scripts: Diagnosis and Correction of Tokeniser-Induced Script Bias in Indic MT Evaluation
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Camera-ready version, accepted at WMT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/John-salvin/script-bias-comet-normalisation
summary: COMET reports translation quality as a single number, and that number is routinely compared across target languages written in different scripts. Such a comparison assumes Script Invariance: the score should not depend on the writing system that carries the target. We test it on IndicMT Eval by re-encoding the target into Latin script, which changes orthographic form while holding content and human ratings fixed. Script identity then accounts for 22.9% of native-script COMET variance, and agreement with annotators falls in all five languages studied. We trace the effect to the tokeniser and measure it with three label-free diagnostics. The bias is two faults, not one. Scores from different scripts occupy incompatible ranges, and within a single script the metric orders translations less accurately. No order-preserving transform of the score can repair the second fault. The first is removed exactly by COMET-QN, which maps the score distribution of each (language, script) pair onto a shared reference. Pooled agreement with annotators rises from 0.300 to 0.399, which is what makes scores from different scripts safe to place on one axis, and every within-language ordering is provably preserved. A regressor over parity features recovers a further 17.1% of the lost sensitivity. The remainder belongs to the encoder, and no post-processing can reach it. We therefore recommend publishing the normalised score, the three diagnostics, and the identity of the tokeniser they were computed against, so that a reader can tell how much of a score reflects translation quality and how much reflects the writing system.

AI.tldr: COMET翻译评分隐含"脚本不变性"假设，但实验证明该假设不成立：脚本身份解释22.9%方差，且误差源于tokeniser。作者提出COMET-QN归一化将跨语言一致度从0.300提升到0.399，并无损保持语言内排序，但编码器残余误差无法事后修复。
AI.motivation: COMET把翻译质量压缩成单一数值，并被跨不同书写系统的目标语言直接比较。这种比较隐含"脚本不变性"假设——分数不应取决于承载目标的书写系统。论文旨在检验该假设是否成立，并定位偏差来源。
AI.method: 在IndicMT Eval上把目标重编码为拉丁字母，保持内容与人工评分不变，从而隔离脚本形式的影响；用三个无标签诊断定位并量化偏差；提出COMET-QN，将每个（语言，脚本）对的分数分布映射到共享参考分布；再用基于parity特征的回顺器恢复部分敏感性。
AI.result: 脚本身份解释原生脚本COMET方差的22.9%，五种语言下与标注者的一致度均下降。偏差含两类fault：不同脚本分数区间不兼容，脚本内排序也不够准确；后者无法被任何保序变换修复。COMET-QN精确消除第一类，合并一致度从0.300升到0.399且语言内排序可证保持；parity回归器再恢复17.1%的敏感性损失，剩余部分属编码器，事后处理无法触及。
AI.conclusion: 建议发布归一化分数、三个诊断指标以及其所针对的tokeniser身份，使读者能判断分数中有多少反映翻译质量、多少反映书写系统。

title: From Local Evidence to Safety Verdicts: Causal Tracing in Vision-Language Models
summary: A vision-language model may need to combine an image with a prompt to recognize a safety risk that neither reveals alone. Where does this joint safety judgment become accessible inside the model? We introduce SSU-Bench, a dataset of matched safe and unsafe image-text combinations constructed using single-item prompt edits or image edits with annotated intended regions. Using three vision-language models, we transfer internal states between paired inputs and measure the resulting change in the safety verdict. Across models and both types of counterfactual, interventions at the changed input positions are effective in earlier decoder layers, while interventions at the final input token become effective later. Directions estimated from other examples produce similar late-layer effects. A linear readout of the final-token state also predicts the model's own verdict, including incorrect judgments, and cross-model comparisons reveal similarities in the patterns of counterfactual change. These findings identify a recurring transition in where interventions can influence a joint safety verdict and distinguish a readable model decision from a correct safety judgment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SSU-Bench数据集，研究视觉语言模型如何在不同层形成图文联合安全判断。实验发现：改变位置的干预在较早解码层有效，最终token干预在较晚层有效；最终token状态可线性读出模型判断（含错误判断），并识别出"可读决策"与"正确安全判断"的区别。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型需结合图像与提示才能识别单独任一方无法揭示的安全风险，但其联合安全判断在模型内部何处可及仍不清楚。
AI.method: 构建SSU-Bench：通过单项提示编辑或带标注目标区域的图像编辑，配对安全与不安全图文组合。在三个VLM间转移配对输入的内部状态，测量安全判定变化，并进行方向估计、线性读出与跨模型比较。
AI.result: 跨模型与两类反事实中，改变输入位置的干预在较早解码层有效，最终token干预在较晚层有效；其他样本估计的方向产生类似晚层效应；最终token状态的线性读出能预测模型判断（含错误判断）；跨模型的反事实变化模式相似。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出干预影响联合安全判定的重复层间转变，并区分可读的模型决策与正确的安全判断。

title: Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Graph Saddle Point Problems
summary: Neural algorithmic reasoning, or aligning a neural network with an algorithmic paradigm, has emerged as an approach to solving polynomial-time-solvable and computationally harder combinatorial optimization problems. We propose a new message-passing framework based on the Chambolle-Pock Primal--Dual Hybrid Gradient (PDHG) method called \textsc{GraphPDHG} for solving general graph saddle-point problems. Theoretically, we show that \textsc{GraphPDHG} can efficiently solve a family of graph saddle-point problems by simulating PDHG. We also show that our network can learn an accelerated PDHG algorithm. Experimentally, we support our results on accelerated PDHG by evaluating the performance of our model as a learned warm start for second-order optimization techniques (SSNAL). We also show that alignment with PDHG leads to stronger size generalization than non-aligned graph neural network (GNN) baselines. Overall, we propose a novel architecture for solving a general family of optimization problems on graphs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GraphPDHG，一个基于Chambolle-Pock原始-对偶混合梯度（PDHG）方法的图消息传递框架，用于求解一般图鞍点问题，并能学习加速PDHG算法。
AI.motivation: 神经算法推理（将神经网络与算法范式对齐）已成为求解多项式时间可解及更难的组合优化问题的方法，但需要为一般图鞍点问题提供新的对齐框架。
AI.method: 提出GraphPDHG——基于PDHG的消息传递框架，模拟PDHG以高效求解一类图鞍点问题，并可学习加速的PDHG算法。
AI.result: 实验中评估模型作为二阶优化（SSNAL）学习热启动的性能，验证了加速PDHG的结果；且与PDHG对齐比未对齐的GNN基线具有更强的规模泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种求解图上一般优化问题族的新型架构。

title: From Laboratory to Road: Evaluating Wearable Gaze Accuracy for Driving
comment: Peer-reviewed and accepted as an Extended Abstract at the German Conference on Pattern Recognition (GCPR 2026). Presented as a poster at GCPR 2026
summary: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations have become a widely used interface between perception and planning in autonomous driving, but they encode what is in a scene, not what is behaviorally relevant to a human driver. Gaze offers a compelling behavioral signal for this gap, yet wearable eye trackers are routinely deployed as if their spatial output were ground truth, despite known sensitivity to head motion, illumination, and calibration drift. We present, to our knowledge, the first unified framework for quantifying wearable gaze accuracy under real driving conditions. Our on-road study contains 41 validated scenes in which one driver fixated a vehicle's license plate. Gaze error is measured as the angular difference between the plate center and the gaze direction estimated by the glasses. Separate indoor studies with the same driver and device systematically analyze how distance, illumination, head motion, target motion, and gaze eccentricity affect both systematic bias and gaze precision. The mean on-road error was 4.58 degrees. Applying an offset estimated from the indoor recordings reduced it to 1.10 degrees and improved all 41 scenes. Because this offset varied between sessions, reliable BEV supervision may require online recalibration and condition-dependent estimates of gaze uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次提出统一框架量化真实驾驶下可穿戴视线追踪精度：41个道路场景平均角度误差4.58°，室内估计的偏移校正后降至1.10°，且偏移随会次变化，提示BEV监督需在线重校准与条件相关的不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: BEV表示仅编码场景内容，缺乏与驾驶员行为相关的信息；视线是理想的行为信号，但可穿戴眼动仪的空间输出常被当作真值，而其对头部运动、光照和校准漂移敏感，其真实驾驶精度尚未被量化。
AI.method: 开展真实道路研究，含41个经验证场景：驾驶员注视某车牌，以车牌中心与眼镜估计视线方向的角度差衡量误差；并与同一驾驶员、同一设备的室内研究对比，系统分析距离、光照、头部运动、目标运动及注视偏心对系统偏差与精度的影响。
AI.result: 道路平均误差为4.58°；应用室内记录估计的固定偏移后降至1.10°，且41个场景全部改善；该偏移在不同会次间存在变化。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴视线追踪在真实驾驶中误差显著且非恒定，可靠的BEV监督可能需要在线重校准及依赖条件（如距离、光照、运动）的视线不确定性估计。

title: STRUCTURALCOST: A controlled reading time dataset for modeling human sentence processing difficulty
summary: We introduce STRUCTURALCOST, a self-paced reading dataset of 475 participants and 40,800 observations isolating the processing cost of long-distance subject-verb dependency resolution. We replicate a low-powered psycholinguistic finding at NLP scale, namely that human reading times at the main verb increase with dependency length, driven by syntactic embedding beyond linear distance. Different language models -- spanning n-gram models, SSMs, and transformers -- partially mirror this graded difficulty profile, yet underestimate the integration cost humans incur, with a gap that persists across architectures and model sizes. This suggests these models capture the predictive component of human processing but not the full integration cost that working memory imposes. STRUCTURALCOST provides data needed to drive progress toward evaluating the cognitive plausibility of language models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出STRUCTURALCOST数据集（475名被试、40,800条观测），用于探究长距离主谓依存解析的处理成本，并发现语言模型低估了人类的整合成本。
AI.motivation: 低统计效力心理语言学发现需在NLP规模上复现；同时需评估语言模型的认知合理性以及其是否具备人类工作记忆约束下的整合能力。
AI.method: 构建自定步速阅读数据集STRUCTURALCOST，分离长距离主谓依存解析成本；比较n-gram、SSM、transformer等不同架构与规模的语言模型对人类阅读时间模式的拟合情况。
AI.result: 复现发现：主句动词处阅读时间随依存长度增加而上升，且受句法嵌套驱动而非仅线性距离。语言模型部分呈现该困难梯度，但系统性低估人类整合成本，且该差距跨架构和模型规模持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型捕捉了人类处理的预测成分，但未体现工作记忆带来的完整整合成本。STRUCTURALCOST为评估语言模型认知合理性提供了数据支持。

title: Grounding What Shapes the Plan: Rethinking Groundedness for Physical Intelligence in Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving models increasingly ground reasoning in causal relations, spatial structure, perceptual evidence, and predicted futures. These advances make reasoning more faithful to the driving scene, but leave a fundamental question unresolved: what should groundedness mean when the model ultimately outputs an action? Correctly grounded reasoning does not, by itself, ensure desirable driving outcomes. We introduce GroundAct, which starts from a simple premise: driving unfolds through physical entities and their interactions. Entities therefore become the unit of grounding; a lightweight reference token keeps each selected entity's continuous state addressable through symbolic reasoning; and only the referenced entities' interactions with the evolving proposal correct the plan. The result is an explicit path from what reasoning grounds to what the plan does, which we call grounded planning. To assess its practical value, we evaluate GroundAct in both open- and closed-loop settings. GroundAct shows strong open-loop planning across normal, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical scenarios, with closed-loop results extending this evidence to driving in simulation.

AI.tldr: GroundAct提出以"实体"为 grounding 单元，通过轻量引用 token 让符号推理可持续访问实体连续状态，仅用被引用实体的交互修正规划，实现从推理到规划的显式路径，并在开环与闭环(仿真)驾驶中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 驾驶模型的推理虽日益基于因果、空间结构、感知证据与预测未来，但 groundedness 的定义仍不清晰：推理正确并不能保证理想的驾驶结果。需要明确"当模型最终输出动作时，groundedness 应意味着什么"。
AI.method: GroundAct 基于"驾驶由物理实体及其交互展开"的前提，将实体作为 grounding 单元；使用轻量 reference token 使每个被选实体的连续状态在符号推理过程中保持可寻址；仅由被引用实体与不断演化的 proposal 的交互来修正规划，从而建立从推理依据到规划动作的显式路径(grounded planning)。
AI.result: 在开环设置中，GroundAct 在正常、分布外(OOD)及安全关键场景下均展现强规划表现；闭环仿真结果进一步支持其驾驶有效性。
AI.conclusion: GroundAct 通过以实体为中心的 grounding 与引用机制，将推理与规划显式连接，兼顾忠实性与实际驾驶效果，为 grounded planning 提供了可行范式。

title: Algorithmically Aligned Neural Agglomerative Tree Construction
summary: Linkage algorithms for hierarchical clustering (HC) are a powerful and efficient framework for constructing clustering trees, yet it is often unclear which merge rule best suits a given dataset or task. In contrast, neural approaches can learn from data, but often fail to retain the efficiency and size generalization of classical algorithms. We introduce NN-linkage, a neural network (NN) model that can learn task-specific and locally dependent merge rules while retaining the recursive structure and efficient inference of classical linkage algorithms. In particular, our model is algorithmically aligned with the Lance-Williams (LW) recurrence, a parameterized framework for defining a broad, continuous family of linkage rules for agglomerative HC. Classical methods such as single linkage (SL), complete linkage (CL), and average linkage arise as discrete choices within this broader family. We show that NN-linkage is a universal approximator for continuous linkage functions, including LW recurrences, and, when paired with a transformer encoding, can also approximate globally dependent rules such as robust single-linkage. We further show that NN-linkage can exactly implement any symmetric constant-coefficient LW recurrence across all input sizes. On the empirical front, we evaluate NN-linkage in real-world applications, clock-tree routing and phylogenetic reconstruction, using both synthetic and real datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness over both classical algorithms and other neural approaches. By learning merge rules directly from target trees, NN-linkage extends efficient HC to scientific and engineering objectives not adequately captured by existing hand-designed linkage rules.

AI.tldr: 提出 NN-linkage，一种与 Lance-Williams 递推算法对齐的神经网络模型，可学习任务特定的合并规则，同时保留经典层次聚类的递归结构与高效推理能力，并在时钟树布线、系统发育重建等任务上优于经典和神经方法。
AI.motivation: 层次聚类的链接算法高效强大，但难以判断哪种合并规则适合特定数据集或任务；神经方法虽能学习，却常失去经典算法的高效性与规模泛化能力。
AI.method: NN-linkage 在算法上与 Lance-Williams（LW）递推对齐——LW 是可定义连续链接规则族的参数化框架，单链、全链、平均链等均为其离散特例。该模型学习任务特定且局部依赖的合并规则，保留递归结构与高效推理；搭配 transformer 编码还可逼近全局依赖规则（如鲁棒单链）。
AI.result: 理论上证明 NN-linkage 是连续链接函数（含 LW 递推）的通用逼近器，可精确实现任意对称常系数 LW 递推（所有输入规模）；实验上在时钟树布线与系统发育重建的合成及真实数据集上，效果优于经典算法和其他神经方法。
AI.conclusion: NN-linkage 通过直接从目标树学习合并规则，将高效层次聚类扩展到现有手工设计链接规则无法充分捕捉的科学与工程目标。

title: Image-Space Refraction Correction for Underwater 3D Reconstruction: Warping Flat-Port Views into Pinhole Perspective
summary: Consumer-grade cameras in flat-port housings are widely used for underwater exploration and mapping of coral reefs and seafloor habitats due to their low cost and accessibility. However, refraction at flat-port interfaces causes bowl-shaped deformation in reconstructed scenes and camera trajectories, compromising the metric accuracy required for mapping and navigation. To remove the dominant refractive distortion before reconstruction, we introduce a physics-based refraction correction in image space. Our method is downstream-agnostic: the refraction-corrected images can be directly used as input to existing reconstruction and SLAM algorithms. We characterize the refractive distortion through ray-tracing simulations and validate our correction on two real underwater datasets with differing scene structures. Compared with conventional and refractive Structure-from-Motion (SfM), our approach removes reconstruction deformation while registering more frames and maintaining low reprojection error. The correction further generalizes across diverse reconstruction and VSLAM backends, demonstrating its broad applicability to downstream vision pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于物理的、图像空间的水下折射校正方法，消除平端口相机折射导致的碗状畸变，可直接接入现有SfM/SLAM流程。
AI.motivation: 消费级相机加平端口外壳广泛用于水下珊瑚礁与海床测绘，但平端口界面折射会造成重建场景和相机轨迹呈碗状变形，破坏测绘与导航所需的度量精度。现有方法在重建中处理折射，难以作为通用预处理对接下游算法。
AI.method: 在图像空间进行基于物理的折射校正：通过光线追踪仿真刻画折射畸变，直接对图像做校正，使校正后图像可作输入送入已有重建与SLAM算法（下游无关）。在两组场景结构不同的真实水下数据集上验证。
AI.result: 相比传统SfM和折射SfM，方法在消除重建变形的同时配准更多帧，并保持较低重投影误差；校正可泛化到多种重建与VSLAM后端。
AI.conclusion: 该图像空间折射校正能有效去除主要折射畸变、恢复度量精度，并具备良好的下游通用性，适用于广泛的水下视觉管线。

title: Memory Depth and Reconstructed Context Width: A Controlled Evaluation of Hierarchical Retrieval
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the PALM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Long-term conversational memory is becoming an integral component of modern LLM systems. Proposed architectures group records by topics and events, construct hierarchies and graphs, and connect facts through causal and temporal relations. We experimentally study the interaction between two memory parameters: structural depth and the width of context supplied to the answer model. Using EverMemBench, we evaluate depths D1-D4, core budgets of 1,024/2,048/4,096 tokens, and additional Production and Oracle conditions up to the full archive. Increasing width from 1K to 4K improves Accuracy by 10.11-17.98 percentage points, whereas increasing depth provides no monotonic gain. Beyond 8-16K, Production performance reaches a plateau while tokens per correct answer continue to increase; Oracle preserves quality on full archives of 68-71K tokens. These results motivate further investigation of large, coherent context blocks instead of progressively deeper memory structures.

AI.tldr: 研究长期对话记忆的两个参数（结构深度与上下文宽度）的交互作用，发现增大上下文宽度显著提升准确率，而增大结构深度无单调增益，建议关注大块连贯上下文而非更深记忆结构。
AI.motivation: 长期对话记忆已成为现代LLM系统的重要组成部分，现有架构通过主题/事件分组、构建层级与图结构、用因果与时间关系连接事实。作者想实验探究记忆结构深度与供给答案模型的上下文宽度之间的交互作用。
AI.method: 使用EverMemBench评测，测试深度D1-D4、核心预算1,024/2,048/4,096 token，以及Production和Oracle条件（直至完整档案，达68-71K token）。
AI.result: 宽度从1K增至4K使准确率提升10.11-17.98个百分点；深度增加无单调增益。超过8-16K后，Production性能进入平台期，但每个正确答案的token数持续增加；Oracle在完整档案（68-71K token）上仍保持质量。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持进一步研究大型连贯上下文块，而非逐步加深的记忆结构。

title: A Systematic Investigation of Bias in Large Language Models for Advertising Relevance
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to judge how well an advertisement matches a query, but the fairness of these judgments has received limited attention. We conduct a systematic study of fairness in relevance judgments made by LLMs for queries and advertisements. Our counterfactual framework examines the effects of advertiser identity and possible popularity, input language, and demographic wording. We study GPT-4o as a categorical relevance judge and a Qwen-7B model trained specifically for relevance prediction. The advertiser and language experiments use query and advertisement pairs sampled from real advertising logs. Controlled synthetic queries are used to study demographic associations in employment, housing, and credit. For both models, changing the advertiser identity or input language can alter the relevance assessment. Selected demographic comparisons also show patterns consistent with common stereotypes, particularly those involving gender and occupation. We further study mitigation during model inference and training. The results indicate that its effectiveness depends on whether advertiser information is relevant to the query and how advertiser labels are distributed in the training data. These findings can help advertising practitioners identify fairness risks and develop suitable mitigation methods for LLM relevance systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究LLM广告相关性判断中的公平性问题，考察广告商身份、语言、人口统计措辞对GPT-4o和Qwen-7B判断的影响，并探讨缓解方法。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于判断广告与查询的匹配度，但其判断的公平性关注不足，存在偏见风险。
AI.method: 提出反事实框架，检验广告商身份、流行度、输入语言和人口统计措辞的影响；用真实广告日志采样及受控合成查询（就业、住房、信贷）；研究推理和训练阶段的缓解措施。
AI.result: 两个模型的相关性评估会因广告商身份或语言改变而变化；部分人口统计比较呈现与性别、职业刻板印象一致的模式；缓解效果取决于广告商信息是否与查询相关及训练数据的标签分布。
AI.conclusion: 研究帮助广告从业者识别公平性风险，并为LLM相关性系统开发合适的缓解方法。

title: Lock-in EP: An In-Situ Training Algorithm for Oscillatory Hardware
summary: Analog hardware platforms offer the potential to reduce energy consumption over digital architectures, but in order to succeed, large-scale analog systems must also be able to operate with or recover from the variability of their components. Towards this goal, we derive and demonstrate the lock-in equilibrium propagation (LIEP) training method. LIEP provides local gradient information for each component in an oscillatory network without separate forward and backward sweeps, potentially allowing for in-situ learning capabilities on analog oscillatory hardware platforms. We demonstrate that LIEP can be used both for ab-initio training as well as recovering performance when pre-trained parameters are perturbed. We show that LIEP can be formulated as a three-factor update rule, and suggest that although the method is currently only validated on shallow networks, alternate architectures may allow it to extend to deep and large-scale networks addressing complex tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并验证了锁相平衡传播（LIEP）训练方法，为振荡网络中的每个元件提供局部梯度信息，无需独立的前向和反向扫描，有望在模拟振荡硬件上实现原位学习，并具备从元件扰动中恢复性能的能力。
AI.motivation: 模拟硬件平台有望比数字架构降低能耗，但要在大规模系统中成功应用，必须能够应对并恢复元件变异性的影响。因此需要一种适合模拟振荡硬件、支持原位学习的训练方法。
AI.method: 论文推导并展示了锁相平衡传播（LIEP）训练方法。该方法在振荡网络中为每个元件提供局部梯度信息，无需单独的前向与反向扫描，并可表述为三因子更新规则。
AI.result: LIEP 可用于从头训练（ab-initio training），也能在预训练参数受到扰动时恢复性能。目前该方法仅在浅层网络上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: LIEP 为实现模拟振荡硬件的原位学习提供了可行途径，并具备容错与恢复能力；未来通过替代架构设计，可能将其扩展到深层和大规模网络以处理复杂任务。

title: Geometry-Constrained Bidirectional Point Cloud Registration for Thin, Sheet-Like Heritage Artifacts
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in ACM Journal on Computing and Cultural Heritage
summary: Non-contact three-dimensional reconstruction of thin, sheet-like heritage artifacts poses significant geometric and registration challenges. Due to their fragility, these artifacts cannot be suspended or equipped with artificial markers, necessitating independent acquisition of their front and back surfaces. Subsequent registration proves difficult due to the limited number of shared geometric features and the scarcity of explicit physical constraints, which may result in rotational ambiguity, instability, and structural collapse during iterative optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a geometry-constrained bidirectional point cloud registration method specifically tailored for thin, sheet-like heritage artifacts. The method integrates semantic-guided preprocessing, Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-based geometric normalization, and a thickness-aware registration strategy. The estimated physical thickness is incorporated as a geometric constraint to preserve structural integrity during registration. Rotational ambiguity is resolved by evaluating a finite set of global rotation hypotheses, each refined using the point-to-plane Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm, with the optimal transformation selected via a geometry-aware fitness criterion consistent with the thickness scale. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves competitive or improved performance in most cases, particularly in projected area consistency and physically plausible front-back alignment. In addition, the thickness-aware constraint and rotation hypothesis evaluation reduce the risk of degenerate configurations in which the two surfaces are incorrectly flipped while still yielding deceptively acceptable numerical scores, supporting reliable non-contact digitization of delicate and thin heritage artifacts. Implementation details are available at https://zyz-nwpu.github.io/GCBPCR/.

AI.tldr: 提出几何约束的双向点云配准方法，用于薄片状文物的非接触三维重建。
AI.motivation: 薄片状文物脆弱，无法悬挂或加标记，正反面需独立采集；共享几何特征少、缺乏物理约束，导致旋转歧义、配准不稳定甚至结构坍塌。
AI.method: 结合语义引导预处理、基于PCA的几何归一化和厚度感知配准策略；将估计的物理厚度作为几何约束保持结构完整；通过评估有限全局旋转假设解决旋转歧义，每个假设用点到面ICP细化，并以与厚度尺度一致的几何感知适应度准则选最优变换。
AI.result: 在多数情况下达到有竞争力或更优的性能，尤其在投影面积一致性和物理合理的前后对齐方面表现突出；厚度感知约束与旋转假设评估降低了正反面错误翻转但数值得分看似可接受的退化配置风险。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持精细薄片状文物的可靠非接触数字化，实现细节见 https://zyz-nwpu.github.io/GCBPCR/。

title: Language Unalignability: Why Some Concepts Resist Cross-Cultural Benchmark Evaluation
comment: Position paper. 32 pages (10 pages main text), 6 figures, 12 tables
summary: Current evaluation of multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) rests on an implicit Translation-Isomorphism Assumption (TIA): that semantic structures across languages are congruent and mutually mappable without loss of information. We argue that this assumption is not merely violated in practice, but ill-posed in principle for a typologically identifiable class of concepts, including pragmatic markers, honorifics, and diachronically stratified terms. We formalize this failure using a usage-cloud framework, representing concepts as point sets of contextualized embeddings. We define $α$-unalignability as the impossibility of any mapping that simultaneously preserves lexical faithfulness (centroid correspondence) and structural faithfulness (local neighborhood topology). We provide three layers of evidence. Behaviorally, we show that FLORES-200 translation failures are predicted by language family and resource class but not by script, and that LOBSTER reasoning scores vary by family. Mechanistically, we report a Representation-Intervention Gap (RIG) in a nine-model case study on Yami: the models' activations encode a regularity along which Yami groups with other low-resource and Austronesian languages, yet interventions on language-specific neurons show no demonstrated advantage over random masks: the regularity is visible but not usable by this intervention. Finally, we operationalize these findings into a multidimensional diagnostic profile: Cycle-Consistency, Pragmatic-Load Disagreement, Manifold-Curvature Mismatch, and RIG. We argue that collapsing cultural competence into a single scalar incentivizes "probabilistic flattening," and that recognizing the unalignable class is a precondition for AI that respects, rather than erases, cultural divergence. This suggests that multilingual alignment is not a single well-defined objective, but a set of mutually incompatible projections.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑多语言LLM评估中隐含的"翻译同构假设"(TIA)，证明对语用标记、敬语、历时分层词等概念，语义结构跨语言不可无损对齐，并形式化定义了α-不可对齐性，提供行为、机制、诊断三层证据。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言LLM评估默认不同语言的语义结构一致且可无损互映射(TIA)，但该假设对特定类型学概念在实践中被违反、在原理上本就不成立，需要被明确识别和形式化。
AI.method: 提出usage-cloud框架，将概念表示为上下文化嵌入的点集；定义α-不可对齐性，即不存在同时保持词汇忠实性(质心对应)与结构忠实性(局部邻域拓扑)的映射。证据分为三层：行为层(FLORES-200翻译失败与LOBSTER推理得分)、机制层(九模型Yami案例的表示-干预鸿沟RIG)、诊断层(四维诊断画像)。
AI.result: 行为上，翻译失败由语系和资源类别预测而非文字系统；LOBSTER得分因语系而异。机制上，RIG显示模型激活沿规律将Yami与低资源及南岛语系语言归组，但对语言特异神经元的干预相对随机掩码无优势，规律可见却不可用。诊断上提出循环一致性、语用负载分歧、流形曲率失配、RIG四个指标。
AI.conclusion: 将文化能力压缩为单一标量会激励"概率扁平化"；承认不可对齐类概念是让AI尊重而非抹除文化差异的前提。多语言对齐并非单一明确目标，而是一组互不兼容的投影。

title: Decoupled Multi-Agent Orchestration
summary: Learned orchestration can automatically construct effective language-model multi-agent systems, but existing approaches couple planning to fixed worker pools and train decomposition and collaboration from the same terminal outcome, limiting transfer and obscuring credit assignment. We introduce DeOrch, which separates worker-agnostic planning from concrete worker selection. Its two-stage planner first decomposes the task without worker information, then chooses collaboration operations using compact, worker-identity-free matchability feedback from the pool, enabling conditional credit assignment to decomposition and collaboration decisions. A lightweight matcher estimates worker suitability from behavior on a fixed probe set and adapts online with a contextual bandit, allowing new workers to be incorporated without retraining the planner or matcher. Across diverse in- and out-of-distribution tasks, DeOrch outperforms prior automatic MAS orchestration methods with fewer worker calls than competing learned orchestrators, remains effective when transferred to an entirely unseen worker pool without retraining, and shows consistent gains from both components.

AI.tldr: DeOrch 将多智能体编排解耦为“与工人无关的任务分解”和“具体工人选择”两阶段，实现条件信用分配并支持无重训练迁移到新工人池。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式多智能体编排将规划与固定工人池耦合，且用同一终端结果训练分解与协作，导致迁移性差、信用分配不清。
AI.method: 两阶段规划器：先不依赖工人信息分解任务，再基于紧凑且不含工人身份的 matchability 反馈选择协作操作；轻量 matcher 用固定探针集评估工人适配度，并通过上下文老虎机在线自适应。
AI.result: 在多样域内与分布外任务上优于已有自动 MAS 编排方法，工人调用次数更少；可无重训练迁移到全新工人池；两组件均带来稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: 解耦规划与工人选择是实现可迁移、可解释信用分配且高效的多智能体编排的有效途径。

title: FlexiFlow: Bandit-based Model Switching in ML Workflows
summary: Model optimizations help improve inference performance and accuracy of ML workflows. However, relying on a single model to perform inference across all data batches often fails to maximize accuracy and thus overall performance. In many cases, alternate models could perform better on specific subsets of data where a primary model underperforms. Our experiments with real ML workflows indeed show that switching models improves workflow accuracy by up to 23%. Yet, current systems lack the ability to adaptively switch between models based on performance, forcing users to manually test models in sequence. We present FlexiFlow, a dataflow system that dynamically switches between alternate models when the current model exhibits low accuracy. FlexiFlow learns to rank models using a novel multi-armed bandit approach that accounts for model runtimes, probability of passing user-defined assertions, and the computational structure of the ML workflow. We show that the standard Thompson sampling approach is insufficient for switching models in ML workflows. In contrast, our proposed approaches are effective and scales to complex real-world ML workflows. Experiments show that switching models at runtime while reusing intermediate results provides higher accuracy, but also 48% efficiency gain compared to sequential workflow runs.

AI.tldr: FlexiFlow 是一个数据流系统，能在当前模型精度低时动态切换备选模型。它采用多臂老虎机方法对模型排序，考虑运行时间、通过用户断言的概率及工作流计算结构，相比顺序执行提升精度并带来48%效率增益。
AI.motivation: 单一模型对所有数据批次推理无法最大化精度和整体性能，某些备选模型在特定数据子集上表现更好。实验显示切换模型可使工作流精度提升最多23%，但现有系统无法自适应切换，用户只能手动依次测试模型。
AI.method: 提出 FlexiFlow 数据流系统，当当前模型精度低时动态切换备选模型。核心是一种新颖的多臂老虎机方法，用于学习模型排序，综合考虑模型运行时间、通过用户定义断言的概率以及 ML 工作流的计算结构。并指出标准 Thompson 采样方法不适用于此场景。
AI.result: 实验表明，运行时切换模型并复用中间结果可提高精度，同时相比顺序工作流运行带来48%的效率提升；所提方法有效且可扩展到复杂的真实 ML 工作流。
AI.conclusion: FlexiFlow 通过自适应模型切换和中间结果复用，同时改善 ML 工作流的精度与效率，适用于复杂真实场景。

title: Efficient Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression with Standard Video Codecs
summary: This paper presents a novel effective Gaussian Splatting (GS) sequence Compression method that utilizes the Video codec (GSCV). Existing video-based GS sequence compression relies on the Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting (PLAS) and tracked primitive information to convert GS into smooth 2D videos. However, tracked information is not available for most practical applications, and without it, using the vanilla PLAS can generate images exhibiting weak inter-frame correlation, due to its stochastic nature. GSCV incorporates a simple yet efficient Inter-PLAS method to produce close images between the I- and P-frames of GS, enhancing the inter-frame performance of video codec greatly. GSCV also realizes a new pipeline based on the state-of-the-art video codecs with high bit-depth GS images, achieving higher compressibility while simultaneously providing a higher quality upper bound. Experimental results show that the proposed GSCV exhibits obviously improved performance over MPEG video and point cloud-based anchors in GS sequence compression. The code is available at https://github.com/Qi-Yangsjtu/GSCV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GSCV，一种基于视频编解码器的高斯泼溅（GS）序列压缩方法，通过引入Inter-PLAS和基于高比特深度GS图像的新流程，显著提升压缩性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频的GS序列压缩依赖PLAS和跟踪图元信息，但跟踪信息在多数实际应用中不可得；缺少该信息时，原始PLAS因其随机性会导致帧间相关性弱，压缩性能差。
AI.method: GSCV引入简单高效的Inter-PLAS方法，使GS在I帧与P帧之间生成接近的图像，增强视频编解码器的帧间性能；并基于最先进视频编解码器与高比特深度GS图像实现新流程，提升可压缩性与质量上限。
AI.result: 实验表明，GSCV在GS序列压缩上相较MPEG视频和点云基准方法均有明显性能提升。
AI.conclusion: GSCV无需跟踪信息即可有效压缩GS序列，性能优于现有基准，代码已开源。

title: Foresight-over-Graph: Reasoning Beyond Local Horizons for Knowledge Base Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in question answering, yet they still frequently suffer from hallucinations on knowledge-intensive tasks. Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide LLMs with structured, interpretable, and updatable factual grounding, making them a promising external knowledge source for reliable reasoning. However, existing LLM-guided graph reasoning methods typically rely on hop-wise greedy or beam-style pruning during evidence retrieval. Such local decision processes are inherently myopic: evidence that appears weak near the source may become crucial only after deeper graph context is explored, causing answer-critical branches to be discarded prematurely and making the reasoning chain difficult to recover. To address this limitation, we propose Foresight-over-Graph (FoG), a foresight-aware evidence retrieval framework for knowledge base question answering (KBQA). FoG iteratively constructs a question-relevant evidence subgraph and uses far-to-near feedback to guide path exploration, and maintains a compact memory subgraph to support continued exploration. Extensive experiments on widely used KBQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a particularly large improvement of 16.58% in Hit on CWQ, while also reducing LLM calls and token usage. Our code is available at https://github.com/yhong7/FoG .

AI.tldr: 提出FoG框架，用远到近反馈引导知识图谱证据检索，缓解局部贪心剪枝的短视问题，在KBQA上取得SOTA，CWQ的Hit提升16.58%，并减少LLM调用与token消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM在知识密集型任务中易产生幻觉，知识图谱可提供结构化事实支撑；但现有LLM引导的图推理多在证据检索时采用逐跳贪心或束搜索剪枝，这种局部决策具有短视性，会过早丢弃近源看似弱、深层上下文中却关键的证据分支，导致推理链难以恢复。
AI.method: FoG（Foresight-over-Graph）：一个面向KBQA的预见性证据检索框架。迭代构建与问题相关的证据子图；利用远到近（far-to-near）反馈引导路径探索；维护紧凑的记忆子图以支撑持续探索。
AI.result: 在常用KBQA基准上达到SOTA，CWQ上Hit提升达16.58%，同时减少LLM调用次数与token用量。
AI.conclusion: 通过远到近反馈的预见性检索，可有效克服局部剪枝的短视问题，提升KBQA性能并降低推理成本，代码已开源。

title: Navigating Route Latent Space for Synthesizable Molecular Design
summary: Goal-directed molecular design has advanced rapidly, yet a substantial proportion of designed molecules remain difficult to synthesize in practice, limiting their real-world utility. Prior synthesizability-aware methods either project generated molecules back to synthesizable analogs that deviate from the intended target, or optimize directly in discrete synthesis spaces that lack a continuous landscape for efficient search. We argue that this limitation mainly comes from the search space rather than the optimizer. To address this, we propose RouteFlow, a framework that reformulates synthesizable molecular design as a search over a continuous route latent space, where each latent maps back to a complete synthesis route and synthesizability is inherently preserved. To navigate this space, we adopt reward-guided flow matching as an efficient sampler that steers toward high-property regions. Since reward optimization may push latents off the manifold of real synthesis routes, where decoding becomes unreliable, we further introduce a cycle-consistency mechanism to stabilize fine-tuning. Across 16 optimization tasks from Therapeutic Data Commons, RouteFlow achieves the best sample efficiency among synthesizability-aware baselines, with the best synthetic accessibility and the highest retrosynthesis success rate. Our results also confirm that the proposed cycle-consistency reliably keeps optimization on-manifold while improving target properties, supporting effective synthesizable molecular discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出RouteFlow，将可合成分子设计重新表述为连续合成路线隐空间搜索，配合奖励引导流匹配与循环一致性机制，在16个TDC任务上实现最佳样本效率、可合成性与逆合成成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有可合成性感知方法的问题：将生成分子投影回可合成类似物会偏离目标；直接在离散合成空间中优化则缺乏连续地形，难以高效搜索。作者认为瓶颈在于搜索空间而非优化器。
AI.method: RouteFlow框架：把可合成分子设计建模为连续"路线隐空间"上的搜索，每个隐向量映射回完整合成路线，从本质上保证可合成性。采用奖励引导的流匹配作为高效采样器，引导向高性质区域。由于奖励优化可能使隐向量偏离真实合成路线流形导致解码不可靠，引入循环一致性机制稳定微调。
AI.result: 在Therapeutic Data Commons的16个优化任务上，RouteFlow在可合成性感知基线中取得最佳样本效率、最佳合成可及性与最高逆合成成功率。结果还证实循环一致性可靠地保持优化在流形上，同时提升目标性质。
AI.conclusion: 通过将搜索空间转为连续合成路线隐空间并配以奖励引导流匹配与循环一致性，可有效实现可合成分子发现，兼顾目标性质优化与合成可行性。

title: ATLAS-AL: Adaptive Trust-Region for Latent Adversarial Searches via Active Learning
comment: 9 pages main body, plus 10 additional pages for references and appendix
summary: Security evaluation of learning-based systems requires more than just testing the system against a fixed collection of attacks. It requires adaptive mechanisms that can efficiently discover \textit{sets} of inputs that induce model failure. We introduce ATLAS (Adaptive Trust-Regions for Latent Adversarial Searches), which is a query-based framework that discovers adversarial input sets for black-box learning systems. ATLAS casts attack generation as an active learning level set estimation problem then combines calibrated approximations with a local-global sampling architecture to find regions of the input space that contain adversarial examples. Once discovered, ATLAS is designed to sample points within these adversarial regions to build adversarial sets that accurately represent the state of robustness of the target model. When applied on toy experiments, we find that ATLAS is able to recover more of the adversarial region under a limited query budget than does previous work. When applied to standard and adversarially trained MNIST, CIFAR, and ImageNet model targets, ATLAS produces better representative attacks than other query-based black-box attacks (NES, SignHunter, BayesOpt). ATLAS represents an automated red-teaming framework that can be used for both analyzing the robustness of learning-based systems under development and continuous auditing to see how the robustness of a system changes over time.

AI.tldr: ATLAS：一种基于查询的黑盒对抗攻击框架，将攻击生成建模为主动学习水平集估计问题，自适应地发现并采样对抗区域以构建代表性对抗集。
AI.motivation: 传统安全评估仅用固定攻击集测试不足以反映模型鲁棒性，需要自适应机制高效发现能诱发模型失败的输入集合。
AI.method: ATLAS (Adaptive Trust-Regions for Latent Adversarial Searches)：基于查询的黑盒框架，将攻击生成视为主动学习水平集估计，结合校准近似与局部-全局采样架构定位含对抗样本的输入区域，并在区域内采样构建对抗集。
AI.result: 在玩具实验中，有限查询预算下比此前方法覆盖更多对抗区域；在标准和对抗训练的MNIST、CIFAR、ImageNet上，生成的攻击比NES、SignHunter、BayesOpt等查询型黑盒攻击更具代表性。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS是自动化红队框架，可用于开发中系统的鲁棒性分析及持续审计以跟踪鲁棒性随时间的变化。

title: Towards benchmarking Western Bluebird detection in the wild
summary: Bird monitoring in natural environments is challenging due to the small size of some species of birds relative to the scene, background clutter, variability in illumination, and the observers' viewpoint. Progress is further limited by the scarcity of large-scale, realistic datasets, which are essential for understanding behavioral patterns. To address this gap, we introduce a new benchmark dataset for the detection and segmentation of Western bluebirds (Sialia Mexicana), comprising over 6,000 labeled images from 41 recording sessions. The dataset features high-resolution (4K) in-the-wild images in which birds occupy only a small fraction of the image. We evaluated supervised detectors, open-vocabulary models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings, and segmentation approaches. Supervised detectors remain the most reliable overall, with Faster R-CNN achieving the highest detection mAP and RT-DETR offering the best precision-recall trade-off. Open-vocabulary models perform poorly in zero-shot settings; however, fine-tuning substantially improves their performance, with YOLO-World becoming competitive with supervised methods and achieving the highest precision, F1-score, and mAP@0.5. For segmentation, supervised methods significantly outperform Grounded-SAM and SAM 3: Mask R-CNN achieves the highest mask mAP, while YOLOv8-Seg provides the best precision and fastest inference. A diagnostic analysis further shows that failures are not explained by object size alone, but by a combination of apparent scale, brightness, contrast, clutter, blur, crowding, and recording-session variation. Overall, our findings highlight the difficulty of zero-shot bird detection in cluttered ecological scenes and underscore the importance of domain adaptation in small-object settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个西蓝鸲（Sialia Mexicana）检测与分割基准数据集，含6000+张41个录制会话的4K野外图像，系统评估监督检测器、开放词汇模型和分割方法。实验表明监督方法仍最可靠，开放词汇模型零样本表现差但微调后可媲美监督方法，失败原因由表观尺度、亮度、对比度、杂乱、模糊等多因素共同决定。
AI.motivation: 自然环境鸟类监测面临目标小、背景杂乱、光照变化和视角变化等挑战，而大规模真实数据集稀缺，限制了行为模式研究。为填补这一空白，需要构建面向小目标鸟类的基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建超过6000张标注图像、跨41个录制会话的西蓝鸲检测与分割数据集，包含4K野外高分辨率图像且鸟类仅占图像很小比例。评测监督检测器（Faster R-CNN、RT-DETR）、开放词汇模型（零样本与微调，如YOLO-World）及分割方法（Mask R-CNN、YOLOv8-Seg、Grounded-SAM、SAM 3），并进行失败原因的诊断分析。
AI.result: 监督检测器总体最可靠，Faster R-CNN取得最高检测mAP，RT-DETR精度-召回权衡最佳。开放词汇模型零样本表现差，微调后显著提升，YOLO-World具备竞争力并取得最高精度、F1和mAP@0.5。分割方面监督方法显著优于Grounded-SAM和SAM 3：Mask R-CNN掩码mAP最高，YOLOv8-Seg精度最高且推理最快。诊断分析表明失败并非仅由目标尺寸决定，而是表观尺度、亮度、对比度、杂乱、模糊、拥挤和录制会话差异共同作用。
AI.conclusion: 本文凸显了杂乱生态场景中零样本鸟类检测的困难，强调小目标场景下领域自适应的重要性，并为自然环境下鸟类监测提供了有价值的基准与评测参考。

title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Cross-Domain and Multi-Turn Generalization of Latent Underspecification Signals
summary: Large language models routinely answer questions that cannot be answered from the information given, and in dialogue they answer before enough has been said. Unanswerability is linearly decodable from hidden states, but it is unclear which of its forms share a representation and whether the signal is useful in dialogue. We contribute a turn-labeled multi-turn benchmark (423 conversations, 1,661 labeled turn-states) and an evaluation harness with a simulated user who answers clarifying questions, and use them with six datasets and six open-weight LLMs to test how far probes for unanswerability carry. Probes transfer robustly between datasets that share a ground of unanswerability: missing information in math (AUROC 0.77-0.97) and in a passage (SQuAD 2.0<->MuSiQue, 0.77-0.90). Probes for epistemic "known-unknowns" transfer poorly to math, but this separation weakens under lexical controls and changes with layer and coordinate system, so it remains unresolved. Single-turn probes fail zero-shot to detect when a conversation becomes answerable; in-structure probes recover it, but no better than a bag-of-words classifier. A gate on the calibrated probe, with no model fine-tuning, fires on underspecified turns far more precisely than chance, and its end-task success comes within 0.08 of a gate given the true labels. Yet across four models it does not reliably beat vanilla generation or prompted consolidation. The remaining gap lies mostly in how models use a clarification, not in detection.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多轮基准与探测实验，检验"不可回答性"表征的可迁移性及其在对话中的实用性。
AI.motivation: 大模型常回答无法从给定信息中推出的问题，多轮对话中也过早作答。虽然不可回答性可从隐状态线性解码，但其各形式是否共享表征、能否用于对话尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建带轮次标注的多轮基准（423段对话、1,661个标注轮次状态）与含模拟用户澄清问答的评测框架；结合6个数据集与6个开源模型，用探针测试不可回答性的迁移性。
AI.result: 在共享不可回答根据的数据集间探针迁移稳健（数学缺信息AUROC 0.77-0.97；SQuAD 2.0<->MuSiQue 0.77-0.90）。"已知的未知"迁移到数学较差，但该区分在词汇控制下减弱、随层与坐标系变化，仍未定论。单轮探针零样本无法检测对话变可回答；结构内探针可恢复但不优于词袋。校准探针门控精确率远高于随机，端任务成功仅差真标签门控0.08，但四模型中未能稳定超过原生成或提示整合。
AI.conclusion: 主要瓶颈不在检测不可回答性，而在于模型如何利用澄清信息。

title: Unanimously Wrong: Certified Abstention from How Medical LLM Consensus Forms
comment: Accepted at the GenAI4Health Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: In clinical practice, agreement among independent experts is treated as evidence of reliability, and multi-round consensus has become a core mechanism of agentic medical question-answering systems. When such a system must decide whether to trust its own answer, the prevailing signal is again agreement, now among the sampled answers. But agreement is a fragile proxy for correctness. A system can be unanimously wrong, returning the same incorrect answer on every sample, and on these questions agreement-based signals carry no information. The cause is that these signals read only the final state of the consensus and discard how it was reached. Agreement that was reached by resolving disagreement with evidence looks identical, at the end, to agreement that was present from the first sample because every sample shares one misconception. ProbeGuard is a certified abstention framework that bases the abstention decision on how the consensus formed. Process features trace agreement trajectories, minority persistence, and retrieval saturation. For unanimous votes, rationale semantic entropy checks whether the reasons behind the vote cohere, and an active probe retrieves counter-evidence and measures whether the consensus survives. A stratified Learn-then-Test calibration then converts these scores into a distribution-free bound on selective risk. We evaluate ProbeGuard on three medical QA benchmarks and a hard-frontier reference, with a published multi-round agentic RAG substrate, against six abstention baselines. On MedQA, 13.4% of unanimous votes are wrong, and no agreement-based signal can flag them. Process signals raise the discrimination of correct from incorrect consensus from chance to 0.696 AUROC. The certified rule answers six in ten unanimous-layer questions at an observed selective risk of 9.0%, and nine in ten once in-domain calibration data accumulate.

AI.tldr: ProbeGuard是一个"认证弃答"框架，通过分析共识的形成过程（而非只看最终一致性）来判断医学问答系统是否应信任自己的答案，在三个医学QA基准上显著优于六种弃答基线。
AI.motivation: 临床实践中，"专家间一致性"被视为可靠性证据，多轮共识成为代理式医学问答系统的核心机制。当系统需要判断是否信任自己的答案时，采用的信号仍是"一致性"（采样答案间的一致）。但一致性是正确性的脆弱代理：系统可能"一致地错误"——每次采样都返回同一错误答案，此时基于一致性的信号完全失效。根本原因是这些信号只读取共识的最终状态，丢弃了达成共识的过程。
AI.method:
ProbeGuard基于"共识如何形成"来做弃答决策，包含：
1) 过程特征：追踪一致性轨迹、少数派持续性和检索饱和度；
2) 对全票一致的投票：用理由语义熵检验投票背后理由是否自洽，并通过主动探测检索反证据、测量共识能否存活；
3) 分层Learn-then-Test校准：将上述分数转化为对选择性风险的无分布界。
AI.result: 在三个医学QA基准和一个硬前沿参考集上，基于已发表的多轮代理式RAG基座，与六种弃答基线对比：MedQA上13.4%的全票一致投票是错误的，且无任何基于一致性的信号能标记它们；过程信号将正确与错误共识的区分度从随机水平提升至0.696 AUROC；认证规则回答了六成全票一致层的问题，观测选择性风险为9.0%，当域内校准数据积累后可达九成。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖最终一致性作为可信度信号存在根本缺陷，无法识别"一致地错误"的情形。通过利用共识形成过程的过程特征、语义熵与主动反证探测，并结合无分布风险的认证校准，可有效提升医学问答系统弃答决策的可靠性与覆盖率。

title: Scale-Invariant Training for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are trained on large collections of time series datasets that span various morphologies and domains. This setting exposes models to series whose scales -- typical magnitudes of their values -- can differ substantially. Affine scaling methods such as Reversible Instance Normalization (ReVIN) scale model inputs and reverse the transform before computing the loss. We show that this inversion multiplies each series' gradient by $b^p$ relative to loss on scaled targets, where $b$ is the scaling denominator (e.g., standard deviation) and $p$ is the loss degree. We call this scale-contaminated training (ScaleCon), because the scale of each series consequently becomes an importance weight, causing high-scale series to dominate training. For any scale-equivariant scaler and residual loss that is homogeneous of degree $p$, including MSE, MAE, and Quantile Loss, we prove that computing loss on scaled targets makes every mini-batch gradient and, consequently, the full optimization trajectory invariant to arbitrary independent rescaling of the training series, yielding scale-invariant training (ScaleIn). Notably, existing TSFMs use both objectives, with neither consistent reporting nor a common convention on how to compute training loss. We isolate the convergence disparity induced by ScaleCon and its correction under ScaleIn in controlled studies on synthetic and real data. In pretraining across four TSFM architectures, ScaleIn lowers MASE in all 24 architecture-benchmark comparisons, with average reductions across TSFMs of 18.8% on GIFT-Eval and 21.9% on the M-competitions. The gains extend to supervised neural forecasting, where it lowers MASE in 16 of 20 matched settings. Most existing time series forecasting pipelines can adopt ScaleIn with a one-line code change.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示时间序列基础模型训练中仿射缩放(如ReVIN)反转导致"尺度污染训练"(ScaleCon)：逆变换使梯度被乘以$b^p$，造成高尺度序列主导训练；提出在缩放目标上计算损失的"尺度不变训练"(ScaleIn)，理论证明其令优化轨迹对任意序列缩放不变，并在多种模型与基准上显著降低MASE。
AI.motivation: TSFM在大规模、跨领域时间序列上训练，序列尺度(量级)差异极大。ReVIN等仿射缩放会先缩放输入、再在计算损失前做逆变换，这一反转会引入尺度偏差；且现有TSFM对训练损失计算方式既不一致也无统一约定，训练因此被高尺度序列主导。
AI.method: 作者将逆变换导致每个序列梯度相对缩放目标损失被乘以$b^p$(b为缩放分母如标准差，p为损失次数)的现象命名为ScaleCon。对任意尺度等变缩放器与p次齐次的残差损失(MSE、MAE、Quantile Loss等)，证明在缩放目标上计算损失可使每个mini-batch梯度乃至整条优化轨迹对训练序列的任意独立重缩放不变，即ScaleIn。在合成与真实数据上的受控实验隔离ScaleCon导致的收敛差异及其修正效果。
AI.result: 在四种TSFM架构预训练中，ScaleIn在全部24项架构-基准对比中降低MASE，GIFT-Eval平均降低18.8%，M-competitions平均降低21.9%；在监督式神经预测中，20项匹配设置里16项降低MASE。现有大多数时间序列预测流程仅需一行代码即可采用ScaleIn。
AI.conclusion: ScaleCon是现有TSFM训练中被忽视的尺度偏差来源，会在不同损失计算约定下造成收敛差异；ScaleIn通过一行代码改动即可消除该偏差、实现尺度不变训练，并跨架构与基准稳定提升预测精度。

title: CHARTER: Auditing Reference Substitution in Hierarchical Compact-Evidence Evaluation for Computational Pathology
summary: In digital pathology, compact evidence is often used to explain or audit predictions made by whole-slide image multiple instance learning models. In hierarchical compact-evidence pipelines, candidate filtering introduces a strategy-specific candidate-conditioned prediction alongside the original full-bag prediction. If the evaluation reference changes while the intended target remains the original full-bag prediction, however, not only can the measured fidelity of the same compact evidence change, but comparisons between competing candidate strategies can also change. To make this dependence explicit, we introduce CHARTER, a reference-aware evaluation charter that asks researchers to DECLARE the intended target and reference, QUANTIFY candidate-induced prediction shift, and AUDIT the stability of comparative conclusions. Across the 15 comparisons in our main five-seed Random-K audit, 4 showed determinate reversals; in a matched native-ranking stress test, the ACMIL comparison changed from REVERSED to PRESERVED. CHARTER turns otherwise implicit candidate-filtering and reference choices into an auditable evaluation specification, helping distinguish genuine preservation of the intended prediction from apparent gains induced by changing the prediction being explained.

AI.tldr: 提出CHARTER评估框架，明确候选过滤与参考选择对紧凑证据保真度及策略比较的影响。
AI.motivation: 数字病理中，紧凑证据用于解释WSI-MIL模型预测；但分层紧凑证据流程的候选过滤会引入候选条件下的预测，若评估参考改变而目标仍为原始全袋预测，保真度测量及候选策略比较结论可能变化。
AI.method: CHARTER要求研究者：DECLARE意图目标与参考；QUANTIFY候选引起的预测偏移；AUDIT比较结论的稳定性。采用五个随机种子的Random-K审计（15组比较）及匹配的原生排序压力测试。
AI.result: 15组比较中4组出现确定性反转；在匹配原生排序压力测试中，ACMIL比较从REVERSED变为PRESERVED。
AI.conclusion: CHARTER将隐式的候选过滤与参考选择转化为可审计的评估规范，有助于区分意图预测的真实保持与因改变被解释预测而产生的表面增益。

title: Rethinking Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation: From Alignment Coverage to Supervision Reliability
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations using teacher feedback. With different tokenizers, comparing teacher and student predictions requires alignment at both sequence and vocabulary levels. In this paper, we examine whether expanding this alignment coverage improves learning. Across three heterogeneous teacher--student pairs on mathematical reasoning and code generation, strict 1:1 groups already cover most student-generated tokens despite substantial vocabulary mismatch. On responses sampled from the students before distillation, the shared vocabulary retains nearly all teacher and student probability mass at strictly aligned positions on average. Restricting reverse KL to a student-selected top-16 subset of the shared vocabulary at each strict position achieves accuracy comparable to full shared-vocabulary OPD, outperforming the evaluated cross-tokenizer baselines. Adding mean squared error supervision on span log-probabilities in mismatch groups gives complete supervision coverage, yet reduces accuracy. At checkpoints from training with only the strict loss, the span gradients show weak or negative directional agreement with the strict gradients and grow in magnitude relative to them. These diagnostics may help explain the accuracy drop from adding span supervision. Our findings motivate a shift from maximizing alignment coverage to prioritizing supervision reliability: compact supervision at strict positions can be more effective than broader coverage that introduces weakly aligned or conflicting training signals.

AI.tldr: 在跨分词器的On-Policy Distillation中，严格1:1对齐位置已覆盖大部分学生生成的token和概率质量；在严格位置对共享词表做top-16的reverse KL即可媲美全词表OPD，而增加span级MSE监督反而降低准确率。
AI.motivation: 跨分词器场景下，教师与学生预测的对齐需在序列和词表两个层面进行；作者想检验"扩大对齐覆盖范围"是否真的能提升学习效果。
AI.method: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上使用三组异构教师-学生配对，比较严格1:1对齐、共享词表对齐、span级MSE补全覆盖等不同对齐覆盖策略，并分析span梯度与strict梯度的方向一致性。
AI.result: 严格1:1组已覆盖大部分学生生成token；共享词表在严格对齐位置保留了几乎全部师生概率质量；严格位置共享词表top-16的reverse KL即可达到全共享词表OPD的准确率并优于跨分词器基线；加入span log-prob的MSE监督实现全覆盖却降低准确率，其span梯度与strict梯度方向弱一致甚至负一致且幅度增大。
AI.conclusion: 应从"最大化对齐覆盖"转向"优先保证监督可靠性"：在严格对齐位置进行紧凑监督，可能比引入弱对齐或冲突信号的更广覆盖更有效。

title: Cooperating with Future Collaborators: Multi-Agent RL under Staggered Participation
summary: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents are often trained under concurrent participation, while in many tasks some agents act earlier and leave task-relevant information that becomes useful to agents participating later. We study this setting as staggered participation (SP), which introduces a cross-time, cross-agent learning dependency because an early action may affect the return through the information it provides and the later policy that uses it. Learning under SP therefore requires both identifying what information is useful for future decisions and learning how later agents should use it. We propose Staggered Participation Learning (SPL), a training-time augmentation that addresses these two parts with prospective acquisition supervision for earlier agents and outcome-supervised receiver learning for later agents. We evaluate SPL across multiple policy-based MARL backbones, environments, and staggered-participation patterns. Across 60 MPE/RWARE backbone setting comparisons, SPL achieves higher observed mean task completion in every case, with an average difference of 14.1%. The gains also extend to eight-agent teams and a physics-based UAV-UGV environment in Isaac Lab, providing evidence across algorithmic, temporal, and embodied settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Staggered Participation Learning (SPL)，针对多智能体强化学习中的错峰参与（SP）场景，通过前瞻性获取监督和结果监督的接收者学习两个机制，解决跨时间、跨智能体的学习依赖问题，在60个设置对比中平均任务完成率提升14.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有合作MARL通常假设智能体同时参与训练，但许多任务中部分智能体提前行动并留下对后续智能体有用的信息，形成跨时间、跨智能体的学习依赖：早期动作的回报取决于其提供的信息及后续策略如何使用该信息。这一错峰参与（SP）场景下的学习机制尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 提出SPL训练时增强方法，包含两部分：(1) 对早期智能体的前瞻性获取监督（prospective acquisition supervision），识别对未来决策有用的信息；(2) 对后续智能体的结果监督接收者学习（outcome-supervised receiver learning），学习如何利用这些信息。
AI.result: 在60个MPE/RWARE骨干设置对比中，SPL全部取得更高的平均任务完成率，平均提升14.1%；增益还扩展到八智能体团队及Isaac Lab中的物理UAV-UGV环境，验证了在算法、时间和具身设置上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SPL能有效应对错峰参与下的跨时间跨智能体学习依赖，在多种策略型MARL骨干、环境和错峰模式上均表现出一致提升，具备跨设置的可扩展性与泛化能力。

title: Structuring MoE Expert Selection for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents are frequently implemented using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, yet the co-design of agentic behavior and MoE structures remains underexplored. In this work, we comprehensively study the connections between agentic post-training and MoE expert selection. In off-the-shelf MoE models, we observe expert selection exhibits a specialized structure that naturally aligns with agentic trajectories. Specifically, expert routing overlaps more between turns where the agent performs semantically similar operations (e.g., READ, UPDATE) than between turns with differing operations. However, standard RL algorithms ignore this specialization, allowing the MoE routing to go uncontrolled during training, which empirically limit task performance and inference efficiency. To address this, we introduce a hierarchical routing control framework for agentic tasks. We explicitly encourage turn-level expert selections to align with agentic operations while regularizing token-level expert selections to maintain local consistency. To resolve stability issues that arise during post-training with the proposed methods, we further introduce an entropy-gated control mechanism. Overall, our routing control framework achieves over 10-point improvements in success rate on all evaluated benchmarks. These results demonstrate that agentic trajectory structure provides an effective signal for optimizing MoE capacity during RL post-training.

AI.tldr: 研究agentic后训练与MoE专家选择的关联，提出分层路由控制框架，成功率达10+点提升。
AI.motivation: 长程LLM agent常用稀疏MoE模型，但agent行为与MoE结构的联合设计鲜有探索。作者发现现成MoE的专家选择存在与agent轨迹自然对齐的专门化结构（语义相似操作如READ/UPDATE的轮次间路由重叠更高），而标准RL忽略此结构导致路由失控，损害任务性能与推理效率。
AI.method: 提出分层路由控制框架：在轮次级别显式鼓励专家选择与agent操作对齐，在token级别正则化专家选择以保持局部一致性；并引入熵门控控制机制以解决后训练中的稳定性问题。
AI.result: 在所有评测基准上成功率提升超过10个百分点。
AI.conclusion: agent轨迹结构为RL后训练中优化MoE容量提供了有效信号。

title: CueRator: Agentic Search for Symbolic Rules to Adapt Frozen Multimodal Encoders
summary: Large language model agents have been used to search over symbolic structures such as programs and equations. We propose CueRator, an agentic framework for policy-aware decision-rule discovery, which adapts frozen contrastive multimodal encoders by searching for the decision rule that converts their cross-modal similarities into predictions. We validate it on open-vocabulary audio-visual event perception, where existing methods involve a trade-off between adaptivity and generalization to unseen categories: trained modules adapt at the cost of generalization, and fixed rules the reverse. The framework pairs a symbolic formulation for generalization with a lightweight policy that predicts its parameters per video for adaptivity. A report-guided multi-agent loop discovers the formulation offline, evaluating each candidate on its expressive ceiling and on whether a trained policy can realize it. On OV-AVEBench, CueRator raises the total average from 57.8 to 60.2 and unseen-category performance from 55.8 to 59.9 over the best existing method, reducing the seen-unseen gap from 7.1 to 1.2. Ablations attribute the gains to both the formulation and the policy and show that both feedback signals are necessary for effective search. CueRator also improves over the respective baselines on two further audio-visual event perception tasks, and the discovered rule remains competitive across encoders with only the policy retrained. Code is available at https://github.com/cvsp-lab/cuerator.

AI.tldr: CueRator是一个智能体框架，通过搜索将冻结对比多模态编码器的跨模态相似度转化为预测的决策规则，实现策略感知的决策规则发现，在开放词汇音视频事件感知中兼顾适应性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在适应性与对未见类别的泛化之间存在权衡：训练模块牺牲泛化换取适应，固定规则则相反。论文旨在同时兼顾二者。
AI.method: CueRator用符号化公式保证泛化，用轻量级策略为每个视频预测公式参数以增强适应性；通过报告引导的多智能体循环离线发现公式，每个候选依据表达上限和策略可实现性评估。
AI.result: 在OV-AVEBench上，总体平均从57.8提升至60.2，未见类别从55.8提升至59.9，见过-未见过差距从7.1降至1.2。消融表明公式和策略均有贡献且两种反馈信号都必要；另在两个音视频事件感知任务上超越基线。
AI.conclusion: CueRator通过符号公式与策略结合有效解决适应-泛化权衡，发现的规则在仅重训策略时对多种编码器仍具竞争力，代码已开源。

title: LOGIC: An LLM Benchmark for Intent-Grounded Change Impact in Aerospace Electrical Systems
summary: Aerospace electrical-design revisions can contain multiple genuine changes, although an engineering request may authorize only a subset. Propagating every detected difference can therefore produce overly broad impact reports. We present LOGIC, a controlled benchmark and evaluation framework in which locally deployable language models ground a request in a deterministic candidate-change inventory before selected changes are propagated through a typed electrical traceability graph. This separation permits candidate-selection errors to be distinguished from downstream propagation errors. LOGIC contains 168 scenarios, including 144 selection and 24 abstention cases. We evaluate three 7--8B models against intent-agnostic, lexical, and structured-evidence methods, with an oracle-root upper bound. On 96 explicitly anchored selection cases, gate-only structured evidence achieves candidate F1 of 1.0000, compared with 0.9677 for token-lexical matching. On 12 relational-paraphrase cases, token-lexical F1 is 0.1772 and gate-only F1 is 0.0000, compared with 0.5000--0.6400 for the large language models. Model grounding degrades as candidate inventories grow from 4 to 64 changes, while affected-element and typed-path accuracy remain comparatively stable when frozen selections are replayed over graphs of approximately 1K to 100K nodes. Strict evidence gating suppresses false positives but can remove correct semantic selections. An exploratory evidence-empty abstention policy raises strict abstention accuracy to 0.6667 for all three models and reduces unsafe-report rates to 0.1667, while decreasing answerable-case coverage by 16.0--27.1 percentage points. Four of six conflicting requests remain unsafe for each model. These findings support combining literal evidence and language-model reasoning with engineering review when intent cannot be established reliably.

AI.tldr: LOGIC 是一个可控基准与评测框架：语言模型先在确定性的候选变更清单上定位需求（先选后传播），从而将"选择错误"与"下游传播错误"分开评估。
AI.motivation: 航空航天电气设计修订常含多个真实变更，但工程请求可能只授权其中一部分，因此传播所有检测到的差异会产生过于宽泛的影响报告。需要能区分候选选择错误与传播错误、并评估模型在意图不可靠时是否应弃答的框架。
AI.method: LOGIC 让本地可部署语言模型先在确定性候选变更清单上进行 grounded 选择，再经带类型的电气追溯图传播。基准含 168 个场景（144 选择、24 弃答）。评估三个 7–8B 模型，对比 intent-agnostic、token-lexical、structured-evidence 方法，并设 oracle-root 上界。含显式锚定、关系改写、冲突请求等子集；另探索"证据为空即弃答"策略。
AI.result: 96 个显式锚定案例上 gate-only 结构化证据候选 F1 达 1.0000（token-lexical 0.9677）；12 个关系改写案例上 token-lexical F1=0.1772、gate-only=0.0000，而大模型为 0.5000–0.6400。候选清单从 4 增至 64 时模型 grounding 下降，但固定选择在约 1K–100K 节点图上回放时受影响元件与类型化路径准确率较稳定。严格证据门控抑制假阳但会剔除正确语义选择。证据为空弃答策略将严格弃答准确率提至 0.6667，不安全报告率降到 0.1667，但可用案例覆盖率下降 16.0–27.1 个百分点。对抗性(冲突)请求：6 个中仍有 4 个对各模型不安全。
AI.conclusion: 当意图无法可靠确定时，应结合字面证据、语言模型推理与工程人工审查；单一方法（严格门控或纯词法）均不足以保证安全传播。

title: Weight Oracles: Reading Neural Network Weights with Language Models
comment: Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality (NeuralArtifacts), Paris. 14 pages, 10 figures
summary: Interpretability methods for neural networks are predominantly reactive: they analyse activations produced during specific forward passes, requiring known inputs to find hidden capabilities such as backdoors. We propose Weight Oracles, fine-tuned language models that diagnose properties of a target network by reading its raw weights directly, without behavioural testing. We investigate this paradigm in two phases. Phase I establishes feasibility: through a staged curriculum and an external chain-of-computation that delegates parameter-free operations to deterministic code, an explainer LLM learns to simulate the forward pass of small transformers from their weights, achieving 99% holdout accuracy on unseen targets. Phase II repurposes this infrastructure for safety auditing. We train an oracle on natural language diagnostic questions about weight anomalies using only benign pathologies as training signal, and evaluate it zero-shot on backdoors absent from training. The oracle achieves AUROC 0.93 on attention-routed backdoors and 0.81 across a diversified threat distribution including stealth and adversarially regularized variants. Hand-crafted statistical detectors are sharp on the threat models they implicitly target but collapse on threat-model shift, while the oracle remains uniformly competent across attack types. Scaling to realistic model sizes remains the principal open challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"权重预言机"概念，用微调语言模型直接读取目标网络原始权重来诊断其属性（如后门），无需行为测试；在小型Transformer上实现99%前向模拟准确率，并以AUROC 0.93/0.81检测未见过的后门，超越易受威胁模型偏移影响的统计检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络可解释性方法多为反应式，需已知输入并进行前向传播才能发现隐藏能力（如后门）；作者希望探索一种无需行为测试、直接读取权重即可诊断网络属性的新范式。
AI.method: 分两阶段：Phase I通过分阶段课程与外部计算链（将无参数操作交给确定性代码）训练解释器LLM从权重模拟小型Transformer前向传播；Phase II将基础设施用于安全审计，仅用良性病理作为训练信号，训练预言机回答自然语言诊断问题，并在未见过的后门上零样本评估。
AI.result: Phase I在未见目标上达到99%留出准确率；Phase II在注意力路由后门上AUROC 0.93，在含隐蔽及对抗正则化变体的多样化威胁分布上达0.81；手工统计检测器在隐含针对的威胁模型上锐利但在威胁模型偏移时崩溃，而预言机在各攻击类型上表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 权重预言机证明直接读取权重进行诊断是可行的，并在后门审计上展现跨威胁模型的稳健泛化能力；扩展到现实模型规模仍是主要未解挑战。

title: Revar3r: gauge-aware perturbation uncertainty for feed-forward 3d reconstruction
summary: A correctly reconstructed distant point appears uncertain even when a frozen 3D model processes equivalent inputs because its output frame rotates fractionally. This exposes a weakness of trainingfree perturbation uncertainty: when outputs contain an unobserved symmetry, run-to-run variation potentially reflects symmetry rather than error. Existing alternatives have trade-offs: built-in confidence is outperformed in most evaluated conditions, while trained evidential heads require modelspecific supervision. For point maps, this research derives a closed-form, error-independent variance term that grows with scene extent and potentially overwhelms the desired signal. Simulation reproduces the effect; all 30 real VGGT view-sets tested exhibit its predicted $\|x_p\|^2$ signature. ReVar3R robustly registers predictions to a common similarity frame before computing per-point variance, without retraining or modifying the frozen model. Optional calibration and fusion use a held-out split. Across VGGT, π3, and MASt3R on six datasets, the same estimator on every backbone lowers AUSE below built-in confidence in 15 of 18 conditions. The staged evaluation yields 11 of 18 wins for the label-free core, 12/18 for label-free equal-weight fusion, 14/18 with held-out weights, and 15/18 when the built-in signal is included. Against a trained evidential head, the result is a trade-off: the head calibrates magnitude better and leads in its training domain, whereas ReVar3R transfers across backbones without adaptation. Its ranking improves point filtering, but it does not detect stable systematic bias, aid novel-view synthesis, or transfer calibration across domains.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示冻结3D模型（如VGGT）因输出帧的微小旋转对称性导致训练-free不确定度不可靠，并提出ReVar3R：通过将预测配准到共同相似帧后再计算逐点方差，无需重训即可降低AUSE。
AI.motivation: 冻结3D模型处理相同输入时输出帧会有微小旋转，导致远点重建不确定。这暴露了训练-free扰动不确定度的弱点：当输出含未观测对称性时，run-to-run变化可能反映对称性而非误差。现有替代方案有trade-off：内置置信度在多数条件下表现较差，而训练型evidential head需要模型特定监督。
AI.method: 对point maps推导出一个闭式、与误差无关的方差项，该方差随场景范围增长并可能淹没目标信号。ReVar3R在计算逐点方差前，将预测鲁棒地配准到共同相似帧，无需重训或修改冻结模型。可选的校准与融合使用held-out split。
AI.result: 仿真复现该效应；所有30个真实VGGT view-sets均呈现预测的‖x_p‖²特征。在VGGT、π3、MASt3R及六个数据集上，同一估计器在每个backbone上将AUSE降至内置置信度以下达15/18条件。分阶段评估：label-free核心11/18胜，label-free等权融合12/18，held-out权重14/18，加入内置信号15/18。对比训练型evidential head是trade-off：head在幅度校准更好且在其训练域领先，而ReVar3R无需适配即可跨backbone迁移。
AI.conclusion: ReVar3R改善排序，有利于point filtering，但无法检测稳定系统偏差，不能辅助novel-view synthesis，也不能跨域迁移校准。

title: Representation Bias, Correction Transfer, and Resolution Sensitivity in Three-Dimensional Mitochondrial Morphometry
summary: Quantitative imaging pipelines can produce precise but systematically different measurements of the same object. We present an empirical reliability assessment of three-dimensional mitochondrial morphometry that connects representation bias, a controlled processing intervention, correction transfer, and resolution sensitivity.
