title: RA-MoWE: Workflow-Affinity Embeddings for Query Clustering and Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: Agentic workflows enable large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks by coordinating reasoning, tool use, and verification. However, a workflow optimized for an entire task collection can overlook differences in the reasoning strategies that individual queries need, while searching for a new workflow for every query repeats costly optimization. To address this tradeoff, we introduce RA-MoWE, a framework that uses workflow-affinity embeddings to cluster queries and guide the generation of reusable expert workflows. Each embedding records how well a fixed set of reference workflows solves a query, revealing similarities in which reasoning strategies are effective. RA-MoWE uses each cluster's queries and average embedding to initialize and refine a specialized workflow through execution feedback. An embedding encoder predicts these embeddings from query text, allowing new queries to select a generated expert without first executing the reference workflows. On a 300-query test set drawn from four benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and programming, RA-MoWE improves average task score by 4.04 percentage points over selecting among the reference workflows, while using 27.7% fewer language-model calls at inference.

AI.tldr: 提出RA-MoWE，用工作流亲和性嵌入聚类查询并生成可重用专家工作流，解决全局优化忽略查询差异与逐查询优化成本高的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 针对整个任务集优化的单一工作流会忽略单个查询在推理策略上的差异，而为每个查询单独搜索新工作流又带来高昂的重复优化开销，两者之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 用固定的参考工作流集合在各查询上的表现记录为工作流亲和性嵌入，据此聚类查询；用每簇的查询与平均嵌入初始化并借助执行反馈精炼出专用工作流；训练嵌入编码器从查询文本预测嵌入，使新查询无需先执行参考工作流即可选择已生成的专家。
AI.result: 在涵盖数学、科学、编程的四个基准共300条查询上，平均任务得分比在参考工作流中选择提升4.04个百分点，同时推理时语言模型调用次数减少27.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在“全局共享”与“逐查询定制”之间取得折衷，RA-MoWE实现了可重用专家工作流的高效生成与选择，提升性能的同时降低推理开销。

title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity
summary: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct each synthetic pretraining context, the In-Context Diversity Prior samples from multiple related environments derived via controlled interventions and distribution shifts on a shared causal process. This in-context diversity encourages the model to learn a more comprehensive and task-specific representation. Moreover, the Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer iteratively and selectively applies a shared group of Transformer blocks to refine contextual representations, with a task-conditioned gate modulating the final hidden-state update. This enables task-adaptive iterative refinement. Together, these components encourage the model to identify predictive relationships from contextual contrasts during pretraining and dynamically modulate context integration for each task. Across six classification and five regression benchmark datasets, TAFFY attains the lowest average rank.

AI.tldr: TAFFY提出一种表格基础模型，通过上下文多样性先验和任务条件循环Transformer增强从上下文推断任务特定预测关系的能力，在多个基准上取得最低平均排名。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型的性能主要取决于能否从可用上下文中推断任务特定的预测关系，现有方法在此能力上仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 1) 上下文多样性先验：通过对共享因果过程施加受控干预和分布偏移，从多个相关环境采样构建合成预训练上下文；2) 任务条件循环Transformer：迭代且选择性地应用共享Transformer块组以精炼上下文表示，并用任务条件门控调节最终隐状态更新。
AI.result: 在六个分类和五个回归基准数据集上，TAFFY取得最低的平均排名。
AI.conclusion: 上下文多样性与任务自适应迭代精炼相结合，可使模型在预训练中从上下文对比中识别预测关系，并为每个任务动态调节上下文整合，从而提升整体性能。

title: UniCounting: Instance-Aware Proposal Consolidation for Image-Query-Free Multi-Category Counting
summary: Visual counting is commonly formulated as counting a single specified target, with a model receiving an image-specific exemplar, text query, or target category and returning a single count. We instead study fixed-vocabulary image-query-free multi-category counting. A global vocabulary is fixed for each run, and, given only an RGB image, the model predicts a complete category--count vector without being told which categories appear. We present UniCounting, which casts counting as instance-aware structural inference over an over-complete proposal set. Generic segmenters produce duplicate masks, partial views, and proposals from neighboring instances; semantic scores can name them but cannot determine which denote the same object. Frozen SAM~2.1 generates masks, while frozen DINOv2 and OpenCLIP provide relation and category features. A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head predicts same-instance affinities from instance-mask-derived supervision. Sparse graph construction, representative selection, labeling, and background-margin admission then convert each admitted component into one count with replayable group evidence. Only the relation head is trained, without count or density-map targets. On COCO clean500, UniCounting obtains lower point-estimate vector $\ell_1$ error and absent-class false mass than calibrated OWLv2-All80, with comparable micro presence F1. Under a matched decoder, the learned relation reduces both errors relative to mask containment, mask IoU, CLIP, and DINO, while revealing a fragmentation--merge trade-off. We also report transfer diagnostics on OmniCount-sub, FSC-147, and CARPK.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniCounting，研究固定词表、无需图像查询的多类别计数：仅输入RGB图像，模型输出完整类别-计数向量。方法将计数建模为过完备提议集上的实例感知结构推断，仅训练3276参数的类别共享关系头。在COCO clean500上超过校准的OWLv2-All80。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉计数多针对单一指定目标（图像示例、文本查询或目标类别），只返回单一计数。论文转向固定词表、无需图像查询的多类别计数：全局词表固定，仅给RGB图像，需预测完整类别-计数向量且不告知出现类别。
AI.method: UniCounting 将计数视为过完备提议集上的实例感知结构推断。冻结SAM 2.1生成掩码，冻结DINOv2与OpenCLIP提供关系与类别特征。仅训练一个3,276参数的类别共享关系头，从实例掩码派生监督预测同实例亲和度。再经稀疏图构建、代表选择、标注与背景边界准入，将每个被接纳的连通分量转为一个计数，并提供可重放的组证据。不使用计数或密度图目标。
AI.result: 在COCO clean500上，UniCounting的向量ℓ1点估计误差与缺席类虚假质量低于校准的OWLv2-All80，微观存在F1相当。在匹配解码器下，学习到的关系相对于掩码包含、掩码IoU、CLIP与DINO均降低两类误差，并揭示碎片化—合并权衡。另报告在OmniCount-sub、FSC-147与CARPK上的迁移诊断。
AI.conclusion: 以实例感知关系推理替代直接计数回归，可用极小训练参数实现无查询多类别计数，优于校准的强基线，并具迁移能力。

title: WorkflowOps: Learning Agent Collaboration Priors for Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex knowledge work, yet their orchestration layers remain largely memoryless: each new task is decomposed, assigned, and executed from scratch with no benefit from prior successful executions. We present WorkflowOps, a multi-agent workflow orchestration framework that learns agent collaboration priors from historical workflows and expands its agent pool on demand to cover new capability requirements. Our approach introduces three coupled mechanisms. First, a transition probability matrix captures pairwise agent collaboration frequencies from past workflows and applies them as soft guidance during DAG workflow construction through intra-layer ordering optimization, probability-thresholded edge suggestion, and transitive reduction for parallelism maximization. Second, a sufficiency-driven agent creation loop detects capability gaps via semantic matching scores, generates specialized agents through an LLM, and simultaneously injects them into the collaboration matrix, so that newly created agents are immediately usable with predicted collaboration priors. Third, a layered semantic matching strategy uses pre-trained sentence embeddings for fast, deterministic capability matching as a first pass, invoking LLM verification only for low-confidence cases, thereby reducing LLM routing calls by over 80\% compared to pure-LLM approaches. Experiments on mixed code, math, and question-answering suites show that WorkflowOps improves end-to-end pass rates over recent workflow-construction baselines, with the largest gains on structured, decomposable tasks where past agent handoff patterns transfer.

AI.tldr: WorkflowOps 提出一种多智能体工作流编排框架，从历史工作流学习协作先验并动态扩展智能体池，以提升任务通过率并降低 LLM 调用。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体编排层基本无记忆，每个新任务都从头分解、分配和执行，无法利用以往成功经验，导致重复劳动和效率低下。
AI.method: 三个耦合机制：(1) 基于历史工作流的转移概率矩阵，通过层内排序优化、概率阈值边建议和传递归约，为 DAG 构建提供软引导并最大化并行性；(2) 充足性驱动的智能体创建循环，用语义匹配检测能力缺口，LLM 生成专用智能体并注入协作矩阵；(3) 分层语义匹配策略，先用预训练句向量快速确定性匹配，仅对低置信度情况调用 LLM 验证。
AI.result: 端到端通过率优于近期工作流构建基线，在结构化、可分解任务上增益最大；相比纯 LLM 路由方法减少超过 80% 的 LLM 路由调用。
AI.conclusion: 利用历史协作先验和按需智能体扩展，可有效提升多智能体工作流编排性能与效率，尤其在过往智能体交接模式可迁移的任务上效果显著。

title: Learning a Mixture of GFlowNets
summary: Learning an ensemble of GFlowNets to sample from a discrete target distribution has become a common approach for achieving better state space exploration and convergence than that of a monolithic sampler. However, these methods often add a substantial runtime overhead to the base model, and their conceptual connection remains elusive. To address this, we first propose a general-purpose theoretical framework for describing a mixture of GFlowNets, which we specialize into continuously (CI) and discretely indexed (DI) collections. On the one hand, we show CI GFlowNets can be interpreted through the lens of a random features expansion, provably boosting the sampler's expressivity in graph-structured tasks and reducing learning instability via spectral shifting. On the other hand, we demonstrate DI GFlowNets encompass prior approaches for GFlowNet training and provide the foundation for the newly proposed Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets. This method, which is inspired by the Doob's h-transform of Markov chains, decomposes the state space according to a prescribed modular function and restricts each component to sample from a distinct subset of it. Importantly, SC GFlowNets support centralized and component-wise embarrassingly parallel training, and we show both of them significantly speed up learning convergence and mode coverage without introducing any non-negligible extra computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GFlowNet 集合（混合）的统一理论框架，将其分为连续索引（CI）与离散索引（DI）两类，并据此提出分层条件（SC）GFlowNets，实现并行训练且不增加显著计算开销。
AI.motivation: GFlowNet 集合采样虽提升探索与收敛，但常带来较大运行时开销，且其概念联系尚不清晰。
AI.method: 提出统一理论框架描述 GFlowNet 混合，specialize 为 CI 与 DI 集合；CI 通过随机特征展开解释，DI 涵盖既有方法并引出基于 Doob h-变换的 Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets，按模块函数分解状态空间并支持集中式与逐组件并行训练。
AI.result: CI 在图上任务中可证明提升表达力并通过谱移动减少学习不稳定；SC GFlowNets 显著加速收敛与模式覆盖，且不引入不可忽略的额外计算。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一了 GFlowNet 集合方法并揭示其理论联系，SC GFlowNets 提供高效并行训练方案。

title: UP-MOPD: Update Projection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation from multiple teachers combines expertise from different domains in a single student, but conflicting gradients can hinder this integration. Gradient corrections directly constrain parameter updates under plain SGD. With optimizers such as AdamW, however, momentum, adaptive scaling, and weight decay can turn a corrected gradient into an update that increases a domain loss to first order. To address this gap, we propose Update Projection for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (UP-MOPD). UP-MOPD lets the original mixed gradient update the optimizer state and generate a candidate displacement, then projects only violating candidates before they are committed to the parameters. The projection gives the unique feasible update closest to the candidate in Euclidean distance. In experiments combining medical and general domains, UP-MOPD improves IFEval-loose accuracy late in training by 2.96 points over vanilla M-OPD. It achieves an average score of 60.03 across eight metrics, compared with 59.00 for gradient projection and 59.15 for update rejection. On a public benchmark covering mathematics, code, and instruction following, it achieves the best average across six tasks (32.67), leads on LiveCodeBench v5, and ties for the best IFEval result.These results support projecting optimizer updates to reduce interference between domains.

AI.tldr: 提出更新投影(UP-MOPD),在多教师on-policy蒸馏中解决AdamW下梯度校正失效问题,显著提升多域整合性能。
AI.motivation: 多教师on-policy蒸馏整合不同领域专长时存在梯度冲突。梯度校正在plain SGD下可直接约束参数更新,但AdamW的动量、自适应缩放和权重衰减会使被校正的梯度仍产生增大某领域损失的一阶更新。
AI.method: UP-MOPD:先让原始混合梯度更新优化器状态并生成候选位移,再仅对违约的候选更新进行投影,取欧氏距离下最近且可行的唯一更新后再提交到参数。
AI.result: 医学+通用域实验中,训练后期IFEval-loose准确率较vanilla M-OPD提升2.96分;八项指标平均60.03,优于梯度投影(59.00)与更新拒绝(59.15)。公开基准上六任务平均最优(32.67),LiveCodeBench v5领先,IFEval并列最佳。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对优化器更新进行投影以降低领域间干扰,验证了在AdamW下直接校正梯度不足、需在更新层面约束的观点。

title: Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards
summary: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出"自参照社会偏好"：智能体无需观察他人奖励，而是用自身奖励模型评估他人行为结果，从而在多智能体强化学习中实现合作。
AI.motivation: 现有社会偏好方法通常要求智能体观察同伴的奖励信号，但现实中智能体往往只能观察他人的行为与结果，无法获取其私有奖励。
AI.method: 每个智能体学习自身奖励模型，将其应用到其他智能体观测到的状态转移上，从自身视角评估其收益，并把这些"自参照评估"接入标准社会偏好。两种接入方式：修改学习奖励，或用于加权策略更新。
AI.result: 在Escape Room、Clean Up、Commons Harvest三个序贯社会困境中，智能体无需观察他人奖励即可学到合作行为，甚至在独立学习失败的场景下也能成功，且常比拥有真实奖励的智能体获得更公平的收益分配。最优接入点取决于社会偏好类型：不公平厌恶在奖励加价值前瞻时效果最好，纯利他偏好适合策略更新加权；在部分可观测下策略更新方法仍能维持合作。
AI.conclusion: 显式获取他人奖励信号并非学习合作行为的必要条件，社会偏好可建立在基于他人可观测行为推导的自参照评估之上。

title: Complementary Feature Domains: Information Preservation Does Not Imply Predictive-Contribution Preservation
summary: Complementary Feature Domains (CFD) theory characterizes predictive value as a context-indexed contribution system induced jointly by representations and their realization family. We show that Shannon-information preservation does not imply preservation of this contribution system: an invertible representation transformation can leave target information unchanged while altering predictive contribution under a restricted decision family. We formalize the resulting transition through a CFD contribution defect that measures how contextual contributions change under controlled recoding. For bounded Lipschitz utility, we show that each coalition utility shift is bounded by the behavioral distance between the attainable action sets before and after recoding; consequently, every contextual contribution defect is bounded by the sum of the corresponding coalition incompatibilities. Exact behavioral closure yields invariance, while increasingly accurate compensation yields restoration. A controlled ECG experiment illustrates the mechanism: a nonlinear bijective recoding preserves the information in a frozen time-frequency representation but changes accuracy under a fixed affine learner; applying the exact inverse restores all tested coalition accuracies. The result separates information preservation from realization-dependent contribution and provides a quantitative transition law for multi-representation prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CFD理论，揭示Shannon信息保持不等于预测贡献保持：可逆表示变换可在信息不变下改变受限决策族中的预测贡献。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为保持信息即可保持预测价值，但作者质疑这一等价性，希望刻画表示变换如何影响上下文相关的预测贡献系统。
AI.method: 形式化CFD贡献缺陷，度量受控重编码下上下文贡献的变化；对Lipschitz效用，将联盟效用偏移界定为动作集行为距离，并将贡献缺陷界定为联盟不兼容性之和；用ECG实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上，精确行为闭包导致不变性，精确补偿带来恢复；实验上，非线性双射重编码保持冻结时频表示信息，却改变固定仿射学习器精度，逆变换可恢复联盟精度。
AI.conclusion: 信息保持与实现依赖的预测贡献可分离，为多表示预测提供了定量转换规律。

title: GeoPID: Decomposing and Steering Visual Information in Vision-Language Models
summary: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown outstanding performance across diverse applications, they tend to under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context. In this work, we propose \textsc{GeoPID}, a training-free framework that analyzes multimodal information within VLMs from a geometric perspective. \textsc{GeoPID} decomposes information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Through an extensive analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks, we confirm that correct predictions exhibit stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding. Building on this geometric analysis, we introduce a targeted intervention technique that selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference. As a result, visual grounding capabilities were enhanced without any additional model parameter updates, achieving an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GeoPID，一个无需训练的框架，从几何视角分析 VLM 的多模态信息，分解出冗余、模态独有和协同成分，并通过放大视觉独有子空间来增强视觉 grounding。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 往往低估视觉信息、过度依赖文本上下文，需从多模态表示几何关系入手分析并纠正这一问题。
AI.method: 利用视觉与文本表示子空间的几何关系，将信息分解为 Redundant、Modality-Unique、Synergistic 三部分；在推理时对 vision-unique 子空间进行定向放大干预，无需更新参数。
AI.result: 在 22 个 VLM 和 14 个基准上分析，发现需强视觉 grounding 时正确预测具有更强 vision-unique 成分；干预后平均相对准确率提升 7.63%。
AI.conclusion: 几何分析可有效揭示并改善 VLM 的视觉利用不足问题，训练-free 干预即可显著提升视觉 grounding 能力。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Atmospheric Rivers in GraphCast
summary: While AI weather models now rival operational forecasts, how they represent the atmosphere internally remains an open question: feature attribution reveals which input patterns matter, not what the model computes or how it combines information internally. We train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on GraphCast to uncover its learned concepts, using atmospheric rivers as our phenomenon of focus. Both standard and Matryoshka SAEs show GraphCast computes atmospheric river intensity, measured by integrated vapor transport (IVT), as a stable internal variable, despite IVT being neither an input nor a target. In contrast to the unstructured concept retrieval of the standard SAE, the Matryoshka SAE orders concepts by importance and exposes their relations. Atmospheric river concepts persist across depth and direct interventions confirm causality. This method offers a way to find internal variables and determine which of them the model actually relies on, which is a prerequisite for asking whether those variables remain meaningful as the phenomenon changes under a warming climate.

AI.tldr: 在GraphCast上训练稀疏自编码器，发现模型内部自发计算了大气河强度（IVT）这一稳定内部变量，Matryoshka SAE还能按重要性排序并揭示概念间关系，干预实验证实其因果作用。
AI.motivation: AI天气模型预报性能已接近业务水平，但其内部如何表征大气仍是未解问题；特征归因只能揭示哪些输入重要，无法说明模型计算了什么、如何组合信息。
AI.method: 在GraphCast上训练标准与Matryoshka稀疏自编码器（SAE），以大气河为焦点现象，挖掘其学习到的概念；对比两种SAE的概念检索方式，并进行跨深度分析与因果干预实验。
AI.result: 两种SAE均显示GraphCast将大气河强度（以IVT度量）计算为稳定的内部变量，尽管IVT既非输入也非目标；Matryoshka SAE按重要性排序概念并揭示其关系，而标准SAE检索是无结构的；大气河概念跨深度持续存在，干预实验证实因果性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可发现模型的内部变量并判定其中哪些被真正依赖，为进一步追问这些变量在气候变暖下现象变化时是否仍具意义提供前提。

title: Decoy and disclosure radii of invariant shape descriptors
summary: A recognizer that compares rotation-invariant descriptors sees a surface only up to the fiber of the descriptor. We measure this fiber by its radius in the orbit distance from the enrolled surface. A large radius admits decoys, that is, distant shapes that pass the matcher. A small radius discloses the enrolled shape to anyone who captures the stored value. For star-shaped surfaces truncated to spherical harmonics of degree at most $L$, with $n$ coefficients, a descriptor of generic rank $r$ has generic fibers of dimension $n-3-r$ modulo rotations. The standard pool of band powers, even bispectra, and three invariants of the degree-three band therefore admits decoy families of dimension $5$, $13$, $20$ at $L=4,6,8$. Its rank first reaches $n-3$ at $L=16$, and a mirror decoy remains at every $L$. The odd bispectra remove the mirror decoy generically for $L \geq 4$. Yet at fixed mean radius the same pool determines the enclosed volume exactly, and it does not determine whether a surface meets a clearance requirement. We certify two cases by exact and interval arithmetic. At $L=6$ a decoy matches all $32$ invariants to relative precision $2 \cdot 10^{-18}$ at orbit distance at least $0.87$ times the norm of the enrolled tuple. For the radar shape model of asteroid (101955) Bennu, the pool recovers the modeled volume, misses the handedness, and leaves the keep-out radius uncertain by more than $7 \, \mathrm{m}$.

AI.tldr: 本文分析旋转不变描述子（如带功率、双谱等）的信息泄漏与欺骗脆弱性：描述子一般只能确定形状到某个纤维（fiber），纤维半径大则存在欺骗形状，半径小则泄漏原形状。对球谐截断的星形曲面，给出纤维维数公式与具体欺骗族维数，并证明体积可精确恢复但间隙/手性等信息不可确定。
AI.motivation: 旋转不变描述子被广泛用于形状匹配与安全存储（如生物特征、3D模型检索），但其安全性缺乏量化分析：比较描述子只能识别曲面到描述子的纤维，因此需要度量该纤维的半径，以理解欺骗（decoy）与隐私泄漏之间的权衡。
AI.method: 将形状限定为星形曲面并截断到次数≤L的球谐，共n个系数；用轨道距离度量纤维半径；计算通用秩r描述子的通用纤维维数（模旋转为n-3-r）；分析标准不变量池（带功率、偶双谱、degree-3带的三个不变量、奇双谱）的秩与欺骗族维数；用精确与区间算术验证L=6的反例，并应用于小行星(101955) Bennu的雷达形状模型。
AI.result: 标准不变量池在L=4,6,8时分别存在维数5、13、20的欺骗族；秩直到L=16才首次达到n-3，且任意L都存在镜像欺骗。奇双谱在L≥4时一般可消除镜像欺骗。固定平均半径时该池可精确确定封闭体积，但不能判断是否满足间隙要求。L=6时存在欺骗在所有32个不变量上相对精度2e-18匹配，轨道距离至少为注册元组范数的0.87倍。Bennu模型：池可恢复建模体积、遗漏手性、keep-out半径不确定度>7 m。
AI.conclusion: 旋转不变描述子的信息量受纤维维数严格限制，标准不变量池存在高维欺骗族并泄漏手性与间隙等关键几何信息；体积虽可精确恢复，但不足以满足安全与碰撞规避需求。需谨慎选择不变量集合或引入额外约束以同时抵抗欺骗与隐私泄漏。

title: Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research
summary: Automated research systems increasingly run LLM agents over long horizons, but more inference does not by itself produce more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. Yet most evaluations use short budgets or benchmarks that saturate early, leaving these failure modes untested. We trace these failures to two choices: where research state lives and who decides what to try next. We introduce Stateless Language Agents (SLAs), built on the principle of stateful search with stateless agents: no agent carries its conversation across invocations; instead, the harness owns the research state (candidate solutions and measured outcomes) and reconstructs a fresh and role-specific context for every invocation. What each agent sees becomes an explicit design choice rather than a history that grows with the run. We implement this principle in the SLA framework, where a stateless Advisor reads harness-summarized evidence across search directions and assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. We evaluate SLA against three recent frameworks on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets of up to one billion tokens. SLA achieves the best final result on every task and reaches the strongest kernel baseline's final performance with over 84% fewer tokens. Ablations from shared checkpoints show that focused contexts and explicit assignments each contribute to SLA's progress, with effects that can compound over full runs, while the Advisor consumes less than 0.6% of tokens. These results argue for SLAs, which keep durable research state out of agent conversations, and show that short evaluation horizons can misjudge research systems and their components.

AI.tldr: 论文提出无状态语言智能体（SLAs），通过"有状态搜索 + 无状态智能体"原则，把研究状态交给框架而非智能体对话，在长时程自动化研究中显著提升效率与效果。
AI.motivation: 自动化研究系统中，更多推理不等于更多进展：智能体反复重放历史、重复工作或在消耗 token 时停止实验。现有评估多用短预算或早饱和的基准，导致这些失败模式未被充分测试。作者将失败根源归为两点：研究状态存放位置，以及由谁决定下一步尝试什么。
AI.method: 提出 SLAs，核心原则是"有状态搜索、无状态智能体"：智能体不在多次调用间携带对话，框架负责研究状态（候选解与测量结果），并为每次调用重建全新且角色特定的上下文。在 SLA 框架中，无状态 Advisor 读取框架汇总的跨搜索方向证据并分配具体实验给并行 Workers。
AI.result: 在软件工程、内核优化和算法设计任务上，预算最高达十亿 token，与三个近期框架对比：SLA 在每个任务上取得最佳最终结果；以超过 84% 更少的 token 达到最强内核基线的最终性能。消融显示聚焦上下文和显式任务分配均有贡献且可叠加；Advisor 仅消耗不足 0.6% 的 token。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持 SLAs：将持久研究状态保存在智能体对话之外，能提升长时程研究效率与效果，同时表明短评估时程可能误判研究系统及其组件。

title: Textual Environmental Context and Spatial Graphs for LLM-Based Regional SST Forecasting
summary: Sea surface temperature (SST) forecasting depends on local temporal persistence, regional spatial dependence, and environmental conditions that evolve with the forecast date. We study how these heterogeneous conditions can be presented to a large language model (LLM) for regional multi-step forecasting without serializing the full SST grid as text. We formulate forecasting as conditional numerical generation: historical SST and anomaly sequences, date-aligned environmental records, and static ocean knowledge form a textual context, while regional spatial state is supplied through continuous graph-derived prefixes. A static graph encodes persistent geographic--climatological relations, and a dynamic graph encodes recent SST correlations and localized tropical-cyclone influence. Two graph neural networks produce a target-node representation that is mapped by a spatial-prefix fusion and injected into the LLM input. On SST forecasting in the South China Sea, the complete configuration achieves the best MAE and $\Rtwo$ among the compared methods over ten forecast steps. Alongside the numerical forecast, a rule-based module matches predicted trends and environmental-factor directions with knowledge entries to return source-linked, post-hoc contextual explanations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将SST多步预测建模为条件数值生成任务，用文本上下文+连续图前缀供给LLM，无需序列化整个SST网格，并在南海预测中取得最优精度，同时提供可溯源的事后解释。
AI.motivation: SST预测依赖局地时间持续性、区域空间依赖和随预测日期变化的环境条件；但直接把完整SST网格文本化输入LLM成本高、不可行，需要一种异质条件表征方式。
AI.method: 将预测形式化为条件数值生成：历史SST/异常序列、日期对齐环境记录与静态海洋知识构成文本上下文；静态图编码地理-气候关系，动态图编码近期SST相关性与局地热带气旋影响；两个GNN生成目标节点表示，经空间前缀融合注入LLM输入。另设规则模块匹配预测趋势与环境因子方向与知识条目，返回带来源的事后解释。
AI.result: 在南海SST预测上，完整配置在十个预测步中取得对比方法中最优的MAE和R²。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能以图-derived连续前缀高效向LLM注入区域空间状态，实现高精度多步SST预测，并输出可溯源上下文解释。

title: Hub for Outliers, Spokes for Inliers: Uniform Latent Space Construction for Dual-Mismatched Semi-Supervised Learning
comment: Equal contribution by Li Yuan and Yaxin Hou. Corresponding author: Yuheng Jia. Emails: {yuan-li,yaxin,230259148,yhjia}@seu.edu.cn, gaoyb@qlu.edu.cn. 18 pages
summary: Semi-supervised learning typically assumes that labeled and unlabeled data share an identical class distribution and label space. However, this setting is often violated: unlabeled data may be imbalanced and contain unknown class samples, causing mismatches in both class distribution and label space. Such dual mismatch leads to majority classes dominating the latent space and unknown class samples being overconfidently misclassified, degrading feature discriminability and pseudo-label quality. To address this, we propose a hub-spoke latent geometry, where known classes are uniformly distributed around a central hub and each class forms compact clusters around its prototype, while the hub provides an anchor for a low-evidence region specifically designed for high-uncertainty unknown class samples. Integrated with an evidence-based classifier, this geometry ultimately enhances feature discriminability and uncertainty separation by mitigating majority-class domination through structured feature organization and guiding high-uncertainty unknown class samples toward the hub. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with a maximum improvement of 3.25% across various settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对半监督学习中标签与未标签数据类别分布和标签空间双重不匹配问题，提出hub-spoke潜在几何结构配合证据分类器，提升特征判别性和伪标签质量。
AI.motivation: 半监督学习通常假设标注与未标注数据共享相同类别分布和标签空间，但现实中未标注数据常不平衡且含未知类样本，导致多数类主导潜在空间、未知类被过度自信误分类，损害特征判别性和伪标签质量。
AI.method: 提出hub-spoke潜在几何：已知类均匀分布在中心hub周围，每类围绕其原型形成紧凑簇；hub为高不确定性未知类样本提供低证据区域锚点。结合基于证据的分类器，通过结构化特征组织缓解多数类主导，引导高不确定性未知类样本向hub移动。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法优于现有最先进方法，在不同设置下最大提升达3.25%。
AI.conclusion: hub-spoke几何与证据分类器结合可有效应对类别分布和标签空间双重不匹配，增强特征判别性与不确定性分离，提升半监督学习性能。

title: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding for Privacy-Friendly AIoT
summary: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding (IBFU) aims to directly perform fine-grained classification and semantic description generation from encoded image byte sequences. In contrast to conventional pixel-domain visual understanding, IBFU conducts semantic analysis without fully decoding images into the pixel domain. Since pixel-level visual content is not explicitly reconstructed during inference, this paradigm reduces visual exposure within the processing pipeline and suits privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) applications. In this paper, we propose Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG), a novel foundation model tailored for IBFU. BFG consists of two main components: a Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) and a Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG). BSeE directly models semantic representations from encoded image bitstreams without explicit pixel reconstruction, while FSeG transforms the extracted bitstream semantics into detailed natural-language descriptions through autoregressive generation. To train BFG and comprehensively evaluate IBFU in practical AIoT scenarios, where image bitstreams may suffer corruption during transmission and storage, we construct a large-scale Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D), containing both intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels. Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption. For example, the performance only has slight change from 0.6339 to 0.6077 in terms of average CIDEr score on Stanford Dogs Caption dataset, while vision-language models, such as Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM, Gemini, and GPT suffer severe performance decrease. This paper provides a practical paradigm for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向图像比特流细粒度理解(IBFU)的基础模型BFG，直接在编码字节序列上进行分类与描述生成，无需完整像素解码，并构建损坏比特流数据集CFU-D，验证其在比特流损坏下仍保持稳定的细粒度描述能力。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉理解需将图像完整解码到像素域，视觉暴露度高，不利于隐私友好的AIoT应用。IBFU旨在直接在编码比特流上做语义分析，减少处理流程中的视觉暴露。
AI.method: 提出BFG基础模型，含两部分：Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE)直接从未解码的编码比特流建模语义表示；Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG)通过自回归生成将比特流语义转化为详细自然语言描述。并构建CFU-D大规模数据集，包含完整比特流及多种损坏类型和严重程度的变体。
AI.result: BFG在比特流损坏下仍保持稳定的细粒度描述生成，在Stanford Dogs Caption数据集上平均CIDEr仅从0.6339略降至0.6077；而Qwen-VL-Chat、BLIP-2、GLM、Gemini、GPT等视觉语言模型性能严重下降。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为AIoT中隐私友好的细粒度视觉理解提供了可行的实用范式。

title: Isotropic Yet Undecodable: The Sequential Content-Sufficiency Gap in Latent-Predictive Text Representations
summary: We study sequential content sufficiency by investigating whether a representation retains the ordered target information available in its input. An information-theoretic decomposition separates input ambiguity, representation loss, and readout mismatch. We construct recoverable views where perfect agreement and joint isotropic Gaussianity coexist with zero target information, and establish limits imposed by deterministic canonical anchors. Token log-loss provides a one-sided information-loss bound; a fixed-penalty ridge analysis shows why rank alone cannot determine prediction risk. These results motivate CANOPE, a nonautoregressive framework with ordered latent canvases, canonical-token supervision, and geometric regularization. On 40,000 validation sequences, latent-agreement (PL0) and token-grounded (PL2) have nearly identical pooled ranks but reach 13.5% and 98.8% positional Recall@1, respectively, under strong natural corruption when the correct target length is provided. On 3,930 LJSpeech validation utterances, frozen PL2 with a trained MatchaTTS readout yields 21.54% word error rate (WER) on corrupted text, versus 99.22% for frozen PL0, while end-to-end MatchaTTS reaches 10.93%. These results show that geometric regularity alone does not guarantee recoverable sequential content or effective downstream access in the text settings studied here.

AI.tldr: 研究序列内容充分性：表征是否保留输入中的有序目标信息。提出信息论分解与可恢复视图，并据此设计CANOPE框架。
AI.motivation: 探究表征"一致性与几何规整"是否足以保证有序目标信息可恢复，揭示仅靠几何规律无法保证序列内容可恢复及下游可用。
AI.method: 信息论分解（输入歧义、表征损失、读出失配）；构造可恢复视图与确定性规范锚点界限；token log-loss单侧信息损失界；固定惩罚岭分析；提出非自回归CANOPE（有序潜画布、规范token监督、几何正则）。
AI.result: 4万验证序列：PL0与PL2池化排名几乎一致，但位置Recall@1为13.5% vs 98.8%。3930条LJSpeech：冻结PL2+MatchaTTS读出WER 21.54%，PL0为99.22%，端到端MatchaTTS为10.93%。
AI.conclusion: 几何规律性本身不能保证有序内容可恢复或下游有效访问；需token落地与规范监督。

title: AFA-BANDIT: Provably Near-Optimal Online Multi-Feature Classification Under Budget Constraints
summary: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) is a classification problem in which an agent decides which costly features to acquire before predicting each sample's label. Unlike batch AFA, which trains a fixed policy and classifier offline on fully observed data, online AFA updates its predictor from revealed labels as samples arrive. Existing online methods either use deep reinforcement learning (RL) without performance guarantees or maximize cost-adjusted reward rather than enforce a global budget. We formulate online AFA as a combinatorial Bandits with Knapsacks (BwK) problem that couples acquisition and prediction. Unlike prior bandit-based AFA and classical BwK, our setting has combinatorial complexity, evolving rewards, a global budget, and structured side information. We obtain an improved regret upper bound over standard BwK bounds in this framework, leveraging a cardinality-aware confidence bound and the subset update structure. To avoid an exponentially large action space, we propose \emph{LP-Chain}, a variant that searches a cost-aware chain of feature subsets with a size that grows linearly with the number of features. While the regret upper bound is specific to the combinatorial framework, \emph{LP-Chain} empirically achieves comparable predictive performance. On synthetic data, \emph{LP-Chain} outperforms HEDGE-based BwK and deep RL-based online AFA baselines and scales favorably to more features.

AI.tldr: 本文将在线主动特征获取(AFA)建模为带背包的组合Bandit(BwK)问题，提出LP-Chain方法，在全局预算约束下获得改进的regret上界。
AI.motivation: 在线AFA需在样本到达时利用已揭示标签更新预测器，但现有在线方法要么用深度RL且无性能保证，要么仅最大化成本调整后奖励而不强制全局预算约束。
AI.method: 将在线AFA形式化为耦合获取与预测的组合BwK问题，利用基数感知置信界和子集更新结构；提出LP-Chain，通过搜索成本感知的特征子集链将动作空间从指数级降至随特征数线性增长。
AI.result: 在该框架下获得优于标准BwK的regret上界；在合成数据上LP-Chain性能超越基于HEDGE的BwK和深度RL在线AFA基线，且随特征数增加扩展性良好。
AI.conclusion: 在线AFA可作为组合BwK问题求解，LP-Chain在预算约束下兼具理论保证（regret上界）与可扩展的实证表现。

title: Ariadne's Thread of LipSync: Unraveling Forgeries via Inconsistency between Lip Motions and Head Poses
summary: Recent advances in LipSync generation technology have led to the creation of highly realistic videos, posing severe societal risks. However, existing defense strategies struggle against LipSync forgeries, as advanced LipSync generation methods not only achieve better lip synchronization but also eliminate visual artifacts. An important reason is that they overlook an inherent biological coupling between lip movements and head poses in natural speech videos. In this paper, we propose LipDA, a novel framework for joint LipSync Detection and Attribution, which takes advantage of the inconsistency between head and lip. For detection, the framework learns to quantify this discrepancy by contrasting lip and pose features from authentic versus forged videos. For attribution, our method is designed to capture the unique temporal dynamics and audio-visual synchronization patterns that act as the fingerprint of models, enabling source tracing. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging LipSync datasets as well as our own proposed large-scale and multi-generator dataset. LipDA achieves over 97\% AUC in detection and 97.5\% accuracy in model attribution, significantly outperforming existing methods. Code and the proposed LipSync-A dataset are available at https://github.com/AnsonShe/LipDA.

AI.tldr: LipDA 提出利用自然语音视频中唇动与头部姿态的生物学耦合关系，联合进行 LipSync 伪造检测与归因，在两个数据集及自建数据集上取得高精度。
AI.motivation: 先进的 LipSync 生成方法唇同步好且无视觉伪影，使现有防御策略失效；其忽略了自然语音视频中唇动与头部姿态的固有生物学耦合。
AI.method: 提出 LipDA 框架：检测阶段通过对比真实与伪造视频的唇部与姿态特征量化头-唇不一致性；归因阶段捕捉模型特有的时间动态与音视频同步模式作为指纹以溯源。并构建大规模多生成器 LipSync-A 数据集。
AI.result: 在两个挑战性 LipSync 数据集及自建数据集上，检测 AUC 超 97%，模型归因准确率 97.5%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用头-唇生物耦合不一致性可有效实现 LipSync 伪造的检测与溯源，LipDA 性能优越，代码与数据集已公开。

title: Improving Synthetic Data Generation for Argument Mining via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
summary: Argument Mining (AM) is fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of high-quality structure-annotated datasets. While LLMs have shown promise in synthetic data generation, producing synthetic AM data that is both structurally accurate and sufficiently diverse remains a challenging problem. To address this problem, we revisit synthetic data generation for AM from a new perspective and propose a novel adversarial reinforcement learning framework for data synthesis. The proposed framework jointly optimizes the generator and the discriminator in an adversarial loop, in which the generator produces structured AM instances, and the discriminator provides learning signals by distinguishing real data from synthetic candidates. This enables the generator to progressively improve both the structural accuracy of generated argument data while maintaining diversity through adversarial feedback. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves AM performance on three benchmark datasets in both full-data and low-resource settings, validating its effectiveness and scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出对抗强化学习框架合成论证挖掘数据，兼顾结构准确性与多样性，在三个基准数据集上提升性能。
AI.motivation: 论证挖掘受限于高质量结构化标注数据稀缺；现有LLM合成数据难以同时保证结构准确与足够多样性。
AI.method: 从新视角重构AM合成数据生成，提出对抗强化学习框架，联合优化生成器与判别器：生成器产生结构化AM实例，判别器区分真实与合成数据并提供学习信号，通过对抗反馈迭代提升生成数据质量。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集、全数据与低资源两种设置下，均持续提升AM性能，验证了有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 对抗式合成数据生成可有效缓解AM数据稀缺问题，兼具结构准确性与多样性。

title: Continuous Memory Machines
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM)
summary: Recurrent neural networks typically compress information into a single vector-valued recurrent state, forcing short-term computation and long-term retention to share the same representation. Past extensions alleviate this bottleneck by increasing the memory capacity or separating timescales, but lack the combination of rapid neuron-level processing and longer-term retention found in biology. To that end, we introduce the Continuous Memory Machine (CMM), a recurrent architecture with matrix-valued short- and long-term memory states serving distinct functional roles. Building on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM), the CMM's short-term memory tracks recent neural activity, with uniquely parameterized neuron-level models learning to use these activity patterns for computation. A persistent long-term memory stores information for later use, with a Transformer jointly updating both memory stores, providing an expressive bidirectional read--write mechanism such that each store can reorganize its own contents and both read from and write to the other. Across algorithmic, in-context learning, and recurrent reasoning tasks, the CMM outperforms a broad suite of baselines, exhibiting stronger generalization than prior memory-augmented networks while preserving the CTM's interpretable attention patterns. Code is available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/continuous-memory-machines.

AI.tldr: 提出连续记忆机器(CMM)，用矩阵值短期与长期记忆状态分离快慢时间尺度，Transformer双向读写，在算法、上下文学习和推理任务上超越多种基线。
AI.motivation: 传统RNN将信息压缩为单一向量状态，迫使短期计算与长期保留共享同一表示；现有扩展或增大容量或分离时间尺度，但缺乏生物学中快速神经元级处理与长期保留的结合。
AI.method: 基于连续思维机器(CTM)，引入矩阵值短期与长期记忆状态。短期记忆追踪近期神经活动，具独特参数化的神经元级模型学习利用这些活动模式进行计算；持久长期记忆存储信息供后续使用；由Transformer联合更新两者，实现表达性强的双向读写机制，使每个存储可重组自身内容并相互读写。
AI.result: 在算法、上下文学习和循环推理任务上，CMM优于广泛基线，泛化能力强于先前记忆增强网络，同时保留CTM可解释的注意力模式。
AI.conclusion: CMM通过矩阵值双记忆与Transformer双向读写，有效结合快速神经元级处理与长期保留，提升泛化并保持可解释性。

title: SIGMA: Self-Improving Alignment Generalization from a Model Spec
summary: LLM agents are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks and of recursively improving themselves on easy-to-verify objectives such as software engineering and mathematics. Since alignment is much harder to verify, this creates a growing risk of capabilities increasing without appropriate safety alignment, especially as capabilities expand to auto-research and cybersecurity. Existing approaches focus on capability self-improvement using verifiable feedback or on alignment training with supervision from stronger models or curated data, creating an external supervision bottleneck for alignment. We ask whether current models can improve their own safety alignment, and propose SIGMA, a data generation and training pipeline enabling alignment self-improvement that generalizes to out-of-distribution settings. Given only a "Model Spec" stating the model's desired behavior, SIGMA leverages a model's reasoning capabilities to strengthen its own safety reasoning. SIGMA first performs spec-guided task synthesis, using the candidate model as a task designer agent to generate diverse alignment dilemma scenarios and convert them into training tasks that stress-test its understanding of the Model Spec. Next, SIGMA conducts self-judged alignment training through supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning with the model itself as the reward model. Despite training only on single-turn chat data, SIGMA improves safety alignment in multi-turn agentic environments (AgentHarm harmfulness decreases from 22.6 to 14.8; Agentic Misalignment decreases from 79.1 to 3.8), outperforms Deliberative Alignment and Constitutional AI baselines, and retains general capability. Analyses show that a Model Spec balancing harmlessness and helpfulness, test-time reasoning for safety deliberation, and high-quality rubrics from SIGMA's task designer agent are crucial for effective self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出SIGMA，一种让模型自我提升安全对齐的数据生成与训练流水线，仅依赖Model Spec，在单轮对话数据上训练却能泛化到多轮智能体环境。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体的能力（含自我改进）增长快于可验证的安全对齐，对齐验证困难，导致能力提升缺乏安全保障；现有方法依赖更强模型或人工数据的外部监督，形成瓶颈。因此探究模型能否自我改进安全对齐。
AI.method: SIGMA仅给出描述期望行为的Model Spec，先做spec引导的任务合成：用候选模型作任务设计者，生成多样化的对齐困境场景并转为训练任务；再进行自我评判的对齐训练：监督微调+基于rubric的强化学习，模型自身充当奖励模型。
AI.result: 仅在单轮聊天数据上训练，却提升了多轮智能体环境的安全对齐：AgentHarm有害性从22.6降至14.8，Agentic Misalignment从79.1降至3.8；优于Deliberative Alignment与Constitutional AI基线，并保留通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 平衡无害性与有用性的Model Spec、用于安全审议的测试时推理、以及高质量rubric是有效自我改进的关键。

title: Complementary Supervised and Self-Supervised Representations for Out-of-Distribution Graph Learning
summary:
Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains challenging for graph neural networks (GNNs), as graph distributions can vary substantially across time and domains. Supervised and self-supervised graph representation learning are guided by distinct objectives and offer different perspectives on graph representations. In this work, we study whether self-supervised representations (SSL) can provide complementary signals to improve supervised OOD node classification. We develop two backbone-agnostic frameworks that exploit such information at different stages of learning and prediction. Co-Train jointly learns supervised and SSL representations and adaptively integrates them during training, while Dual-Space Retrieval performs non-parametric prediction in the two representation spaces and combines their predictions through confidence-aware fusion at inference time. The supervised and SSL encoders are separately parameterized and need not share the same GNN architecture.
  We evaluate multiple GNN backbones and two distinct SSL objectives, DGI and GRACE, on four graph benchmarks spanning temporal and cross-domain distribution shifts. Extensive experiments show that Co-Train consistently outperforms strong supervised OOD baselines, while Dual-Space Retrieval achieves competitive performance as a flexible non-parametric alternative. Results across different backbones and SSL objectives, together with representation analyses and ablations, demonstrate that SSL representations provide complementary information to supervised representations and can improve OOD node classification across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Co-Train与Dual-Space Retrieval两个框架，利用自监督表示(SSL)补充监督表示以提升图神经网络的OOD节点分类性能。
AI.motivation: GNN的OOD泛化困难，因图分布在时间和领域间变化显著。监督与自监督图表示学习目标不同，对图表示提供不同视角，作者探究SSL表示能否为监督OOD节点分类提供互补信号。
AI.method: 提出两个与骨干无关的框架：Co-Train联合学习监督与SSL表示并在训练中自适应融合；Dual-Space Retrieval在推理时于两个表示空间做非参数预测并以置信度感知方式融合。监督与SSL编码器分别参数化，无需共享同一GNN架构。
AI.result: 在四个覆盖时间与跨域分布偏移的图基准上，评估多种GNN骨干与DGI、GRACE两种SSL目标。Co-Train持续优于强监督OOD基线，Dual-Space Retrieval作为灵活非参数方案取得有竞争力表现。
AI.conclusion: 不同骨干与SSL目标的结果、表示分析和消融表明，SSL表示为监督表示提供互补信息，可在多样场景下提升OOD节点分类。

title: Deformable CT-US Registration via Anatomy-Aware Implicit Neural Representations
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Advances in Simplifying Medical UltraSound (ASMUS 2026), held with MICCAI 2026; to appear in Springer LNCS 17276 (MICCAI 2026 Workshops and Challenges). Open-access camera-ready: https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2026-sat/ASMUS_047.html
summary: Slice-to-volume registration between ultrasound (US) and preoperative computed tomography (CT) imaging would enhance many minimally invasive interventions, for example by locating soft tissue structures intra-operatively that are discernible in CT. While optical tracking enables initial rigid registration, contact from the probe induces soft tissue deformations that inhibit accurate alignment. In this work, we introduce a deformable CT-ultrasound registration framework that incorporates anatomical priors derived from CT to improve registration under deformation. Rigid registration is first established using a robot-assisted optical tracking system, after which a deformable transformation is estimated using a sinusoidal implicit neural representation (SIREN) optimized per frame. Tissue stiffness is approximated from CT-based HU values and used as spatially varying regularization, suppressing deformation in rigid structures such as bone while allowing more flexibility in soft tissue. Two additional constraints capture the physics of probe contact: a contact-zone displacement prior that drives the displacement field to compress tissue below the probe face, and a fan-geometry regularization term based on beam direction and convex transducer field of view. Model parameters are optimized with a normalized gradient field (NGF). The proposed approach improves alignment over rigid initialisation by 17% and outperforms classical deformable baselines while maintaining near-zero topological folding.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于CT解剖先验的可变形CT-超声配准框架，用SIREN逐帧优化，结合组织硬度、接触区与探头几何约束，配准精度较刚性初始提升17%且拓扑折叠近零。
AI.motivation: 超声与术前CT的切片-体配准可辅助微创手术定位软组织。光学追踪能提供初始刚性配准，但探头接触导致软组织形变，破坏对齐精度，故需引入形变建模。
AI.method: 先用机器人辅助光学追踪完成刚性配准；再用正弦隐式神经表示（SIREN）逐帧估计形变场。以CT的HU值近似组织硬度作空间变化正则（骨等刚性结构抑制形变，软组织更灵活）；并加入两个物理约束：接触区位移先验（使探头面下方组织压缩）和基于波束方向与凸阵视场的扇形几何正则。参数用归一化梯度场（NGF）优化。
AI.result: 相较刚性初始配准对齐精度提升17%，优于经典可变形基线方法，并保持近乎零的拓扑折叠。
AI.conclusion: 融合CT解剖先验与探头接触物理约束的可变形配准框架能有效改善CT-超声配准精度与形变合理性。

title: Confidence Reasoning Graphs: Structured Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
summary: When using an LLM agent in a consequential domain, making an informed decision about whether to trust its output or intervene requires calibrated confidence in the agent's success. Confidence estimation for agents is difficult because evidence about success is distributed across heterogeneous, interdependent steps of an agent's trajectory. Practical agentic deployments introduce further challenges: frontier LLMs often provide limited access to internal signals, agent roll-outs are costly, and training data may be unavailable or quickly become outdated. To address these challenges, we introduce Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs), an inference-time framework that estimates the probability an agent accomplished its task from a single trajectory, without privileged model access or training data. Rather than compressing an execution into a single holistic judgment, a CRG begins with the claim that the agent accomplished its task, decomposes it into contextualized sub-claims grounded in trajectory evidence, estimates confidence for each terminal claim, and finally aggregates these into an overall confidence estimate. Across three agentic benchmarks, three backbone models, and three agent frameworks, CRGs yield better-calibrated confidence and stronger risk-aware decision making than verbalized, sampling-based, and white-box surrogate baselines. We further find that calibration error alone can be misleading: a white-box surrogate baseline appears well calibrated while providing near-chance discrimination. Ablations attribute CRG's improvements to claim-level confidence estimation and aggregation rather than graph construction alone. Finally, a CRG exposes the claims and trajectory evidence underlying each confidence estimate, enabling it to be audited at decision time.

AI.tldr: 提出置信推理图（CRG），一种在推理阶段、仅凭单条轨迹即可估计智能体任务成功概率的框架，无需特权模型访问或训练数据，在多基准上实现更好校准与风险决策。
AI.motivation: 在关键领域使用LLM智能体时，判断是否信任其输出需要校准的置信度。但成功证据分散在异质、相互依赖的轨迹步骤中；实际部署还面临内部信号访问受限、roll-out成本高、训练数据缺失或过时等挑战。
AI.method: CRG从"智能体完成任务"这一总主张出发，依据轨迹证据将其分解为情境化的子主张，估计每个终端主张的置信度，最后聚合为整体置信估计。这是一个推理时的框架，不需特权访问或训练数据，也非压缩为单一整体判断。
AI.result: 在3个智能体基准、3个骨干模型、3个智能体框架上，CRG比言语化、采样式及白盒代理基线给出更好的校准置信与更强的风险感知决策。发现仅凭校准误差可能误导：白盒代理基线看似校准良好却接近随机判别。消融显示改进源于主张级置信估计与聚合，而非仅图构建。CRG暴露主张与轨迹证据，可在决策时审计。
AI.conclusion: CRG通过轨迹证据分解与聚合实现校准置信估计，适用于访问受限、数据稀缺的实际智能体部署，并提供可审计性。

title: Does On-Policy Distillation for Safety Pose Backdoor Risks?
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has attracted growing attention as an effective way to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models. Recent studies further explore OPD as a tool for improving large language model safety with promising results. However, these approaches typically assume that the teacher and training data are trustworthy. In this paper, we uncover an overlooked threat to OPD for safety: a safety-aligned but backdoored teacher can propagate its hidden malicious behavior to an initially clean student. Under our threat model, a poisoning rate as low as 3% results in an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 70% on the distilled student. We further identify two training choices that can amplify this risk. First, increasing the number of training epochs can lead to high ASR even at low poisoning rates. With only 10 poisoned samples, ASR reaches 67% after 16 epochs. Second, the commonly used top-k KL can accelerate backdoor transfer, causing trigger-conditioned harmful behavior to emerge earlier than sampled-token KL in most settings. Alongside these findings, we explore a simple mitigation, Lazy Defense, which clips KL rewards to make student updates less aggressive, limiting aggressive updates and slowing backdoor learning. Experiments show that Lazy Defense delays backdoor transfer in low poisoning rate settings. Together, our findings reveal that OPD can propagate backdoors, highlighting the need to address the safety risks of OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示on-policy distillation (OPD)的安全隐患：一个安全对齐但被植入后门的教师模型会将其隐藏的恶意行为传播给干净的学生模型，并探讨了放大风险的因素及一种缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 近期研究用OPD提升大模型安全性，但普遍假设教师模型与训练数据可信。本文发现这一假设存在被忽视的威胁：安全对齐但含后门的教师会通过OPD传播后门给学生。
AI.method: 提出针对OPD安全性的威胁模型——使用安全对齐但被植入后门的教师进行蒸馏。分析两个放大风险的因素：训练轮数增加、top-k KL（相比采样token KL）。并提出Lazy Defense缓解方法，通过裁剪KL奖励使更新更温和。
AI.result: 仅3%投毒率即可使蒸馏学生攻击成功率(ASR)高达70%；仅10个中毒样本训练16轮后ASR达67%；top-k KL在多数设置下比采样token KL更早引发后门。Lazy Defense能在低投毒率下延迟后门转移。
AI.conclusion: OPD会传播后门，凸显了亟需解决OPD安全风险的必要性。

title: HuC-VideoMAE: Human-Centric Video Masked Autoencoding from synthetic data
summary: Modern action recognition models rely on video transformers pretrained on massive collections of web-crawled videos, such as Kinetics-700. However, the use of such data raises ethical concerns, as subjects' consent is typically not obtained. Recent high-quality synthetic video datasets generated from motion-capture data, such as BEDLAM2.0, offer a promising ethical alternative. In this work, we investigate self-supervised pretraining of video transformers on synthetic human-motion datasets. We first show that directly applying the standard VideoMAE masking strategy leads to substantially worse performance than pretraining on Kinetics. To address this limitation, we propose a human-centric masking scheme that leverages body keypoints and person bounding box regions. Our approach encourages the model to focus on the structure and dynamics of human motion during pretraining. Experiments on NTU RGB+D and Toyota-Smarthome demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms standard VideoMAE pretraining on synthetic data, closing 49% of the gap to Kinetics pretraining on NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject without using a single real frame during pretraining. To promote the use of ethical action recognition models, we will publicly release our pretrained models.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在合成人体运动数据集上自监督预训练视频Transformer，提出以人体为中心的掩码策略，缩小与Kinetics预训练的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有动作识别模型依赖未经被拍摄者同意的网络爬取视频（如Kinetics-700）进行预训练，存在伦理问题。合成视频数据集（如BEDLAM2.0）是伦理替代方案，但直接套用VideoMAE掩码策略效果显著差于Kinetics预训练。
AI.method: 提出以人体为中心的掩码方案，利用身体关键点和人物边界框区域，引导模型在预训练中关注人体运动的结构与动态。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D和Toyota-Smarthome上显著优于合成数据的标准VideoMAE预训练；在NTU RGB+D跨视角-跨被试设置下，不使用任何真实帧，缩小了与Kinetics预训练49%的差距。
AI.conclusion: 以人体为中心的掩码能有效提升合成数据预训练效果，为伦理合规的动作识别模型提供可行路径，作者将公开预训练模型。

title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

AI.tldr: TRACE 是一种面向 MoE 语言模型 RL 训练的 FP4 量化框架，通过 rollout 引导的量化感知训练对齐训练与 rollout 两条量化路径，实现高效 FP4 rollout 且性能接近 BF16。
AI.motivation: RL 后训练 LLM 时 rollout 生成的算力与内存开销巨大，低精度 rollout 是提升效率的方向；但现有 FP4 RL 方法仅独立优化训练路径和 rollout 路径的量化精度，未直接缩小两条量化执行路径之间的差异。
AI.method: 提出 TRACE：1）rollout 引导的量化感知训练，用 rollout 侧量化结果指导训练侧 FP4 舍入决策，直接降低 train-rollout 差异；2）高效的量化信息缓存方案，选择性保留深层尾数与 scale 信息，降低 rollout 引导带来的存储与通信开销。面向 MoE 语言模型的 FP4 权重/激活与 FP4 KV-cache。
AI.result: 在四个大规模 MoE 语言模型、涵盖推理、编码和长时程 RL 任务上评估：支持 FP4 权重/激活与 FP4 KV-cache 联合 rollout，RL 性能与 BF16 rollout 相当，rollout 提速最高达 5.4 倍，且最终 FP4 性能优于对 BF16 训练策略的事后 FP4 量化。
AI.conclusion: 直接对齐训练与 rollout 的量化路径是提升 FP4 RL 效率与性能的关键，TRACE 在保持 BF16 级 RL 性能的同时显著加速 rollout，并优于事后量化方案。

title: Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces
summary: Mobile GUI agents increasingly operate on interfaces influenced by users' histories and preferences, but their reliability across different users remains underexplored. We introduce PAIR (Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering), a pipeline for constructing user-conditioned application states that enables controlled evaluation of the same task across different users. We further introduce RePAIR (Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards), a training approach that learns from cross-user differences in subgoal outcomes to improve reliability across user-conditioned mobile environments. Across six agents, we find substantial variation in task success across users and consistently lower subgoal achievement in user-conditioned UI contexts (6.98 to 15.4 pp). This gap further increases for personal targets drawn from each user's own content (8.77 to 22.0 pp). Failures in these contexts frequently involve selecting another item instead of the intended target, particularly before target exposure. Finally, RePAIR improves user-conditioned SAR (+5.87 pp), all-success (+7.50 pp), and overall Task SR (+9.42 pp) over its supervised fine-tuning parent on unseen users, providing initial evidence that explicitly learning from cross-user variation can improve GUI-agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PAIR构建用户个性化应用状态用于评测，并提出RePAIR训练方法，通过跨用户子目标差异学习提升移动GUI智能体的用户条件可靠性。
AI.motivation: 移动GUI智能体在受用户历史和偏好影响的界面上运行，但其在不同用户间的可靠性尚未被充分研究，缺乏可控的跨用户评测手段。
AI.method: PAIR（个性化应用状态实例化与渲染）管线构建用户条件的应用状态，实现同一任务在不同用户下的受控评估；RePAIR则利用跨用户子目标结果差异作为个性化感知的交互奖励进行强化学习训练。
AI.result: 六个智能体在不同用户间成功率差异显著；用户条件UI下子目标达成率下降6.98–15.4个百分点，针对用户个人内容的个性化目标下降更多（8.77–22.0个百分点），失败常表现为在目标暴露前选错条目。RePAIR在未见用户上相较SFT基线提升用户条件SAR +5.87pp、all-success +7.50pp、整体Task SR +9.42pp。
AI.conclusion: 显式从跨用户差异中学习可提升GUI智能体在用户条件环境下的可靠性，为个性化移动智能体训练提供了初步证据。

title: MS-ECG-FM: Towards a More Universal Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Health Monitoring using Multi-source Contrastive Learning
comment: Andrew C. Miller, Joseph Futoma: equal contribution. 52 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables, including supplementary information
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) records the electrical activity of the heart, aiding diagnosis by detecting abnormalities in cardiac function. ECG foundation models have demonstrated promising results, but are limited by a reliance on ECG interpretation reports as their sole supervision. Because interpretation reports only capture the subset of waveform information routinely recognized by clinicians, this constrains representation learning to overlook the broader diagnostic signals present in ECG. We introduce a new ECG foundation model --- MS-ECG-FM --- that is trained through contrastive alignment to multiple distinct clinical note types, including ECG, echocardiography, radiology, and discharge reports. We evaluate MS-ECG-FM on an extended set of ECG detection benchmarks, showing that it comprehensively outperforms existing methods on the full span of conditions that ECG can detect, including in reduced-lead configurations. Different reports improve representations for different diagnostic domains, while multi-source alignment captures their complementary information and produces consistently strong representations across clinically diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MS-ECG-FM，一种通过对比学习对齐多种临床报告类型（ECG、超声心动图、放射学、出院报告）的心电基础模型，在多项ECG检测任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有ECG基础模型仅依赖ECG解读报告作为监督信号，而解读报告只涵盖临床医生常规识别的部分波形信息，导致表示学习忽略了ECG中更广泛的诊断信号。
AI.method: 训练MS-ECG-FM，通过对比对齐（contrastive alignment）将其与多种不同的临床报告类型对齐，包括ECG报告、超声心动图报告、放射学报告和出院报告，而非仅使用单一ECG解读报告。
AI.result: 在扩展的ECG检测基准测试中，MS-ECG-FM全面超越现有方法，覆盖ECG可检测的全部病症范围，包括在减少导联配置下依然表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 不同报告对不同诊断领域的表示有改善作用，多源对齐能够捕获它们的互补信息，在临床多样任务上产生持续强劲的表示。

title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出Knee3DVLM，一种序列感知的视觉语言模型，利用全容积DESS和TSE膝关节MRI预测57个基于MOAKS的二元诊断目标，融合模型效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在三维医学影像中应用渐增，但在膝关节MRI上受限，尤其难以处理临床中互补序列的解读。
AI.method: 构建序列感知的VLM，使用全容积DESS与流体敏感TSE MRI，预测源自MOAKS的57个解剖分辨二元诊断目标；在OAI受试者不重叠划分下评估DESS单序列、TSE单序列与DESS-TSE配对三种配置。
AI.result: 在1,074例留出队列中，融合模型达到72.98%平均准确率、71.17%平衡准确率、78.96%平均ROC-AUC和78.74%宏ROC-AUC，为三种配置中最高。次级多分类分析中，在五个病理类别上数值高于报告的最强3DReasonKnee配置。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用双序列全容积建模以实现全面的膝关节MRI评估。

title: Learning from Revision Consequences: Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation for Self-Improving Agents
summary: As agents continuously improve by generating and revising Skills, the process that discovers and refines those Skills becomes a learnable object in its own right. Task-Skills directly act on task execution, whereas Meta-Skills govern how agents discover and improve future Skills; their value therefore emerges through the subsequent search processes they induce. Existing approaches improve Meta-Skills from observed raw Skill-search trajectories and branch outcomes. However, branch performance entangles the effects of the initial discovery state and the Meta-Skill revision that generated the search process, making it difficult to characterize what a particular revision actually changed, and pushing updates toward revisions that benefit from favorable states rather than those that improve the process. We introduce HMED (Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation), a mechanism for constructing Meta-Experience for self-improving agents. HMED revisits the completed event from which a revision originates and re-executes the incumbent and revised Meta-Skills from the same restored discovery state, so that the changes associated with the revision can be observed under a shared condition. Each comparison is distilled into a Meta-Experience, a structured record that can be reused by future updates, so that even revisions that are not ultimately retained still contribute a learning signal. Across three interactive agent benchmarks and both open-source and closed-source models, HMED consistently improves Skill discovery performance over strong baselines, shifting Meta-Skill learning beyond branch outcomes toward the consequences of changing the improvement process.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HMED机制，通过在同一恢复的发现状态下重执行新旧Meta-Skills，消除初始状态与分支结果的混淆，构建可复用的Meta-Experience，从而提升自改进智能体的Skill发现能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法从原始Skill搜索轨迹和分支结果中改进Meta-Skills，但分支表现混合了初始发现状态和Meta-Skill修订的效果，难以刻画某次修订究竟改变了什么，导致更新偏向于依赖有利状态的修订，而非真正改善过程的修订。
AI.method: HMED（Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation）回访修订所源自的已完成事件，从同一恢复的发现状态重执行现有和修订后的Meta-Skills，在共享条件下观察修订带来的变化；每次比较被蒸馏为结构化的Meta-Experience，可被未来更新复用，使未被保留的修订也能贡献学习信号。
AI.result: 在三个交互式智能体基准以及开源和闭源模型上，HMED在Skill发现性能上持续优于强基线，将Meta-Skill学习从分支结果转向改变改进过程的后果。
AI.conclusion: HMED通过统一条件下的对照与经验蒸馏，解决了Meta-Skill学习中的归因混淆问题，为自改进智能体提供了更可靠的Meta-Skill优化机制。

title: Exact-Solution Volume and Length Generalization in Transformers
summary: Research on transformer expressivity shows whether a transformer is capable of solving a given task, but gives little indication of whether the solution, if learned, is generalizable to longer input lengths. We study this question through normalized exact-solution volume (NESV): the fraction of a bounded parameter region that achieves an exact solution on every input of length $n$. For fixed-width, single-layer transformers with $\log n$-scaled attention, we establish asymptotic bounds on NESV for four tasks: FIRST ($Θ(1)$), MAJORITY ($Θ(1/(n\log n))$), INDEX ($Θ(1/n^3)$), and PARITY ($0$). These results are consistent with previous empirical results: the faster the exact-solution volume decays with input length, the harder it is to length-generalize on that task. Looking deeper into INDEX, our volume analysis reveals two error sources that grow with $n$. Consequently, we study a transformer model that would structurally eliminate one of the terms, theoretically improving the NESV bound to $Θ(n^{-1})$, and empirically achieving 85% accuracy when tested at $10\times$ the training length, compared with the 60% accuracy of the original model. We conclude that volume analysis may be a useful approach to identify concrete sources of length sensitivity and thus provide insights into task-specific model refinements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出归一化解空间体积（NESV）度量Transformer对长度泛化的能力，并对四个任务给出渐近界，发现解体积衰减越快越难长度泛化，且该分析可指导模型改进。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer表达性研究只关注任务能否被求解，却几乎无法说明学到的解能否泛化到更长输入长度，因此需要一个能刻画长度泛化难度的理论度量。
AI.method: 定义NESV为在长度为n的每个输入上都取得精确解的参数区域占比。针对固定宽度、单层、注意力按logn缩放的Transformer，对FIRST、MAJORITY、INDEX、PARITY四个任务推导NESV的渐近上下界，并针对INDEX的误差来源设计可结构性消除其中一项的模型。
AI.result: NESV界为：FIRST为Θ(1)，MAJORITY为Θ(1/(n log n))，INDEX为Θ(1/n^3)，PARITY为0。这与经验结果一致：解体积随长度衰减越快越难长度泛化。对INDEX的改进模型理论上把界提升到Θ(n^{-1})，实测在10倍训练长度下达到85%准确率（原模型60%）。
AI.conclusion: 体积分析可用于识别长度敏感性的具体来源，从而为任务特定的模型改进提供洞见。

title: 2D Spatial Reasoning with Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Many modern learning approaches are still struggling with spatial reasoning tasks, i.e. they lack the ability to utilize geometric information of perceived entities and their spatial relation to each other to solve problems. We introduce a novel Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata (aNCA) architecture which uses deformable convolutions to dynamically adapt the perceptive field and iteratively reason over 2D spatial relations on grid-like data structures (e.g. images). Empirical results on public benchmarks show state of the art comprehensible results with high generalization abilities for solving image based puzzles like Sudoku or finding the shortest path in a maze.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应神经细胞自动机(aNCA)架构，利用可变形卷积动态调整感受野，在网格类数据上迭代推理2D空间关系，在数独、迷宫最短路径等图像谜题上取得SOTA且具强泛化能力的结果。
AI.motivation: 现代学习方法仍难以胜任空间推理任务，缺乏利用感知实体的几何信息及其相互空间关系来解决问题的能力。
AI.method: 提出Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata (aNCA)架构，采用可变形卷积(deformable convolutions)动态适应感受野，在图像等网格状数据结构上迭代推理2D空间关系。
AI.result: 在公开基准上取得当前最优(SOTA)且可理解的结果，对解决数独等图像谜题及迷宫最短路径问题具有高泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: aNCA通过可变形卷积与迭代空间推理，有效提升了空间推理任务的表现与泛化性。

title: Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Code, policies, evaluation and videos: https://github.com/JordyKieto/puffermoba-dyna
summary: World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.

AI.tldr: 本文从"外部"评判世界模型：用MOBA游戏实测策略胜率。构建十英雄完整MOBA的结构化多智能体世界模型（206单位，每tick全英雄行动），仅在梦中训练策略，再在真实游戏中对战内置对手。采用异步Dyna循环，真实游戏只提供数据和在线评估，不提供梯度。策略作为天辉方胜率达70.2%（421/600），而仅靠梦境训练为0%，循环前为33.7%。四项发现解释该结果：模型利用在梦内不可见；世界模型在策略自身对局上失准，Dyna可修复（+9.2点）；策略继承世界模型的保真度特征。
AI.motivation: 已有研究多从内部指标（预测损失、想象回报、画面逼真度）评判世界模型，但这些指标未必反映真实任务表现。本文主张从"外部"——即在真实游戏中策略的实际胜率——来评判世界模型，以验证世界模型能否支撑有效的策略学习。
AI.method: 构建十英雄完整MOBA的结构化多智能体世界模型（206单位、每tick全英雄、最长6000tick对局），仅在世界模型内用1400tick自由运行想象回合训练策略（dream-PPO）。运行连续异步Dyna循环：真实游戏不提供梯度，而是将策略自身对局作为世界模型的训练数据，并做在线评估以选择和锚定策略。在未用于任何决策的随机种子上，于真实游戏中对战游戏自带对手进行评测。
AI.result: 作为天辉方真实胜率70.2%（421/600，95% CI 66.4–73.7），相比仅梦境训练的0%和循环前的33.7%大幅提升；作为夜魇方胜率为0，自带对手自我对弈亦为0。关键发现：未锚定的运行数次更新即崩溃且梦内指标无法察觉（模型利用在梦内不可见）；世界模型在策略自身对局上存在偏差，Dyna修复该项带来+9.2点真实胜率；策略逐机制继承世界模型保真度——模型能表示宏观博弈但不表示控制、施法时机和致命性，策略靠全图施压取胜，几乎无协同团战。
AI.conclusion: 从外部评判世界模型可行且必要：仅靠内部指标会漏掉模型利用与分布偏差问题。异步Dyna循环配合真实对局数据修复与在线评估，可显著提升真实胜率。策略表现深深受限于世界模型保真度：模型缺什么（控制、施法时机、致命性），策略就缺什么，转而以宏观施压取胜。作者开源世界模型、dream-PPO框架、世界模型调试器、评估协议及全部策略与日志。

title: Adaptive Model Inversion Attacks Generalize a Privacy-Robustness Tradeoff
summary:
In this paper, we show that standard evaluations of high-resolution Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) significantly underestimate training-data privacy leakage. State-of-the-art privacy defenses, standard training techniques such as MixUp and Adversarial Training, and undefended models all leak training images at rates 1.16 to 6.59 times higher on FaceScrub under simple adaptive changes to the attack, with the largest increases among defenses reporting the strongest privacy. We further show that measured leakage depends on the feature basis of the external classifier used to evaluate reconstructions: for the same reconstructed images, an adversarially trained Inception evaluator identifies the targeted identity at different rates than the standard Inception evaluator. Our results suggest that standard MIA evaluation can mistake optimization and measurement failures for privacy.
  These underestimated leakage rates also concealed a broader relationship between privacy and adversarial robustness. Once we adapt the attack and vary the evaluator, reconstruction leakage closely tracks adversarial robustness across recent defenses and standard training regimes, suggesting that robustness provides an attack-agnostic proxy for reconstruction vulnerability that applies far more broadly than previously theorized. This raises an open question: can a practical defense reduce training-data reconstruction without paying a corresponding cost in adversarial robustness?

AI.tldr: 标准高分辨率模型反演攻击(MIA)评估显著低估了训练数据隐私泄露，通过自适应调整攻击及变化评估器后，泄露率提升1.16–6.59倍，并揭示泄露与对抗鲁棒性强相关。
AI.motivation: 现有高分辨率MIA评估可能把优化失败和测量失败误认为隐私保护，导致对隐私泄露的系统性低估，也掩盖了隐私与对抗鲁棒性之间的真实关系。
AI.method: 对攻击进行简单的自适应改动，并更换外部评估分类器的特征基（标准Inception vs. 对抗训练Inception），在FaceScrub等数据及多种防御、标准训练技术（MixUp、对抗训练）和未防御模型上重新测量重建泄露。
AI.result: 在FaceScrub上各模型泄露率提高1.16至6.59倍，声称隐私最强的防御增幅最大；同一重建图像在不同评估器下识别目标身份的比例不同；调整攻击与评估器后，重建泄露与对抗鲁棒性高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 对抗鲁棒性可作为攻击无关的重建脆弱性代理，适用范围比以往理论更广；并引发开放问题——是否存在既能降低训练数据重建又能不牺牲对抗鲁棒性的实用防御。

title: MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

AI.tldr: MedCORE 提出一种面向临床标准的结构化诊断框架，将诊断过程分解为临床定义的准则，通过多尺度表征、图注意力网络、文本对齐和不确定性校准聚合，在三个异质医学影像任务上一致超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型直接从图像特征映射到疾病标签，跳过了临床医生系统评估的形态与纹理标准，缺乏诊断透明性，可能危及临床安全部署。
AI.method: 在视觉-语言架构中操作化临床推理：将诊断分解为临床准则；空间定位每个准则至相关图像区域；用多尺度表征编码宏观结构与微观纹理证据；用图注意力网络建模准则间依赖；将准则表征与临床文本描述对齐；通过类级视觉原型强化；并用不确定性校准加权聚合，按比例折减低置信度证据。
AI.result: ISIC 2018：89.2% 准确率、85.7% macro-F1、96.4% AUC；BUSI：96.1% 准确率、95.2% macro-F1、98.4% AUC；IDRiD：84.3% 准确率、80.2% macro-F1、92.8% AUC，均优于 CNN、Transformer、生物医学视觉-语言、概念型及原型型强基线。
AI.conclusion: MedCORE 在三种临床异质影像模态上验证了结构化、可解释的诊断推理能带来一致的性能提升。

title: Same Feedback, Different Answer: Measuring Run-to-Run Instability in Frontier-Model Customer Feedback Analysis
summary: AI agents are increasingly being programmed to automate knowledge work over large collections of unstructured data. Such automation requires repeatability: when the underlying evidence is unchanged, the agent's categories, priorities, and counts should not shift materially between runs, even if each individual answer appears plausible. We introduce a repeat-run evaluation framework that aligns semantically equivalent categories and focuses on two operating metrics: theme churn, the normalized change in the returned category set, and volume disagreement, the change in counts for categories that persist. We evaluate three recurring customer-feedback tasks across eight frontier models, corpus sizes from 100 to 5,000 records, multiple prompts, and three execution designs: raw generation, taxonomy-free hierarchical decomposition, and a taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) using persistent themes, subthemes, and record-level predictions. With Claude Opus 4.8 and the 1,000-record corpus fixed, TGA reduces theme churn by 86--88% relative to both raw generation and hierarchical decomposition, while matched-theme volumes have zero disagreement. The taxonomy-grounded agent is more stable than every raw model in the screen, remains more stable at each corpus size, and keeps this advantage when theme matching is made stricter or looser. Although evaluated on customer feedback, the framework targets repeated synthesis of unstructured corpora more broadly, including financial reports, legal documents, incident records, and scientific literature. Overall, these results show that taxonomy grounding produces more consistent and repeatable outputs for recurring knowledge work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出重复运行评估框架，用主题流失和数量分歧两个指标衡量AI agent在非结构化数据知识工作中的可重复性，发现taxonomy-grounded agent显著更稳定。
AI.motivation: AI agent被越来越多用于自动化处理大规模非结构化数据上的知识工作，此类自动化要求可重复性：当底层证据不变时，agent返回的类别、优先级和计数不应在多次运行间发生实质变化。然而现有评估多关注单次答案的合理性，缺乏对重复运行稳定性的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出重复运行评估框架，对语义等价的类别进行对齐，聚焦两个操作指标：主题流失（返回类别集合的归一化变化）和数量分歧（持续存在类别的计数变化）。在三个反复出现的客户反馈任务上评估八种前沿模型，语料规模从100到5000条记录，多种提示词，三种执行设计：原始生成、无taxonomy的层次分解、以及使用持久主题/子主题/记录级预测的taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA)。
AI.result: 在Claude Opus 4.8和1000条记录语料固定设置下，TGA相较原始生成和层次分解将主题流失降低86%-88%，匹配主题的数量分歧为零。TGA比所有原始模型更稳定，在各语料规模下都保持稳定，且在主题匹配更严格或更宽松时仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明taxonomy grounding能为反复出现的知识工作产生更一致、可重复的输出。该框架虽在客户反馈上评估，但可推广到金融报告、法律文件、事件记录和科学文献等更广泛的非结构化语料重复综合场景。

title: Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM). 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态几何评分对模态退化的响应，发现扰动位移大小最多解释15%方差，提出方向性几何响应DGR（位移在体积梯度上的投影），其绝对一阶项可高精度解释观察到的响应。
AI.motivation: 基于Gram行列式的几何对齐分数能紧凑建模模态间高阶一致性，但其对模态退化的响应机制尚不清楚。本文探究响应是否主要由扰动位移大小决定。
AI.method: 使用MSR-VTT（N=878）和DiDeMo（N=980）冻结队列，施加受控视频模糊和音频噪声。通过Gram矩阵体积的一阶展开推导出DGR（Directional Geometric Response），即位移在局部体积梯度上的投影，联合刻画干净操作点、位移大小与方向。并设定增益归一化候选V/(g_V+eps)的预设门控检验。
AI.result: 位移大小最多解释15%的样本外方差，大小匹配对响应系统性不同。DGR绝对一阶项样本外R²为0.838-0.969，大小匹配排序准确率0.864-0.963，响应符号准确率0.909-0.989；无方向替代方案较弱或不稳定。增益归一化候选未通过可预测性与干净序门控。
AI.conclusion: 几何响应并非由位移大小决定，而是取决于表示所在的操作点、退化移动关系几何的距离及方向。DGR使用观察到的退化态位移，是解释性量而非部署期预测器。

title: $α$Transfer: Coefficient Transfer for Efficient Model Merging
summary: Model merging offers a promising solution for combining multiple fine-tuned checkpoints into a single model through parameter arithmetic.
