Each evaluation unit contains appearance reference images, a held-out real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations. We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion. The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real-proxy frames. All released scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673. RenderBench provides paired real observations and editable scene state for assessing both appearance fidelity and preservation of geometry and dynamics.

AI.tldr: RenderBench 是一个评估"渲染到真实"(render-to-real)视频生成能力的基准，包含 12 个重建的真实场景，提供配对真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生及匹配的代理渲染。
AI.motivation: 评估视频模型的 render-to-real 能力需要同一场景演化的真实目标视频，以及可编辑、几何配准的 3D 副本，但此类数据传统上需要大量人工建模、标定和动画制作。
AI.method: 构建流程结合视觉几何、神经重建与辅助 3D 编辑；每个场景分解为静态物体和动态演员，并与拍摄相机配准。经多视角几何与时序验证后，每个评估单元包含外观参考图、留出的真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生、匹配代理渲染及渲染器原生场景标注。
AI.result: 首个版本保留 12/14 个配准样本（85.7%），含 1496 对真实-代理帧；所有场景通过文件完整性与环境编辑审计；代理诊断得到深度 si-RMSE 0.2170、实例 mIoU 0.3673。
AI.conclusion: RenderBench 提供配对的真实观测与可编辑场景状态，用于评估外观保真度以及几何与动态的保持能力。

title: Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology
summary: We report on an approach to teaching logic to mixed groups of computer science, mathematics, and philosophy students, based on the logico-pluralistic LogiKEy methodology, used for more than a decade in courses, summer schools, and tutorials. LogiKEy uses classical higher-order logic (HOL) as a universal metalogic in which object logics, classical and non-classical alike, are encoded by defining their semantics; through these semantical embeddings a single proof assistant (e.g. Isabelle/HOL), with its automated theorem provers and (counter-)model finders, becomes one environment in which students learn, experiment with, and compare logics. After making the pedagogical case for proof assistants in the logic classroom, we present a graded sequence of classroom examples, each transition motivated by a limitation of the preceding representation, by a need for more explicit modelling resources, or by a new application. A liars-and-truth-tellers puzzle leads from propositional to modal logic; the Wise Men puzzle leads on to dynamic epistemic logic; Boolos's curious inference illustrates what a higher-order meta-logic buys, even for automated proof search; Chisholm's paradox takes the sequence into deontic logic, and from standard to dyadic deontic logic; and Gödel's ontological argument brings it to a research-level metaphysical argument. We then rebut the objection that embedding everything in classical HOL is monism rather than pluralism, reflect on three years of teaching such a course, and sketch the portability of the approach beyond Isabelle.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍基于LogiKEy方法向计算机、数学和哲学混合学生群体教授逻辑的教学实践，用经典高阶逻辑HOL作为通用元逻辑，通过语义嵌入编码多种对象逻辑，使单一证明助手成为比较、实验逻辑的统一环境。文章给出渐进式课堂案例序列（说谎者谜题→模态逻辑、智者谜题→动态认知逻辑、Boolos推论→高阶元逻辑、Chisholm悖论→道义逻辑、Gödel本体论论证），并回应"经典HOL是独元论而非多元论"的质疑，反思三年教学经验并讨论跨平台移植可能性。
AI.motivation: 面向计算机科学、数学和哲学混合背景的学生教授逻辑存在困难：不同学科对逻辑的需求和理解各异，而传统教学难以让学生在同一环境中学习、实验并比较经典与非经典逻辑。
AI.method: 采用LogiKEy逻辑多元主义方法，以经典高阶逻辑(HOL)作为通用元逻辑，通过定义语义来编码各种对象逻辑（经典的与非经典的）。借助语义嵌入，使单一证明助手（如Isabelle/HOL）及其自动定理证明器和（反）模型查找器成为统一学习环境。按梯度递进设计课堂案例序列。
AI.result: 案例序列包括：说谎者与诚实者谜题引导从命题逻辑走向模态逻辑；智者谜题引入动态认知逻辑；Boolos的奇特推理展示高阶元逻辑对自动证明搜索的价值；Chisholm悖论进入道义逻辑并从标准道义逻辑发展到二元道义逻辑；Gödel本体论论证推进到研究级形而上学论证。文中还反驳了"在经典HOL中嵌入一切属于独元论而非多元论"的反对意见。
AI.conclusion: 该教学法已应用于课程、暑期学校和教程逾十年。作者反思三年教学经验，并勾勒出该方法超越Isabelle的可移植性。

title: SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning
summary: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.

AI.tldr: SpaTime是一个流式VLM，将因果几何token融合进语言模型，并设计响应时间损失来监督回答时机，在流式空间推理任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需在视频流中边观察边推理，一旦信息足够就应答。现有含3D几何先验的VLM只能离线运行，而流式VLM缺乏显式3D表示，二者难以兼得。
AI.method: 提出SpaTime：每帧将因果几何token融合进语言模型，仅用已观测帧；并提出响应时间损失，把每帧响应概率映射为可微的期望响应时间，惩罚其与真实帧的距离。
AI.result: 在StreamVSTI-Bench上整体准确率49.2%，平均响应时间误差相比最强流式基线降低66%；并构建了StreamVSTI-Bench和StreamVSI-Bench两个流式评测基准。
AI.conclusion: SpaTime证明可在流式设定下结合3D几何推理与自主应答时机决策，实现准确且及时的具身空间问答。

title: Align, Then Correct: Training-Free Two-Stage Low-Rank Compensation for Extremely Quantized Large Language Models
summary: Low-rank quantization error compensation (LQEC) recovers the accuracy lost under aggressive weight quantization by attaching a closed-form rank-$r$ adapter beside each frozen quantized weight, without any training. We show that existing compensators are limited by two shared simplifications. They calibrate symmetrically, evaluating the full-precision and compensated weights on the same activation, which yields a compensation target that is inherently high-rank -- so a fixed rank budget captures only a small fraction of it. And they minimize only the second-order term of the loss, although the compensated model is not stationary: a first-order descent direction larger than the applied compensation itself remains in every layer, and no reconstruction objective can absorb it. We propose a two-stage closed-form framework that removes both simplifications. Stage 1 aligns each layer's output with the full-precision model under a Fisher-weighted asymmetric objective, concentrating the rank budget on a rank-compressible target. Stage 2 re-measures statistics on the compensated model and applies a rank-constrained natural-gradient step that absorbs the remaining first-order signal. Every adapter is the result of a single truncated SVD; backward passes serve only to collect statistics. At 2 bits under QuIP#, our method reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 12.43 to 10.26 on Qwen3-8B and from 21.11 to 13.22 on Qwen3-4B. On the held-out C4 corpus, it recovers 51% and 84% of the gap to FP16, versus 31% and 63% for the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in the seven-task zero-shot average, at higher bit-widths, and under a distinct quantizer.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段闭式框架，改进低秩量化误差补偿（LQEC），无需训练即可显著恢复激进权重量化的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有补偿器有两个简化：1）对称校准（全精度与补偿权重用同一激活评估），导致补偿目标本质高秩，固定秩预算只能捕获小部分；2）只最小化损失的二阶项，但补偿模型非平稳，每层仍存在比补偿本身更大的first-order下降方向，重建目标无法吸收。
AI.method: 两阶段闭式框架：阶段1在Fisher加权非对称目标下对齐每层输出与全精度模型，将秩预算集中在可秩压缩目标；阶段2在补偿模型上重新测量统计量，施加秩约束自然梯度步吸收剩余一阶信号。每个适配器来自一次截断SVD，反向传播仅用于收集统计量。
AI.result: 2bit QuIP#下，Qwen3-8B WikiText-2困惑度12.43→10.26，Qwen3-4B 21.11→13.22。C4上分别恢复51%和84%的FP16差距（最强基线为31%和63%），七任务零样本平均、更高位宽及不同量化器均有一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除对称校准和仅二阶最小化的简化，两阶段闭式方法在无需训练下显著提升量化补偿效果，泛化性好。

title: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
summary: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge. To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench, a benchmark of newly designed text-based games, whose rules are novel or counterintuitive, requiring agents to acquire knowledge through interaction rather than rely solely on pretrained knowledge. These games provide reproducible feedback and automatic scoring, enabling controlled evaluation of learning across repeated attempts. We also vary game instances to test whether agents can apply what they have learned to new situations. Therefore, we evaluate how backbone models, self-evolving methods, and agent harnesses affect agents' learning ability, revealing three findings: (1) Experience retention: Retaining complete records of actions and feedback can support more effective learning than summarizing these experiences into rules or strategies. (2) Human agent gap: Top-performing human players achieve higher peak scores than the evaluated agents. Human explore more varied strategies, and repeat actions less. (3) Harness matters: With the backbone fixed, changing the harness can improve performance while reducing estimated inference cost. Together, these findings provide insights into how LLM agents learn from experience and suggest directions for future work to improve their learning ability. Project website: https://liushiliushi.github.io/learn2play-bench-website/

AI.tldr: 提出 Learn2Play Bench，用规则新颖/反直觉的文本游戏评估 LLM 智能体从交互中学习的能力，并揭示经验保留、人机差距、harness 三个关键发现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准的任务规则多已在指令中给出或为预训练模型所熟悉，难以区分"从交互中学习"与"利用已有知识推理"，因此无法有效评估智能体的经验学习能力。
AI.method: 设计规则新颖或反直觉的文本游戏基准 Learn2Play Bench，要求智能体通过交互获取知识；游戏提供可复现反馈和自动评分，支持重复尝试下的受控评估；通过变换游戏实例测试迁移能力；并评估骨干模型、自进化方法和 agent harness 的影响。
AI.result: 三点发现：(1) 经验保留：保留完整的动作与反馈记录比将其总结为规则或策略更利于学习；(2) 人机差距：顶尖人类玩家的峰值分数高于所评估的智能体，人类策略更多样、重复动作更少；(3) Harness 重要：固定骨干模型时，更换 harness 可提升性能并降低估计推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为理解 LLM 智能体如何从经验中学习提供洞见，并指出未来提升其学习能力的方向。

title: TTNet: Multi-Task Deep Learning for Table Tennis Player Analysis with Smart Racket
summary: The AI CUP 2025 Precise Analysis of Table Tennis Smart Racket Data Competition introduced smart table tennis rackets that collect extensive player swing data, enabling research on table tennis big data. These data support in-depth analysis of players' return techniques and swing-force consistency, improving the accuracy of player skill assessment. This study focuses on six-axis sensor data collected by smart table tennis rackets and proposes TTNet, a novel deep learning model with multitask learning capabilities, to advance table tennis data analysis and related applications. TTNet combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs), residual networks (ResNet), and self-attention mechanisms to simultaneously predict four player attributes: gender, playing hand, years of experience, and skill level. We adopt a two-stage training strategy that incorporates data augmentation and task-specific loss functions to improve generalization on imbalanced data. Our approach achieved second place on the official competition leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTNet多任务深度学习模型，基于智能乒乓球拍的六轴传感器数据分析球员属性，在AI CUP 2025竞赛中获第二名。
AI.motivation: 智能乒乓球拍可采集大量挥拍数据，支持对球员回球技术与力量一致性的深入分析，从而提升球员技能评估的准确性，但如何高效利用这些数据仍待研究。
AI.method: TTNet结合CNN、ResNet与自注意力机制，同时预测性别、持拍手、经验年限与技能水平四个属性；采用两阶段训练策略，融合数据增强与任务特定损失函数以应对数据不平衡。
AI.result: 在AI CUP 2025官方竞赛排行榜上获得第二名。
AI.conclusion: TTNet有效提升了乒乓球六轴传感器数据的多任务分析能力，为球员技能评估等应用提供了可行方案。

title: Co-Evolving Paths and Flows via Path-Flow Alignment
summary: We study path-flow alignment as a unified training objective for flow matching. Instead of fixing the interpolation path and learning only the velocity field, we jointly train an endpoint-preserving path network and a flow network using the same alignment loss: the flow learns to match the path velocity, and the path learns to align its velocity to the current flow. Although every fixed learned path defines a valid flow-matching objective, the alignment loss alone is not a reliable criterion for path learning. We identify path overfitting, a failure mode in which the alignment loss decreases while sample quality worsens. We find that this failure is associated with low-entropy bottlenecks in the induced probability path, where the learned path routes samples through overly concentrated intermediate marginals. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce a stochastic path regularizer that hides part of the source information from the path network while preserving exact endpoints. The resulting regularization gives an explicit entropy floor for the stochastic training-path marginals and empirically suppresses the bottleneck in the learned sampler, making joint path-flow training effective. On ImageNet-256x256 with SiT backbones, our method consistently improves FID across model scales, extends to model-guidance training, and leaves the inference-time architecture and sampler unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper

AI.tldr: 本文提出路径-流对齐作为flow matching的统一训练目标，联合训练路径网络与流网络；针对路径过拟合与低熵瓶颈问题，引入随机路径正则化，在ImageNet-256上提升FID。
AI.motivation: 传统flow matching固定插值路径，仅学习速度场，未联合优化路径本身；而直接以对齐损失学习路径不可靠，会出现路径过拟合。
AI.method: 联合训练保持端点的路径网络和流网络，共享对齐损失：流学习匹配路径速度，路径对齐其速度到当前流。提出随机路径正则化，隐藏部分源信息以保持精确端点，为随机训练路径边缘提供熵下限。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256x256、SiT骨干上，方法在各模型规模上持续提升FID，并扩展至model-guidance训练，推理架构与采样器保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 识别并诊断路径过拟合与低熵瓶颈问题，通过随机路径正则化使联合路径-流训练有效，且不改变推理流程。

title: CoDe-LoRA: Mitigating the Orthogonality Dilemma in Continual Learning of LLMs via Knowledge Consolidation and Decoupling
summary: Continual learning (CL) is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to sequentially adapt to evolving tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, recent advances implement low-rank adaptation with orthogonal projections (e.g., O-LoRA) to isolate task parameters. However, we reveal that such strict geometric constraints trigger an "Orthogonality Dilemma": rigid parameter isolation impedes the transfer and accumulation of shared representations across semantically related tasks. In this work, we propose a new replay-free method, called Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA (CoDe-LoRA), for CL of LLMs. CoDe-LoRA disentangles the learning process into Consolidating Universal Knowledge and Decoupling Task-Specific Knowledge. To achieve this, CoDe-LoRA leverages an adaptive null space projection mechanism and semantic routing to balance knowledge accumulation with task-specific adaptation. Experimental results across four backbones and three CL benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoDe-LoRA，一种无需回放的持续学习方法，通过解耦通用知识巩固和任务特定知识，平衡知识积累与任务适应，解决现有正交投影方法中的"正交困境"。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如O-LoRA）用低秩适应结合正交投影来隔离任务参数以缓解灾难性遗忘，但严格的几何约束导致"正交困境"：僵化的参数隔离阻碍了语义相关任务间共享表征的迁移与积累。
AI.method: 提出CoDe-LoRA（Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA），将学习过程解耦为"巩固通用知识"和"解耦任务特定知识"两部分，采用自适应零空间投影机制和语义路由来实现。
AI.result: 在四个骨干模型和三个持续学习基准上，CoDe-LoRA取得了最佳平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: CoDe-LoRA通过自适应零空间投影与语义路由，有效平衡了知识积累与任务特定适应，验证了方法的有效性，代码已开源。

title: Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN): Resource-Aware Hybrid Vision-Language Fusion via Trainable Entanglement
summary: Multimodal vision-language systems typically fuse image and text embeddings through classical operators such as concatenation, attention, bilinear pooling, or tensor interactions. We propose Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN), a hybrid quantum-classical framework that introduces parameterized entanglement as a structured inductive bias for multimodal fusion. Pretrained visual and textual features are projected into compact latent spaces, encoded as angle-parameterized quantum states, processed through intra-modal and paired cross-modal entangling circuits, and measured to produce fused representations for retrieval. Under matched parameter budgets and identical frozen CLIP backbones, QEMFN outperforms classical fusion baselines on COCO-5k and Flickr30k, including multilayer perceptron, tensor fusion, FiLM, cross-attention, compact transformer, and a dequantized paired-topology analogue. An ablation suite isolates the quantum module's contribution from the surrounding classical projections, and quantum-centric analyses report Meyer-Wallach entangling capability, expressibility, gradient variance against barren-plateau bounds, and entropy-performance correlation under controls for training progress alongside an intervention study on the entangling component. QEMFN is executed under shot-based estimation, a noise-modeled fake backend, and a real superconducting device with zero-noise extrapolation. This work does not claim quantum computational advantage; the contribution is the framework together with a controlled empirical and quantum-centric evaluation that positions trainable entanglement as an interpretable, hardware-executable fusion mechanism at scales accessible on contemporary devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子纠缠多模态融合网络（QEMFN），将参数化量子纠缠作为结构化归纳偏置用于图文融合检索，在受控参数预算下优于多种经典融合基线，并给出量子中心化与硬件执行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视觉-语言系统多依赖拼接、注意力、双线性池化或张量交互等经典算子融合图文嵌入，缺乏可解释、硬件可执行的融合机制，作者探索将可训练量子纠缠作为融合归纳偏置。
AI.method: QEMFN将预训练视觉与文本特征投影到紧凑潜空间，编码为角度参数化量子态，经模态内与成对跨模态纠缠电路处理并测量得到融合表示用于检索。在相同参数预算与冻结CLIP骨干下，与MLP、张量融合、FiLM、交叉注意力、紧凑Transformer及去量子化配对拓扑类比基线对比；用消融分离量子模块贡献，并用Meyer-Wallach纠缠能力、表达性、梯度方差与贫瘠高原界、熵-性能相关性及纠缠组件干预研究进行分析；在采样估计、噪声建模假后端与真实超导设备（零噪声外推）上执行。
AI.result: 在COCO-5k与Flickr30k上，QEMFN在匹配参数预算与相同冻结CLIP骨干下优于所有对比经典融合基线；消融验证量子模块的独立贡献，量子中心化分析揭示纠缠能力、表达性与梯度行为，并在真实超导设备上完成执行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不主张量子计算优势，其贡献在于提出QEMFN框架，并通过受控的经验与量子中心化评估，将可训练纠缠定位为可解释、硬件可执行的融合机制，且规模适配当代量子设备。

title: CANDLE: Cortical Null-Space Decomposition for Noninvasive Brain Source Imaging
summary: Electrophysiological source imaging (ESI) aims to estimate cortical source activity from noninvasive electrophysiological measurements such as electroencephalogram (EEG). However, ESI is fundamentally ill-posed because source activity is substantially higher-dimensional than sensor observations, resulting in non-unique solutions. Recent learning-based approaches address this ambiguity by learning data-driven source priors, yet they often struggle to generalize across subject-specific cortical geometries. To address this, we propose CANDLE, a learning-based ESI model that estimates source activity on subject-specific cortical geometries. CANDLE learns a prior over the null space induced by the source-to-sensor mapping derived from T1-weighted MRI, restricting learning to unobservable source components while preserving geometric constraints. To train CANDLE, we develop a whole-brain simulator spanning over 1,100 subject-specific cortical geometries with source configurations derived from over 26,000 statistical brain maps. Trained exclusively on simulated data, CANDLE outperformed prior ESI methods on simulated source activity estimation and generalized to two empirical tasks: (i) intracranial stimulation localization from simultaneously recorded scalp EEG and (ii) epileptogenic zone estimation from presurgical interictal EEG. Our project page is available at https://candle-esi.pages.dev}{https://candle-esi.pages.dev.

AI.tldr: CANDLE是一种学习式脑电源成像模型，在受试者特异性皮层几何上估计源活动，通过学习源-传感器映射零空间的先验来保持几何约束，在模拟数据和两个真实任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: ESI从EEG等无创测量中估计皮层源活动，但因源活动维度远高于传感器观测而本质上是病态问题，解不唯一。现有学习式方法通过学习数据驱动源先验缓解歧义，但难以泛化到受试者特异性皮层几何。
AI.method: 提出CANDLE模型，在受试者特异性皮层几何上估计源活动。它学习由T1加权MRI导出的源-传感器映射所诱导的零空间上的先验，将学习限制在不可观测的源成分，同时保留几何约束。为训练模型，开发了覆盖1100多个受试者特异性皮层几何、源配置源自26000多张统计脑图的全脑模拟器。
AI.result: 仅用模拟数据训练的CANDLE在模拟源活动估计上优于先前ESI方法，并泛化到两个实证任务：(i) 从同步记录的头皮EEG定位颅内刺激；(ii) 从术前发作间期EEG估计致痫区。
AI.conclusion: CANDLE通过零空间先验学习和大规模模拟器训练，解决了ESI的泛化性问题，在模拟与真实任务上均表现优异。

title: Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error
summary: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)的后训练提升(lifting)方法，通过融合多视角信息将2D检测结果转移到3D高斯上，再迁移到mesh顶点进行语义分割评估，有效分离并分析各环节误差来源。
AI.motivation: 同一3D高斯在不同视角下可能被遮挡、检测器置信度不同，导致类别判断不一致；且由于两次训练产生的高斯不同，真值只能以标注mesh形式给出，因此需要一种能融合多视角信息、兼容mesh真值的后训练提升方法。
AI.method: 提出后训练lifting方法，每次处理一个目标类别，累积来自所有视角的目标/非目标证据，并按高斯在各视角的可见性加权。使用双阈值过滤：主阈值β选取高置信种子，较低阈值γβ加入其周围连通分量。评估时将标签从高斯迁移到既可见又标注的mesh顶点，从而分离2D检测器、lifting和表示间迁移三个误差来源。
AI.result: 阈值和迁移算子仅在7个Replica验证场景上选取，并在10个ScanNet++测试场景上以相同参数评估。验证场景mIoU：数据集标注mask为0.93，YOLO mask为0.65；ScanNet++测试场景分别为0.80和0.54。相比逐视角阈值化的旧版本，分数融合使测试mIoU提升0.24，并实现了对所有类别和场景使用单一阈值。
AI.conclusion: 错误分析表明剩余误差主要来自2D检测器。所提方法能有效融合多视角信息，且参数泛化性好，可用统一阈值跨数据集、类别和场景。

title: Toward Alignment Scaling Laws: A Framework and First Preregistered Measurements
comment: 34 pages, 24 figures, 8 tables. Games: https://www.aisafety.fun. Preregistrations: https://osf.io/wda8q, https://osf.io/q2j3y, https://osf.io/8kreb
summary: Whether alignment gets easier or harder as models grow is often argued from isolated findings, as if alignment were one property. We treat it as a family of measurable scaling relations: for each risk category r, the alignment burden needed to hold a fixed safety target is modeled as B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r, with N a capability proxy; against a budget proportional to N, scaling helps if alpha_r<1, keeps pace if alpha_r~1, and accumulates alignment debt if alpha_r>1. We give three operationalizations of burden and distinguish observed, audited and true alignment. A toy model, in which corrections consume capability headroom, makes the consequences explicit. We prove that the largest exponent among corrected risks, not an average, sets the long-run regime; that above 1 any policy holding headroom above a floor must grow super-exponentially; that, for burdens that are positive mixtures of power laws, fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents; and that an audit that uncovers hidden failures without false positives never underestimates true alignment. We propose a pre-registrable protocol and apply reduced versions of it twice. A preregistered reanalysis of public adversarial-training data for Pythia classifiers finds that the compute needed to bring attack success under 10% grows as N^0.60. A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B finds exponents of -0.05 for truthfulness and 0.48 for stated dispositions (both scaling helps under its reduced rule, though local slopes approach 1 at the top; replicated on Qwen3 0.6B-14B), while sycophancy (0.89, or 0.83 with two seeds added at 72B) and a planted backdoor are undetermined: the backdoor is removed quickly when its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at four of five sizes. We release four browser games that play these laws (www.aisafety.fun). We make no claim about which regime holds for current frontier models.

AI.tldr: 论文将"对齐难度随模型规模变化"重新形式化为一族可测量的标度关系：对每个风险类别r，维持固定安全目标所需的对齐负担建模为 B_r(N)=a_r N^{alpha_r}，并据此区分标度有益(α<1)、持平(α≈1)与对齐债务累积(α>1)三种状态。作者给出三种负担操作化并区分观测/审计/真实对齐，证明若干理论结论（校正风险中最大指数决定长期格局、α>1时需超指数增长、小模型拟合低估大尺度指数、无误报审计不会高估真实对齐），提出可预注册协议并做两次缩水实证：Pythia对抗训练数据重分析得 α≈0.60；Qwen2.5 0.5B–72B试点得真实性 α=-0.05、陈述性倾向 α=0.48（Qwen3复现），谄媚(0.89)与植入后门未确定。
AI.motivation: 关于"对齐是否随模型变大而变难"的争论常基于孤立发现，隐含假设对齐是单一属性。作者主张应把它拆解为一系列可测量的标度关系，从而能定量比较不同风险类别的对齐负担随能力增长的走势，并对政策与审计给出可证伪的框架。
AI.method: 1) 形式化：对每类风险r，把维持固定安全目标所需负担建模为幂律 B_r(N)=a_rN^{alpha_r}，N为能力代理；与正比于N的预算对比判定标度有益/持平/债务。2) 给出三种负担操作化，区分观测、审计与真实对齐。3) 构造"校正消耗能力余量"的玩具模型阐明后果。4) 证明四个理论命题（最大指数主导、α>1下保余量需超指数增长、混合幂律下小模型拟合低估大尺度指数、无误报审计不低估真实对齐）。5) 提出可预注册协议并执行两次缩减版实证：Pythia分类器对抗训练公开数据重分析与Qwen2.5/Qwen3的试点。
AI.result: 理论：校正风险中最大指数（非平均）决定长期标度格局；α>1时任何维持余量下限的策略必须超指数增长；小模型上拟合会低估大尺度指数；无误报审计从不低估真实对齐。实证：Pythia对抗训练数据重分析显示将攻击成功率压到10%以下所需算力按 N^0.60 增长；Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B试点得真实性指数-0.05、陈述性倾向0.48（在其缩减规则下均属标度有益，但顶端局部斜率趋近1；Qwen3 0.6B-14B复现），谄媚为0.89（加入两个72B种子后0.83）不确定，植入后门不确定——触发器已知时可快速移除，但在5个规模中有4个在盲目安全训练下存活。
AI.conclusion: 对齐应被视为一族风险类别各自的可测量标度关系，而非单一属性；不同风险可处于标度有益、持平或债务累积的不同状态，且最大指数主导长期格局。作者提出可预注册协议并发布四款演绎这些规律的浏览器游戏(www.aisafety.fun)，但明确不对当前前沿模型属于何种格局作出断言。

title: Retrieval Is Not Enough: Refreshing Memory for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
summary: Retrieval-augmented time-series forecasting uses the continuations of historical segments similar to the current context as references for a forecaster. Most existing methods build the retrieval memory once from the training segment, leaving observations revealed after deployment unavailable as references, and generally do not calibrate how much the retrieved information should influence a frozen forecaster. We identify two key determinants of retrieval utility for a frozen forecaster: whether the history still reflects the current state, and whether the correction it induces aligns with the forecaster's residual errors, an alignment that can shift between validation and deployment when the memory becomes stale. We propose FreshCast, a plug-in retrieval framework that keeps the forecaster frozen, continuously updates a non-parametric memory with new observations, forms a memory forecast through relational kernel regression, and calibrates its weight in closed form on the validation segment. Under a simplified generative model, we characterize the optimal combination gain through the second-order relation between forecaster error and memory correction, and show that a sufficiently long look-back can make periodic memory information redundant. Across seven benchmarks and ten forecasting architectures, FreshCast reduces average MSE for every evaluated forecaster and input length, by 14.6% and 5.6% at input lengths 96 and 720, and achieves lower MSE than the evaluated retrieval-augmented and online baselines in their comparison settings. Ablations show that freezing the memory at the end of training removes most of the gain, identifying post-training observations as a primary source of improvement. For a frozen forecaster, useful historical references must remain timely and provide information that helps correct its remaining errors.

AI.tldr: FreshCast：一种即插即用检索框架，冻结预测器、持续更新非参数记忆并用闭式校准权重，在7个基准和10种架构上均降低MSE。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强时间序列预测的记忆仅在训练段构建一次，部署后新观测无法作为参考；且未校准检索信息对冻结预测器的影响程度。作者指出检索效用的两个关键决定因素：历史是否仍反映当前状态，以及校正是否与预测器残差对齐（该对齐在记忆过时后可能偏移）。
AI.method: FreshCast保持预测器冻结，持续用新观测更新非参数记忆；通过关系核回归形成记忆预测，并在验证段以闭式解校准其权重。在简化生成模型下，用预测器误差与记忆校正的二阶关系刻画最优组合增益，并证明足够长的回看可使周期性记忆信息冗余。
AI.result: 在7个基准和10种预测架构上，FreshCast对每个预测器和输入长度均降低平均MSE；输入长度96和720时分别降低14.6%和5.6%，优于评估的检索增强与在线基线。消融显示训练结束时冻结记忆会移除大部分增益，表明训练后观测是主要改进来源。
AI.conclusion: 对冻结预测器而言，有用的历史参考必须保持时效性，并提供有助于纠正其剩余误差的信息。

title: Data Leakage in Patch-Based Hyperspectral Image Classification: Quantifying the Impact of Spatial Overlap
comment: paper accepted for presentation at IEEE-WHISPERS
summary: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage (OP), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio (AOR), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5x5 to 19x19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于patch的高光谱图像分类中训练-测试集空间重叠导致的数据泄漏问题，提出两种度量指标，并通过实验证明随机采样会显著高估模型性能。
AI.motivation: 基于patch的方法利用局部光谱-空间信息提升HSI分类，但同一图像中随机划分训练/测试集会导致空间patch重叠，造成数据泄漏和过于乐观的性能估计。
AI.method: 提出两种度量：重叠百分比（OP）量化全局测试patch像素重叠量；平均重叠比（AOR）衡量受影响测试patch的局部严重程度。在Pavia University数据集上，对随机与非随机空间采样进行比较，测试SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT和MorpMamba。并做patch尺寸分析。
AI.result: 随机采样下深度patch模型准确率高，3D-CNN达96.17% OA；非随机采样下大幅下降，3D-CNN降至55.20%，ViT和2D-CNN分别下降40.71和38.81个百分点。patch尺寸从5x5增至19x19，重叠百分比从23.28%升至77.02%。
AI.conclusion: 随机patch评估会显著夸大分类性能，尤其对强烈利用空间上下文的模型。研究揭示了HSI分类评估中的严重数据泄漏风险。

title: DeltaTTT: Layerwise Optimization for Nonlinear Recurrent Memory
summary: Sequential test-time training adapts a memory network through successive updates, each computing an inner-loop gradient based on the network's previous state. Intuitively, this state dependence should allow each update to account for what the memory has already learned and better incorporate new information. However, we find that this expected advantage does not consistently materialize in nonlinear memories: a fixed-base parallel TTT baseline outperforms its serial counterpart. Our exploratory experiments point to a key underlying difficulty: nonlinear memories can be harder to optimize than linear ones within a single pass over the sequence. To alleviate this optimization difficulty, we introduce DeltaTTT, which replaces joint inner-loop optimization of a two-layer memory network with layerwise learning. Each layer is assigned a local prediction target and updated through a state-dependent delta rule. This formulation retains a nonlinear readout while enabling chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on DeltaNet and LaCT backbones show improvements in language modeling and retrieval over their recurrent baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文发现序列式测试时训练（TTT）在非线性记忆网络中反而不如并行基线，提出 DeltaTTT 用逐层 delta 规则缓解优化难题。
AI.motivation: 作者直觉认为序列式 TTT 的状态依赖更新能让记忆网络更好地整合新信息，但实验发现该优势在非线性记忆中并不稳定，固定基底的并行 TTT 基线反而优于序列版本。探究发现核心困难是非线性记忆在单次序列遍历中更难优化，故需改进优化方式。
AI.method: DeltaTTT 将两层记忆网络的联合内循环优化替换为逐层学习：每层分配一个局部预测目标，并通过状态依赖的 delta 规则进行更新。该方式保留非线性读出，同时支持分块并行计算。
AI.result: 在 DeltaNet 与 LaCT 骨干上的实验表明，DeltaTTT 相较其循环基线在语言建模和检索任务上均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 逐层 delta 规则能有效缓解非线性记忆的优化困难，兼顾非线性表达能力与并行效率，是一种改进 TTT 的可行方案。

title: OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization
summary: NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4

AI.tldr: 提出OSFP4量化方案，针对NVFP4优化平滑与缩放，在保持吞吐的同时提升LLM推理精度。
AI.motivation: NVFP4虽存储紧凑且有原生张量核加速，但保持精度需精细量化。
AI.method: 对每个线性投影使用对角平滑矩阵，优化其元素以最小化NVFP4下矩阵乘量化误差，考虑舍入过程（最近舍入或GPTQ式干扰消除）；通过分析乘法抖动FP4量化器实现平滑元素与块缩放的联合优化。
AI.result: 在对应量化设置下平均精度最高，保留约94-97%的厂商NVFP4预填充吞吐。
AI.conclusion: OSFP4在精度与吞吐间取得良好平衡，代码已开源。

title: Privileged Context as Drift in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a language model to match a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context. Existing work varies what privileged context contains and how it is produced while also changing models, data, and training setups, making the effects of privileged context design difficult to isolate. Motivated by efforts in continual learning to reduce catastrophic forgetting, we study how the choice of privileged context affects policy drift. Specifically, we vary two axes: content (a demonstration, feedback, or rephrase) and source (external, self-generated with a verifier, or self-generated without a verifier). We train Qwen2.5-7B with OPSD across these nine combinations and three datasets, measuring target-task accuracy, prior-task retention, reverse KL from the base policy, and parameter-update geometry. Holding source fixed, changing content spans a wider median KL range than holding content fixed and changing source. The ratio between these ranges is $5.1\times$ for per-token KL and $2.2\times$ for per-sequence KL. Parameter-update geometry shows the same pattern: updates from adapters that share content are more closely aligned (mean cosine $0.571$) than updates from adapters that share source ($0.255$). For continual learning, these findings suggest that privileged context should be treated as part of OPSD's stability design because it is associated with how far and in what direction the policy moves.

AI.tldr: 研究特权上下文设计对on-policy自蒸馏(OPSD)中策略漂移的影响，发现内容比来源影响更大。
AI.motivation: 现有OPSD研究同时改变特权上下文的内容、来源以及模型和数据，难以隔离特权上下文设计本身的效果。
AI.method: 用Qwen2.5-7B在9种特权上下文组合(3种内容×3种来源)和3个数据集上训练，测量目标任务准确率、旧任务保留、相对基础策略的反向KL及参数更新几何。
AI.result: 固定来源改内容时KL范围比固定内容改来源更宽(逐token 5.1倍,逐序列2.2倍)；共享内容的适配器更新对齐度(余弦0.571)高于共享来源(0.255)。
AI.conclusion: 特权上下文应被视为OPSD稳定性设计的一部分，因为它与策略移动的距离和方向相关。

title: Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention. By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90\% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52$\times$ attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 BASA，一种后端无关的稀疏注意力，用跨 DiT 块的结构化移位局部窗口注意力替代视觉自注意力，兼顾视觉质量与实际加速。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformers 全注意力二次复杂度导致高分辨率生成代价高；分块窗口注意力效率高但阻断跨窗口交互、产生网格伪影；滑动窗口注意力恢复交互却因不规则计算导致理论与实际加速差距大且需定制内核。
AI.method: BASA 以移位局部窗口注意力替代视觉自注意力，跨 DiT 块采用结构化窗口移位方案，使被窗口边界分隔的 token 在后续层中通信，实现全局信息交换并消除窗口伪影；不引入额外不规则算子或定制内核，可直接部署于现有注意力后端。
AI.result: 在 FLUX 上实现超过理论估计 90% 的实测加速；在 Wan 上获得 4.52 倍注意力加速，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: BASA 在后端无关设计下同时获得视觉质量与实际加速，缩小理论稀疏性与实际加速的差距，具备良好可部署性。

title: Sensor-Language-Action Models
summary: Sensors are useful not only for understanding the world but also for deciding what to do next. Existing sensor models however largely stop at perception: they recognize states or predict outcomes, leaving actions modeled separately through task-specific and often closed label spaces. We introduce Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) modeling, a framework that connects multimodal sensor observations, natural language, and actions within a unified model. SLA uses language as a semantic interface between sensing and acting, allowing heterogeneous actions to be represented, predicted, and explained while remaining grounded in the underlying sensor evidence. We build a large-scale SLA benchmark consisting of datasets that span more than 116,000 individuals, 79 sensor modalities, and 60 action groups, together with a multi-faceted captioning pipeline that aligns user context, sensor dynamics, and action evidence. Building on this framework, we present OpenSLA, a unified SLA model for hierarchical action prediction, state understanding, and action explanation. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks in clinical prediction, operating rooms, and metabolic health verify its superior performance over the state-of-the-art. OpenSLA also demonstrates intriguing capabilities including language-guided evidence grounding and zero-shot generalization to unseen actions and cohorts.

AI.tldr: 提出SLA建模范式，将多模态传感、语言与动作统一建模，并构建大规模基准与OpenSLA模型。
AI.motivation: 现有传感模型多停留在感知层面，动作被独立建模且标签空间封闭、任务专用，缺乏统一框架连接感知与行动。
AI.method: 以语言作为传感与行动间的语义接口，构建包含超11.6万人、79种传感模态、60个动作组的大规模基准及多维度描述生成管线，并设计OpenSLA统一模型实现分层动作预测、状态理解与动作解释。
AI.result: 在临床预测、手术室、代谢健康等真实任务上超越现有最优方法，具备语言引导的证据定位及对未见动作与人群的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SLA框架为感知-行动统一建模提供新范式，OpenSLA验证了其有效性与泛化潜力。

title: CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching
summary: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

AI.tldr: 提出CtrlCache：一种无需训练的、控制感知的缓存框架，用于交互式视频世界模型，通过利用控制信号调度计算复用，实现1.21x–1.41x速度提升并提升画质评分。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需高效生成视频块并忠实响应用户控制。现有分块自回归生成配合少步去噪仍需多次昂贵迭代；训练无关的缓存方法多依据模型内部去噪动态决策，未显式考虑控制转换，且忽略了控制信号在去噪前到达这一零成本可用信息。
AI.method: 分析相邻块在不同控制状态下的结构相似性：动作变化时相似性下降，低频结构比高频细节更持久。据此提出CtrlCache：动作感知调度与刷新策略跨块及块内检测动作变化，将块标记为初始、过渡、转折或稳定；在选定内部去噪步，初始与过渡块保留全计算，转折与稳定块复用同块最近全计算步的transformer残差；并引入频率混合历史先验引导，利用前序干净潜变量信息而无需额外DiT前向。
AI.result: 在Matrix-Game 2.0与LingBot-World v1/v2上评估，CtrlCache在无需重训练情况下实现1.21x至1.41x的DiT主干加速，并在三个模型上均提升WBench Overall分数。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用控制信号进行控制感知缓存，可在不训练、不增加前向成本的前提下加速交互式视频生成并提升质量，验证了控制状态驱动的计算调度有效性。

title: SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 37 pages, including appendices
summary: LLM-based agents solve complex multi-step tasks, but sequential execution incurs substantial latency. In principle, parallelizing work across multiple agents should yield near-linear speedups. Yet existing parallel multi-agent systems often run slower than a single-agent baseline. We attribute this gap to two hidden costs that parallel execution incurs but a serial agent avoids. First, there is a re-exploration cost: redundant effort spent by parallel workers reconstructing context that the orchestrator already possesses, such as prior decisions, that would otherwise be inherited implicitly in a serial execution. Second, there is an alignment cost: the overhead required to reconcile inconsistencies across independently generated outputs. We thus derive a principled decision criterion: a layer should be parallelized only when its critical-path cost, plus re-exploration and alignment overheads, is lower than the corresponding serial cost. While this criterion is naturally expressed in wall-clock time, we observe that LLMs are poorly calibrated when asked to estimate task duration. To address this, we instead measure cost in predicted output tokens, which we empirically find LLMs can estimate substantially more reliably than wall-clock time. Building on this token-based criterion, we propose SquidAgent. It estimates all token budgets in a single planning step, forks each worker directly from the orchestrator's session to eliminate re-exploration cost, and replaces post-hoc reconciliation with a pre-generated shared convention block that converts alignment into a bounded upfront cost. A deterministic scheduler then applies the criterion layer by layer. Empirically, SquidAgent achieves a 2.2$\times$ mean throughput improvement and a 2.6$\times$ mean wall-time speedup over Claude Code, and a 2.0$\times$ throughput improvement over the strongest multi-agent baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出SquidAgent，通过基于token的并行决策准则与共享约定机制，消除并行多智能体的重探索与对齐成本，实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 并行多智能体理论上应带来近线性加速，但现有系统常比单智能体更慢，作者归因于重探索成本和对齐成本两大隐藏开销。
AI.method: 推导并行判据（关键路径成本+重探索+对齐<串行成本）；因LLM对时间估计不准，改用输出token衡量；SquidAgent单步规划估预算、worker直接从orchestrator会话分叉、预生成共享约定块、确定性调度器逐层应用判据。
AI.result: 相比Claude Code平均吞吐提升2.2×、墙钟时间加速2.6×；相比最强多智能体基线吞吐提升2.0×。
AI.conclusion: 以token而非时间为成本度量，并前置消除隐式开销，可使并行多智能体系统真正兑现其加速潜力。

title: LeanPlan: Optimal Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics and Admissibility Proofs
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) can generate heuristic functions that guide search to achieve state-of-the-art performance in satisficing planning, where any plan is acceptable. However, these heuristics are not guaranteed to be admissible and can lead to suboptimal plans. We introduce LeanPlan, the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. Given a domain description and training tasks, an agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof and the required domain assumptions. LeanPlan implements the heuristic, its proof and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search in Lean 4. We evaluate LeanPlan on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, using test tasks with up to 57 times as many objects as the training tasks. With GPT-5.6 Sol in the agentic loop, we successfully generate heuristics and admissibility proofs for all these domains. With the resulting heuristics, LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solves more tasks overall.

AI.tldr: LeanPlan是首个使用LLM生成启发式函数并机器验证其可采纳性（admissibility）的最优规划系统，在Lean 4中实现启发式、证明及高效规划器，在13个领域上成功生成可验证启发式，通常比Scorpion扩展更少状态并解决更多任务。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM可生成启发式函数用于可满足规划并达到SOTA，但这些启发式不保证可采纳，可能导致次优规划。本文旨在获得既能指导搜索又具备可机器验证可采纳性的LLM生成启发式，从而实现最优规划。
AI.method: 给定领域描述和训练任务，采用agentic loop，利用规划器反馈迭代改进可复用的领域特定启发式、其可采纳性证明及所需领域假设。在Lean 4中实现该启发式、证明以及带机器验证接地与搜索的高效规划器。
AI.result: 在国际规划竞赛的十个领域及三个新领域上评估，测试任务对象数最多为训练任务的57倍。使用GPT-5.6 Sol，成功为所有领域生成启发式和可采纳性证明；所得启发式通常比SOTA的Scorpion规划器扩展更少状态，整体解决更多任务。
AI.conclusion: LeanPlan展示了将LLM生成启发式与机器验证可采纳性证明结合以实现最优规划的可行性，在多个领域上优于SOTA规划器。

title: A Decision-Focused Neural Optimization Framework for Personalized Route Reproduction from Vehicle Trajectories
summary: This study formulates individual route reproduction as a shortest-path problem over learned driver-specific latent link costs. The central idea is that, once such latent costs are inferred from contextual information, observed routes can be reproduced without enumerating alternative route sets. We propose a neural pipeline that includes a perception model that embeds context covariates, which comprises individual characteristics, trip-specific attributes, and network-level traffic states, into the personalized link costs. A constrained optimization (CO) layer, which determines the shortest path (SP) based on these estimated costs, follows the perception encoder. To enable end-to-end training, we employ decision-focused learning to align the predicted shortest paths with observed routes. The implicit maximum likelihood estimation (iMLE) provides an approximate gradient of the loss function that contains the non-differentiable CO layer. Furthermore, a regularization term anchors the latent cost distribution to the empirical scale of observed link travel times, mitigating the scale ambiguity inherent in shortest-path supervision. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms baseline route choice models in path reproduction. The learned latent costs, interpreted as proxies for perceived travel costs, provide plausible explanations for heterogeneous route choices.

AI.tldr: 将个体路径复现建模为基于学习的驾驶员专属潜在路段成本的最短路径问题，用神经pipeline结合决策聚焦学习实现端到端训练。
AI.motivation: 观测路径复现通常需要枚举备选路径集，效率低且难以刻画个体异质性。作者希望直接从上下文信息推断潜在路段成本，从而无需枚举备选路径即可复现观测路径，并解释异质路径选择行为。
AI.method: 提出神经pipeline：1) 感知模型将上下文协变量（个体特征、行程属性、网络级交通状态）嵌入为个性化路段成本；2) 约束优化（CO）层基于估计成本求解最短路径（SP）；3) 采用决策聚焦学习（decision-focused learning）对齐预测SP与观测路径，用隐式最大似然估计（iMLE）为含不可微CO层的损失提供近似梯度；4) 加入正则项将潜在成本分布锚定到观测路段行程时间的经验尺度，缓解最短路径监督中的尺度模糊问题。
AI.result: 实证评估表明，所提框架在路径复现任务上优于基线路径选择模型；学到的潜在成本（可解释为感知出行成本代理）为异质路径选择提供了合理解释。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明通过决策聚焦学习端到端训练潜在路段成本并求解最短路径，可有效复现个体路径且无需枚举备选路径集，同时提供对异质路径选择的可解释性。

title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
summary: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

AI.tldr: ALIVE框架通过首帧编辑与仅命名新增对象的指令，让插入对象与源视频内容产生连贯交互，实现“活起来”的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑能插入对象，但难以让插入对象参与被抓取或操控等交互，缺乏与源视频动作的协调性。
AI.method: 构建35,800个编辑对（3D渲染、模型生成、真实视频及ROSE通用编辑对），每对仅改变目标对象存在性而保持周围动作；训练VLM从相同输入预测交互引导。
AI.result: 无VLM引导时，ALIVE在两基准上Overall分别超过最强基线43.9%和4.4%；VLM预测引导额外提升ALIVE-interaction分数0.95分，且无需额外用户输入。
AI.conclusion: ALIVE有效提升了视频对象插入的交互保真度、源保持与视觉连贯性，VLM引导可进一步增强效果。

title: Principled Under Pressure: Post-Training Decides Whether LLMs Act on Their Own Moral Judgment
summary: Language models increasingly act as agents. An agent that says an action is wrong and then takes it anyway is a different failure from one that does not know better, and evaluations of stated values cannot see it. We build a pre-registered panel of 248 scenarios across five kinds of pressure. Each scenario is posed twice to the same model, once as the agent choosing what to do and once in the third person asking which option is right, so the model's own judgment is the reference. Every scenario has a twin with the pressure removed, and every model gets a positive control in which its operator orders the violating action, so that a missing gap can be told apart from a blind instrument. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, the model takes the action it judged wrong on about one in five pressuring scenarios, more often than on the same scenarios with the pressure removed. Across four instruct models the gap depends on the post-training recipe: OLMo-3 and Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct carry it; Tulu 3 shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.01 in probability) or on its own most-pressuring scenarios; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.02) and is unresolved on its own (0.083, -0.028 to 0.195). Meta's recipe and Ai2's Tulu 3 start from the same Llama-3.1 weights, and only Meta's carries the gap. Reading a chat model outside its chat template reverses the sign of its gap with nothing at stake (-0.038 against +0.055 under the template on OLMo-3), a distortion present on two of three recipes. On both models that carry it, reasoning about the stakes before acting moves the choice back toward the model's own judgment, against a same-length non-moral task, with or without the pressure; on OLMo-3, naming the norm at stake does about a third of that. The gap is a measurable target for post-training recipes, not a fixed property of pretrained weights.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个预注册的248场景压力测试面板，测量语言模型在压力下是否会做出自己判定为错误的行为（即"知行不一"），发现该"知行差距"取决于后训练配方而非预训练权重。
AI.motivation: 语言模型日益充当智能体，而"说某行为错却仍去做"与"不知道好坏"是两种不同的失败模式；仅评估模型声称的价值观无法捕捉这种知行分离的现象，因此需要一个能区分并量化该差距的评测方法。
AI.method: 构建预注册的248个场景面板，覆盖5类压力；每个场景对同一模型提问两次（第一人称实际选择 vs 第三人称判断对错），以模型自身判断为参照；每场景配一个移除压力的孪生版本，并加入"操作者下令违规"的正控制以区分真实缺失与工具失效。测试四个指令模型（OLMo-3-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Tulu 3、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct），并考察chat template、行动前推理、点明规范等因素的影响。
AI.result: 在OLMo-3-7B-Instruct上，模型约在五分之一有压力场景中做出自己判定为错的行为，且高于移除压力的版本。该差距依赖后训练配方：OLMo-3与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct存在差距，Tulu 3整体及自身最强压力场景上均无，Qwen2.5整体无（>0.02）且自身不明确。Meta与Ai2配方均始于同一Llama-3.1权重，仅Meta保留差距。脱离chat template会反转差距符号（OLMo-3上-0.038 vs +0.055），三个配方中两个存在此失真。在存在差距的两个模型上，行动前对代价进行推理会把选择拉回其自身判断；OLMo-3上点明规范可解释约三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 这种知行差距是后训练配方可测量的目标，而非预训练权重固有的固定属性。

title: MASC: A Multi-Agent Self-Calibration Framework with Latent Construct Alignment for Consistent Client Role-Playing in Psychological Counseling
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate clients for counselor training and psychological counseling research, but reliable simulation requires clients to remain psychologically coherent across extended interactions. Existing role-playing methods largely rely on static profile prompts and may exhibit persona drift, unrealistic cooperativeness, or inconsistent psychological states, communicative actions, and emotions. Existing evaluations also lack a unified testbed for both stable client characteristics and evolving psychological dynamics. We propose MASC, a Multi-Agent Self-Calibration framework with latent construct alignment for consistent client role-playing in psychological counseling. MASC combines construct-guided generation, collaborative refinement, consistency verification, and memory-based revision in a closed calibration loop that detects and corrects inconsistencies as dialogue unfolds. We further introduce CRPC-Bench, a benchmark covering session-level profile information and Big-Five personality traits, as well as turn-level psychological state, communicative action, and emotion expression. CRPC-Bench contains 38 motivational interviewing client profiles augmented with personality and emotion annotations. Experiments show that MASC outperforms existing methods across profile, personality, receptivity, and turn-level consistency, with the heterogeneous configuration achieving the strongest overall performance. MASC and CRPC-Bench provide a unified foundation for developing and evaluating psychologically coherent client simulations for AI-assisted counseling research and training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MASC多智能体自校准框架，通过潜在构念对齐实现心理咨询中一致的来访者角色扮演，并发布CRPC-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 大模型越来越多用于模拟心理咨询来访者，但现有角色扮演方法依赖静态画像提示，存在人格漂移、不真实配合及心理状态/沟通行为/情绪不一致的问题，且缺乏评估稳定特征与动态心理变化的统一测试平台。
AI.method: MASC整合构念引导生成、协作精炼、一致性验证和基于记忆的修订，形成闭环校准机制，在对话过程中检测并纠正不一致。同时提出CRPC-Bench基准，涵盖会话级画像与人格特质及回合级心理状态、沟通行为和情绪表达，含38个动机式访谈来访者画像及人格与情绪标注。
AI.result: 实验表明MASC在画像、人格、接受度及回合级一致性上均优于现有方法，其中异构配置取得最强整体性能。
AI.conclusion: MASC与CRPC-Bench为AI辅助心理咨询研究与训练提供了开发与评估心理一致来访者模拟的统一基础。

title: Tram-FL: Reducing Communication and Computation Costs through Sequential Model Circulation in Decentralized Federated Learning
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Conventional decentralized federated learning (DFL) often focuses on clients, with each client maintaining a model copy, performing updates individually, and undertaking model exchange and integration. While fully leveraging computational resources can shorten training times, it can also lead to significant computational and communication waste. This is especially pronounced with non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data, where achieving high model accuracy demands extra resources. This research shifts focus to the model itself, aiming to realize DFL with minimal computation and communication costs. To this end, we propose Tram-FL (Traveling Model Training Mechanism for Decentralized Federated Learning), a mechanism designed to efficiently address these challenges. It sequentially trains a single model by circulating it among nodes. We address the training scheduling problem in model circulation-based training, specifically determining which nodes should update the model and the number of updates to perform. This is approached by considering the model's circulation route and update iteration allocation, for which we propose simple yet effective methods. Additionally, with quantized momentum, Tram-FL achieves high accuracy with fewer model circulations while controlling communication load per transmission. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm, even with non-IID data, converges to a global model with reduced communication and computation.

AI.tldr: 提出Tram-FL机制，通过单模型在节点间循环训练，以最小化去中心化联邦学习的计算与通信开销。
AI.motivation: 传统去中心化联邦学习以客户端为中心，各客户端维护模型副本并各自更新，虽能利用算力缩短训练时间，但在非IID数据下造成大量计算与通信浪费。本文转向以模型为中心，追求极低的计算与通信成本。
AI.method: 提出Tram-FL，通过单一模型在节点间循环（traveling）依次训练；解决模型循环训练中的调度问题，即决定哪些节点更新模型及更新次数，从循环路径与更新迭代分配两方面设计简单有效的方法；并采用量化动量（quantized momentum）在控制单次传输通信负载的同时提升精度。
AI.result: 实验表明，即便在非IID数据下，该算法也能以更少的通信和计算收敛到全局模型，并保持较高精度、减少模型循环次数。
AI.conclusion: Tram-FL验证了以模型为中心的循环训练范式在去中心化联邦学习中的有效性，可在非IID场景下显著降低资源消耗。

title: 4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction
summary: Existing methods for 4D hand-object reconstruction often rely on costly per-sequence optimization, while generative approaches typically synthesize interactions from random noise, which can lead to unstable interaction prediction. We introduce 4D-HOF, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs 4D hand-object interactions from coarse but informative estimates produced by vision foundation models. Concretely, we learn a conditional flow matching model that transports foundation-model-derived hand-object states toward an interaction manifold, allowing the model to correct errors in translation, rotation, and alignment in a feed-forward manner. A key advantage of our generative formulation is that it naturally enables test-time guidance within the transport process. Rather than applying a separate post-hoc optimization after reconstruction, we directly steer the evolving generative states using physical interaction constraints and observed 2D evidence, allowing the reconstruction to be refined as part of the generative process itself. By training the generative model on diverse datasets, 4D-HOF generalizes robustly to challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks show that 4D-HOF achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing more stable and accurate 4D hand-object reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 4D-HOF是一个前馈框架，利用视觉基础模型的粗略估计，通过条件流匹配将手物状态传输到交互流形，实现稳定准确的4D手物重建。
AI.motivation: 现有4D手物重建依赖昂贵的逐序列优化，而生成式方法从随机噪声合成交互，导致交互预测不稳定。作者希望借助基础模型的粗略但有信息量的估计，实现高效稳定的重建。
AI.method: 学习一个条件流匹配模型，将基础模型导出的手物状态传输至交互流形，前馈地修正平移、旋转与对齐误差。其生成式形式天然支持测试时引导：直接用物理交互约束和观测到的2D证据引导演化中的生成状态，而非重建后再做后处理优化。并在多样化数据集上训练以增强泛化。
AI.result: 在域外基准测试上，4D-HOF取得最先进性能，生成更稳定、更准确的4D手物重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式流匹配与测试时引导结合，可在无需逐序列优化的前提下鲁棒泛化到真实场景，实现高质量4D手物交互重建。

title: A Systematic Study of Small Language Models on Abstract Reasoning Tasks
summary: Endpoint accuracy on abstract-reasoning benchmarks does not reveal whether a language model has acquired a transferable rule or fit distribution-specific regularities. We study this distinction in small language models on the ARC-TGI benchmark, which organizes abstract grid transformations into controllable task families and supports resampling, spatial shifts, and cross-benchmark transfer. Across more than 1,000 runs, we profile decoder-only, encoder--decoder, and mixture-of-experts model families under supervised fine-tuning. We examine the efficiency and stability of skill acquisition, robustness beyond the training distribution, interactions with model family and task formulation, and layer-wise attention signatures that accompany behavioral differences. Substantial in-distribution accuracy is attainable, but acquisition is sensitive to optimization and unevenly distributed across task families. Performance deteriorates sharply outside the training distribution, including when the rule is retained but grid scale changes. Greater training-set depth and breadth yield uneven gains, while the effect of additional in-context examples depends on model family. Executable-rule induction also yields correct solutions not observed under direct grid generation. On selected tasks, attention diagnostics show distinct concentration and context-dependence profiles, but do not establish general causal mechanisms. Overall, abstract-reasoning scores are conditional on the model, adaptation regime, evaluation distribution, and response format.

AI.tldr: 论文研究小型语言模型在抽象推理中是否学到可迁移规则还是仅拟合分布规律，通过ARC-TGI基准的上千次实验分析多种模型族。
AI.motivation: 抽象推理基准的最终准确率无法区分模型是学到了可迁移规则，还是只是拟合了特定分布的模式，这一区分对理解模型泛化能力至关重要。
AI.method: 在ARC-TGI基准上，对decoder-only、encoder-decoder和MoE模型族进行监督微调实验（超过1000次运行），考察技能习得效率、分布外鲁棒性、模型族与任务表述的交互，以及注意力层特征。
AI.result: 分布内准确率可较高，但对优化敏感且任务族间不均衡；分布外性能急剧下降（即使规则保留但网格尺度变化）；训练集深度与广度的增益不均；上下文示例效果依模型族而异；可执行规则归纳可解出直接生成无法解出的题；注意力诊断显示不同集中度与上下文依赖，但未确立普遍因果机制。
AI.conclusion: 抽象推理得分高度依赖于模型、适应方式、评估分布和回答格式，不能简单视作可迁移推理能力的证据。

title: zkLLMPoT: Efficient Zero Knowledge Proof of Training for Large Language Models
summary: Auditing the claimed outcomes of large language model (LLM) training is challenging when model weights and training data are private, while cryptographically proving the full training process is prohibitively expensive at Transformer scale. We present zkLLMPoT, a zero-knowledge framework that certifies auditor-defined properties of a trained checkpoint through forward evaluation rather than verification of its optimization trajectory. zkLLMPoT includes 2 phases: 1) The trainer fixes the architecture and the model weights are committed. Then the auditor selects challenge sequences, preventing the trainer from modifying the checkpoint in response to the audit data. 2) Then the trainer proves the objective value attained by the committed model on those sequences. This formulation makes the certification cost independent of the number of training iterations, without revealing model weights or requiring access to private training data. We build on sumcheck- and lookup-based arguments to certify Transformer computations, while supporting next-token loss and task-specific audit objectives. Across four model families, operator-level benchmarks yield proving times of 41-59 seconds for 1.1-1.5B-parameter models and 131 seconds at 13B for the covered operators, with verification below half a second at a sequence length of 512.

AI.tldr: zkLLMPoT 提出零知识框架，通过前向评估而非验证训练轨迹来认证私有权重训练模型的审计属性，成本与训练迭代次数无关。
AI.motivation: LLM 训练结果审计困难：权重和数据私有，而密码学证明完整训练过程在 Transformer 规模下代价过高，因此需要一种不依赖训练轨迹的审计方法。
AI.method: 两阶段协议：1) 固定架构并承诺权重，审计者选择挑战序列以防止 trainer 篡改；2) trainer 证明承诺模型在这些序列上的目标值。基于 sumcheck 和 lookup 论证认证 Transformer 计算，支持 next-token loss 及任务特定目标，无需泄露权重或私有数据。
AI.result: 在四个模型族中，算子级基准显示 1.1-1.5B 模型证明时间 41-59 秒，13B 为 131 秒，序列长度 512 时验证时间低于 0.5 秒。
AI.conclusion: zkLLMPoT 将 LLM 审计转化为对已承诺检查点的前向评估证明，使认证成本与训练迭代无关，在提供隐私保护的同时保持可接受的证明与验证开销。

title: On-Policy Distillation with Negative-Policy Rollouts
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has been widely studied as a post-training method in which a student model obtains token-level supervision from a stronger teacher on its own rollouts. Recent studies have improved OPD through alternative distillation reward formulations and teacher configurations, while the objective of distillation remains centered on mimicking the teacher. However, when a stronger teacher has limited distributional overlap with the student, such positive guidance can provide insufficient learning signals. In this work, we introduce Negative-Policy OPD (NP-OPD), which complements teacher supervision with rollouts from a lower-performing, lower-capability negative policy that serves as a negative reference for the student. Rather than modifying the distillation reward formulation, NP-OPD introduces the negative policy at the rollout stage, continuously supplying tokens preferred by the negative policy over the teacher so that they remain exposed to teacher supervision throughout training. This provides an explicit negative signal through negative-policy rollouts while preserving the positive teacher supervision used in OPD. Through extensive experiments, we show that NP-OPD improves OPD across model scales, generation modes, reasoning domains, and different OPD variants. Furthermore, our analyses show that NP-OPD effectively suppresses tokens preferred by the negative policy over the teacher and moves the student away from the negative policy. These results support our design of introducing negative signals through negative-policy rollouts and provide new insight into the role of the rollout policy in OPD. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/np-opd.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NP-OPD，通过在rollout阶段引入一个低能力"负策略"作为负参考，补充教师监督的不足，从而提升on-policy蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏（OPD）主要依赖正向教师监督，但当强教师与学生的分布重叠有限时，正向指导无法提供充足的学习信号。
AI.method: NP-OPD不修改蒸馏奖励形式，而是在rollout阶段引入一个性能更低、能力更弱的负策略，持续提供被负策略偏好但被教师不偏好的token，使其始终暴露在教师监督下，从而形成显式负信号，同时保留原有的正向教师监督。
AI.result: 实验表明NP-OPD在多种模型规模、生成模式、推理领域及不同OPD变体上均有提升；分析显示其能有效抑制负策略偏好token，并使学生远离负策略。
AI.conclusion: 通过负策略rollout引入负信号是一种有效设计，为OPD中rollout策略的作用提供了新见解。

title: Building Rome from a Single Image
summary: Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g., Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g., buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D-3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文改造以物体为中心的3D生成器（如Trellis 2），使其适用于室内外单图场景生成，通过自适应分块、显式2D-3D对应建模和合成室外数据，在几何精度和感知质量上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练3D物体生成器虽有强形状先验，但针对固定规范体积内的孤立物体，且主要面向室内场景；室外3D数据稀缺，导致单图场景生成（含未观测区域）在室内外通用性不足。
AI.method: (a) 按相机距离自适应分块，近处小块保留细节，远处（如建筑）用大块覆盖；(b) 通过提升图像特征使生成器捕捉显式2D-3D对应，并感知自由空间、已观测表面与未观测区域；(c) 合成约4000个室外场景扩充训练数据。
AI.result: 在Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++及真实图像上的实验表明，该方法在室内外场景的几何精度与感知质量上均优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新设计物体中心的生成器并补充室外数据，可有效扩展单图3D场景生成至室内外通用场景，同时保留预训练先验。

title: Label-Efficient Deep Learning for ECG Delineation: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark against Widely Used Delineation Tools
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. First two authors contributed equally
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) delineation, the identification of waveform boundaries, is a foundational step that translates raw ECG signals into clinically interpretable measurements. Deep learning has advanced this task but remains dependent on costly expert annotations. Label-efficient strategies such as self-supervised pretraining and semi-supervised learning are expected to ease this burden, yet it remains unclear whether they yield reliable delineation and whether the deep models they produce outperform the delineation tools used in practice. We address this in two stages. First, comparing self-supervised objectives with supervised or semi-supervised fine-tuning across one internal and four external datasets, we find that pretraining helps but the objective matters, and that the value of semi-supervised fine-tuning depends on the pretraining objective. Second, we benchmark the selected deep learning model against widely used open-source (NeuroKit2, Prominence, ECGdeli) and commercial (CalECG) tools using three complementary metrics. The model ranks best on every metric and dataset, outperforming the strongest tool by a clear margin on the rhythm-diverse set (mIoU 71.3 vs. 54.8%; averaged point-wise sensitivity 92.6 vs. 76.4%), and degrades the least from sinus to arrhythmia. A rhythm-stratified and point-wise analysis further characterizes the distinctive behavior of each tool, yielding practical guidance for tool selection. These results provide systematic, multi-dataset evidence that self-supervised pretraining is effective for ECG delineation and enables a label-efficiently trained deep learning model to outperform widely used delineation tools by leveraging abundant unlabeled data. This supports adopting such models in diverse, real-world clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了自监督预训练与半监督微调在ECG波形分割中的作用，并证明标签高效训练的深度学习模型在所有指标和数据集上均优于主流开源及商业分割工具。
AI.motivation: ECG波形分割依赖昂贵的专家标注，虽自监督预训练和半监督学习有望缓解这一负担，但其能否实现可靠分割、所产模型能否超越实际使用的工具尚不明确。
AI.method: 两阶段研究：先在一个内部及四个外部数据集上比较自监督目标与监督/半监督微调组合；再将选定模型与NeuroKit2、Prominence、ECGdeli及CalECG等工具用三种互补指标进行基准对比，并做节律分层与逐点分析。
AI.result: 预训练有效但目标函数很关键，半监督微调价值取决于预训练目标；该模型在所有指标和数据集上排名第一，在节律多样集上大幅领先最强工具（mIoU 71.3 vs 54.8%；平均逐点敏感度92.6 vs 76.4%），且从窦性到心律失常退化最小。
AI.conclusion: 自监督预训练对ECG分割有效，可实现标签高效训练并利用大量无标注数据超越常用分割工具，支持其在多样真实临床场景中应用。

title: World Models' Last Exam in Physics
summary: Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems. Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics. We introduce World Models' Last Exam in Physics, a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models. The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension. Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos. Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements. Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100. Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions. The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.

AI.tldr: 提出"World Models' Last Exam in Physics"基准，用40个跨物理领域的可控任务、基于测量的评估器来评测视频世界模型的物理一致性，最佳模型仅得57.76/100。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型能生成视觉逼真但物理不一致的序列，威胁其在具身AI中预测与规划的可靠性；现有评估多依赖模型判断或参考视频，直接物理测试又偏重力学，缺乏覆盖广、可测量、可解释的评测。
AI.method: 构建含40个受控任务的基准，覆盖力学、光学、流体、热学与相变、电磁学、表面张力；每任务配初始图像、生成提示及预定义物理判据，无需参考视频即可测试可观测物理关系。评估器结合任务可观测性筛选与任务专属定量物理测量。
AI.result: 在8个视频生成模型、1280个视频上实验，揭示持续存在的物理不一致及任务间显著差异，最佳模型总分仅57.76/100。合成视频验证了测量模块在受控条件下的有效性；评估器在任务内排序与成对比较中与人类判断一致性均高于VLM基线。
AI.conclusion: 该基准以跨领域覆盖、可测量证据和显式测量局限，为诊断物理不一致、追踪朝向物理一致视频世界模型的进展提供了可解释基础。

title: The Standardization Trap: Certifying Joint Label Processing in Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Linear regression and kernel smoothing offer tractable explanations of in-context learning: in both, the features determine the weight assigned to each context label. However, whether this fixed-weight account describes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) remains unclear. Testing this account using derivatives runs into a standardization trap: public TFM packages standardize the labels before the model sees them, yet ordinary derivatives also reflect behavior outside the set of standardized labels, making a model appear nonlinear even when every prediction it makes agrees with a fixed-weight map. We propose two certificates that depend only on predictions at standardized labels and can reject two distinct explanations: fixed-weight prediction and sums of independent nonlinear label transformations. Across the five public TFMs that we evaluate, our certificates show that changing one context label alters how other labels influence the prediction, a behavior we call joint processing. We further find that joint processing emerges with training and that attention scores carry most of the measured interaction. Together, these findings motivate TFM explanations that account for how context labels change the influence of individual examples.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验预训练表格基础模型(TFM)的上下文学习是否遵循固定权重解释，提出两种仅依赖标准化标签预测的证书，证明TFM存在"联合处理"行为。
AI.motivation: 线性回归和核平滑等固定权重解释在表格基础模型(TFM)上是否成立尚不清楚。直接用导数检验会遇到"标准化陷阱"：公开TFM包在模型看到标签前会先标准化标签，导致普通导数反映模型在标准化标签集之外的行为，使本可视为固定权重映射的模型被误判为非线性。
AI.method: 提出两种只依赖标准化标签上预测的证书(certificates)，可分别拒绝两种解释：固定权重预测，以及独立非线性标签变换之和。用这些证书评估五个公开TFM。
AI.result: 在评估的五个公开TFM上，证书显示改变一个上下文标签会改变其他标签对预测的影响，作者称之为"联合处理"(joint processing)。联合处理随训练出现，且注意力分数承载了大部分测量到的交互。
AI.conclusion: 固定权重解释无法描述TFM的行为。这些发现推动建立能考虑上下文标签如何改变单个样本影响力的TFM解释方法。

title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures. Code and model are available at https://github.com/SALT-NLP/Sherpa
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable problem solvers, but being able to solve a problem is not the same as being able to teach it. Existing approaches to training LLMs as teachers rely on demonstrations, preference data, or predefined pedagogical criteria that specify what good teaching looks like. However, these signals are often not grounded in individual student learning outcomes, where effective teaching strategies can vary substantially across learners. To address this, we introduce Sherpa, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that instantiates multiple student archetypes with LLMs conditioned on distinct learning preferences and trains a teacher model to adapt its instruction by directly maximizing their learning outcomes. Teacher LLMs trained with Sherpa improve instructed students' performance across all archetypes by an average of 20.5 percentage points. Under MathTutorBench's evaluation, Sherpa raises the overall pedagogy score from 52.5% to 79.2%, indicating better teaching responses. Our human studies show that the trained teacher is preferred over the base model in 79.6% of pairwise comparisons. Together, Sherpa trains LLM teachers to adapt to diverse simulated students and become better aligned with human teachers, paving the road towards AI tutors teaching real students.

AI.tldr: Sherpa 是一个多轮强化学习框架，通过构建具有不同学习偏好的学生原型，直接以学生学习成果为优化目标来训练 LLM 教师，使其能适应多样化学生并提升教学效果。
AI.motivation: 现有训练 LLM 作为教师的方法依赖演示、偏好数据或预设教学标准，这些信号未扎根于个体学生的学习成果，而有效的教学策略因学习者而异，因此需要直接以学生实际学习效果来驱动教师训练。
AI.method: 提出 Sherpa 多轮强化学习框架：用 LLM 实例化多个学生原型，这些原型以不同学习偏好为条件；训练教师模型在多轮交互中调整其教学指令，直接最大化各原型学生的学习成果。
AI.result: 经 Sherpa 训练的教师使所有原型学生的表现平均提升 20.5 个百分点；在 MathTutorBench 上，教学总分从 52.5% 提升至 79.2%；人类研究显示，79.6% 的成对比较中训练后教师优于基座模型。
AI.conclusion: Sherpa 使 LLM 教师能适应多样化的模拟学生，并更好地与人类教师对齐，为 AI 导师教授真实学生铺平了道路。

title: SCOPE: Certified Theorem Proving with a Language Model as the Policy Planner
summary: In proof assistants such as Lean, a generated proof must pass machine compilation checks, so evaluation needs no human scoring. Direct generation fails on multi-step numeric propositions: a proof is valid only if every content integer is correct, so the pass rate is bounded by the k-th power of the per-integer accuracy. Controlled corruption across 2,617 reference proofs confirms this power law. SCOPE (State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution) enforces the natural division of labor: the model plans over an operator vocabulary, a symbolic engine executes the numerics, and a compiler renders the proof. On a 218-problem suite it certifies 191/218 (87.6%) with a 135M backbone; the 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL certifies 18/218 at 27.5 times the tokens and 37.5 times the wall-clock, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B certifies zero on a bidirectional dual suite. Multi-step thinking costs 6.12 discrete decision actions per problem and produces no natural-language thinking text. Replacing the lagged engine state in the decision frame with the current one lifts the pass rate from 117/218 to 191/218, while up-weighting the chain-end loss hurts. On the public Lean-Workbook library, 2,132 of 3,536 gradeable admissible problems certify (60.29%) with zero regression on the main suite. All readings come from a version-frozen review with independent rechecks and reverse verification. Restricting free generation and keeping decision-time information visible is a more direct route than enlarging the model.

AI.tldr: SCOPE 将"模型规划算子+符号引擎执行数值+编译器出证明"分工,在 Lean 多步数值命题上用 135M 骨干达 87.6% 通过率,远超 7B 模型,证明限制自由生成比放大模型更有效。
AI.motivation: 直接生成的多步数值证明只有在每个整数都正确时才有效,通过率受限于单个整数正确率的 k 次方,导致直接生成方法失败(经 2617 个参考证明的受控破坏验证了这一幂律)。
AI.method: SCOPE(State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution):模型在算子词表上做规划,符号引擎执行数值计算,编译器渲染证明。将决策帧中的滞后引擎状态替换为当前状态;并(对比)对链尾损失加权。
AI.result: 218 题套件上以 135M 骨干认证 191/218(87.6%);7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 仅认证 18/218,消耗 27.5 倍 token 与 37.5 倍墙钟时间;DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 在双向对偶套件上认证为零。每问题平均 6.12 个离散决策动作,无自然语言思考文本。用当前状态替换滞后状态将通过率从 117/218 提升到 191/218,而对链尾损失加权反而有害。Lean-Workbook 上 3536 个可评分合法问题认证 2132 个(60.29%),主套件无退化。
AI.conclusion: 限制自由生成并保持决策时信息可见,是比扩大模型更直接的路线;所有读数来自版本冻结的评审,并有独立复核与反向验证。

title: Variance-Averse $n$-Step Offline Reinforcement Learning for Sparse Long-Horizon Environments
summary: Generative actors are transforming offline reinforcement learning (RL) by enabling expressive policy classes that model complex action distributions. However, this expressiveness also exposes a key challenge in heterogeneous datasets: generative policies can reproduce unreliable action modes whose return distributions exhibit high variance, occasionally yielding high returns by chance but lacking consistency. Consequently, maximizing the expected $Q$-value alone is insufficient for identifying reliable actions. We propose VAN-Flow (Variance-Averse $n$-step Flow), a framework that promotes reliable actions in generative offline RL. VAN-Flow combines (i) a categorical distributional critic, (ii) a variance-averse expectation operator that smoothly reweights atom probabilities to favor actions with both high returns and low dispersion, and (iii) a flow-matching generative actor guided via rejection sampling. Unlike CVaR or mean-variance objectives, the operator redistributes probability mass over the categorical return distribution without hard truncation or auxiliary penalty terms. Across more than 40 tasks from D4RL and OGBench, VAN-Flow consistently outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in long-horizon and high-variance regimes where reliable action selection becomes critical.

AI.tldr: 提出 VAN-Flow 框架，通过方差规避的期望算子在生成式离线 RL 中筛选可靠动作，在 D4RL 和 OGBench 超过 40 个任务上优于强基线。
